title: Junior Product Developer to H&M
description:
**Job Description**  

Job Description

*Are you passionate about fashion, trends and the idea of creating an assortment that inspire and elevate the everyday wardrobe?*

*We are now looking for a curious and motivated Junior Product Developer to join our team at H&M. If you thrive in a fast paced and creative environment and want to grow your skills in product development, this is an opportunity to contribute to a global assortment that our customers love.*

*We are currently hiring for both temporary and permanent positions*

**WHAT YOU’LL DO**  

As a Junior Product Developer you will play an important role in the dynamic and multifaceted process of developing products for collections sold in all our markets around the world.


Together with a close and collaborative accessories team, you will work on identifying and developing the right assortment based on upcoming trends, customer needs and commercial insights. Your main responsibility will be to support the Product Developer in creating a relevant and attractive offer for our customers, always guided by our strategy and targets.


You will work closely with a Product Manager, Designers, Planners and other key functions throughout the development process. You will be an important link between teams, driving the process forward and ensuring smooth coordination from idea to final product.


In this role, you will be part of the daily operational work, managing several parallel tasks. You will be involved in everything from sample handling to supporting the development of accessories that meet customer expectations and strengthen our commercial potential.

 **WHO YOU ARE**  

We are looking for people with

* At least one year of experience in product development or buying in fashion
* Relevant education in fashion, buying or product development
* A commercial mindset with a strong drive to contribute to business growth
* A deep understanding of the womenswear customer and a sharp eye for fashion and trends
* A structured and organised way of working, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously
* A collaborative and communicative approach, thriving in a cross functional environment with a humble and hands on attitude
* A curious mindset and eagerness to continuously learn and develop
* Strong commercial thinking, with the ability to spot opportunities for growth and profitability
* A passion for finding smarter ways of working and improving everyday tasks

 **WHO WE ARE**  

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.


We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future.  



**JOIN US**  

Additional information:  

We are currently hiring for both temporary and permanent positions. If you feel your experience, skills and ambitions are right for this role, please send your application including CV in English as soon as possible. Interviews will be held continuously. (For internal candidates, please initiate a dialogue with you manager before applying.) If you are currently in a permanent employment with H&M you will keep your permanent employment even if you take on a temporary position for a limited time.


Benefits:  

At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer all our employees at H&M Group attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. All our employees receive a staff discount card, usable on all our H&M Group brands in stores and online. Brands covered by the discount are H&M (Beauty and Move included), COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories, ARKET. In addition to our staff discount, all our employees are included in our H&M Incentive Program – HIP.


Inclusion & Diversity:  

H&M is a part of H&M Group. At H&M Group, we’re determined to create and maintain inclusive, diverse and equitable workplaces throughout our organisation. Our teams should consist of a variety of people that share and combine their knowledge, experience and ideas. Having a diverse workforce leads to a positive impact on how we address challenges, on what we perceive possible and on how we choose to relate to our colleagues and customers all over the world. Hence all diversity dimensions are taken into consideration in our recruitment process.


We strive to have a fair and equal process and therefore kindly ask you not to attach a cover letter in your application as they often contain information that easily can trigger unintentional biases.

 **Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.**
company_description: At H&M, we welcome you to be yourself and challenge you to grow and make a difference. Help us reimagine the future of an entire industry, making everyone look, feel & do good.

title: Senior Backend Developer
description:
**Role description**
--------------------


In your new developer role, you will take part in building the **3DAI City platform**. It is a scalable answer to the growing demand for data about the urban environment and part of our efforts in smart city development. You will play an important role in designing, building and scaling the platform. 3DAI City is still a young product, and you will have a lot to contribute and freedom to shape the project.

* You will be responsible for growing our platform for storing, processing, and visualizing massive amounts of geospatial and time-series data.
* You will use your experience to design efficient solutions for our backend systems.
* You will have the opportunity to create innovative technologies that will directly help road managers reduce carbon emissions and save lives by improving road safety.

### **Who you are**

* **You have 5+ years of backend experience** (or a proven track record of equivalent depth) building production-grade services using Node.js, TypeScript, and AWS, with a solid grasp of REST APIs and GraphQL.
* **You are highly experienced with geospatial and time-series data**, bringing hands-on knowledge of specialized tools and databases (such as PostGIS) to solve complex spatial and temporal data challenges.
* **You have hands-on experience with Serverless computing or Infrastructure as Code (IaC)**, using tools like AWS CloudFormation, Docker, or the Serverless Framework to reliably deploy, manage, and scale cloud resources.
* **You can own features end-to-end**, translating high-level specifications into clean, maintainable web services—handling everything from database schemas and security to logging, monitoring, and scaling.
* **You understand distributed systems** and are comfortable designing and reasoning about asynchronous processing, caching, queues, and service-to-service communication.
* **You embrace agentic workflows and AI-assisted development**, leveraging tools like Cursor or Claude Code to accelerate delivery, refactor complex codebases, and automate tasks, all while maintaining strict engineering standards.
* **You champion code quality**, treating unit and integration testing as essential, while continuously keeping up with modern software engineering best practices.
* **You are a collaborative team player** who enjoys sharing knowledge, embraces feedback, and is driven by the desire to see your ideas successfully deployed into production.

##### **Bonus points**


You have experience working with any of these systems or technologies:

* High-performance relational, analytical, or NoSQL databases.
* Messaging and event-driven systems such as SQS, SNS, Kafka, or similar.
* Observability tools for logging, monitoring, tracing, and alerting.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and production deployment workflows.

### **What we offer**

#### **Environment**

* **Prime Stockholm location** – Modern, bright facilities steps from Skanstull (Södermalm), one of Stockholm's most vibrant neighborhoods
* **A Global Tribe:** Join a world-class team of experts from every corner of the globe. We pride ourselves on an open, inclusive, and genuinely friendly culture where your voice is heard.
* **Culture of Learning:** Stay at the bleeding edge with our **Weekly Lunch & Learns**—we provide the food, you provide the curiosity.

#### **Freedom & Flexibility**

* **Work Your Way:** We trust our experts. Enjoy **flexible work hours** and a **hybrid setup** that allows for a seamless **work-from-home** balance.

#### **Health & Wealth**

* **Wellness First:** We support your active lifestyle with a **5,000 SEK annual wellness grant** (*friskvårdsbidrag*) to use on gym memberships, yoga, or whatever keeps you moving.
* **Securing Your Future:** Rest easy knowing you’re covered by a comprehensive **occupational pension plan** (*tjänstepension*) and a benefits package designed for long-term peace of mind.

title: SR Software Developer - Olink NPX
description:
**Work Schedule**


Standard (Mon-Fri)**Environmental Conditions**


Office**Job Description**

**Job Description**


As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

**Location/Division Specific Information**


We are the Proteomic Sciences division (former Olink Proteomics). Our solutions are transforming the understanding of human diseases through advanced protein biomarker discovery. With our innovative Olink solutions – including highly specific and validated assays that cover more than 5,000 proteins – our colleagues and technology empower scientists in groundbreaking research that will play a pivotal role in the future of personalized medicine.

**Position Description**


We are looking for a SR Software Developer to join our Olink NPX team as part of our Software Development department at our HQ in Uppsala. Our Software Developers work in agile teams and across the stack to build innovative, high-quality applications.


As a SR Software Developer, you will be a key contributor in designing, developing, and maintaining our software solutions. You will work closely with fellow developers, data scientists, Product Owners, and other stakeholders to deliver robust and scalable applications. You will take ownership of complex features, contribute to technical design decisions, and help improve the quality and maintainability of our products.


Our NPX software platforms provide data analysis capabilities and processing pipelines supporting our Olink products. They are used by customers worldwide to generate and quality control proteomics data produced in laboratories and are an integral part of groundbreaking medical research.

**Main Responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain our NPX software with a strong focus on quality, performance, and maintainability.
* Collaborate with developers, data scientists, Product Owners, and other stakeholders to deliver customer value.
* Contribute to technical design discussions and implement solutions aligned with business and product needs.
* Translate functional requirements into high-quality software solutions.
* Take ownership of features throughout the development lifecycle, from refinement and implementation to testing and maintenance.
* Participate in code reviews and contribute to improving code quality, development practices, and team productivity.
* Help identify, troubleshoot, and resolve technical challenges.
* Work across the technology stack as needed.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of 7+ years of proven industry experience in software development.
* Strong knowledge of C#/.NET as well as experience with a frontend framework (we use Avalonia UI).
* Experience designing and delivering maintainable, scalable software solutions.
* Experience working with modern software development practices, including Git, automated testing, CI/CD, and Agile methodologies.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a cross-functional team.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a continuous improvement mindset.
* Full professional proficiency in English and Swedish is a must.
* Knowledge of biological sciences and bioinformatics is a strong plus.


If you are a curious person who enjoys learning new things and thrives in a collaborative and open environment, this could be the right opportunity for you.


You should be based around the Uppsala or Stockholm region and be able to attend our Uppsala HQ on a regular basis. We work three days from the office with the flexibility to work from home two days per week.

**Apply today!**


If you believe you’re the right fit for this role, we encourage you to submit your resume along with a cover letter highlighting your relevant experience.


Thermo Fisher Scientific is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status.

Vi söker en systemutvecklare med fokus på .NET inom Motorområdet. Rollen innebär deltagande i hela utvecklingsprocessen: design, utveckling, testning, driftsättning och förvaltning av säkra och moderna applikationer/integrationer, både webb och backend. title: Senior Software Engineer, Java
description:
About Us
 



**At FDJ UNITED, we don't just follow the game, we reinvent it.** 




 FDJ UNITED is one of Europe’s leading betting and gaming operators, with a vast portfolio of iconic brands and a reputation for technological excellence. With more than 5,000 employees and a presence in around fifteen regulated markets, the Group offers a diversified, responsible range of games, both under exclusive rights and open to competition. We set new standards, proving that entertainment and safety can go hand in hand. Here, you’ll work alongside a team of passionate individuals dedicated to delivering the best and safest entertaining experiences for our customers every day.
 



  





 We’re looking for bold people who are eager to succeed and ready to level-up the game. If you thrive on innovation, embrace challenges, and want to make a real impact at all levels, FDJ UNITED is your playing field.
 



**Join us in shaping the future of gaming. Are you ready to LEVEL-UP THE GAME?** 




 The role
 



 As a senior software engineer, you are a core team member on whom the team relies to consistently deliver high quality solutions. You take ownership to help the team reach their goals, including actively sharing knowledge and providing feedback. You can identify and initiate activities to address improvement areas within the team. With a mature view on technical governance you have a long term perspective of the team's components and applications.
 



 What you will do
 


* Develop secure, reliable, and maintainable solutions for authentication, authorization, and session-related flows in a business-critical domain.
* Design and evolve backend solutions that meet both business and technical requirements, while proactively identifying risks and improvement opportunities related to security, reliability, and performance.
* Contribute to a high engineering bar through clean design, code reviews, testing, and pragmatic engineering practices.
* Take ownership from design to production: break down work, drive delivery, and support operational stability in production.
* Proactively improve quality by catching issues early through automation, validation, and shift-left testing practices.
* Make sound technical decisions and align effectively with teammates and stakeholders across product, architecture, and security.



 Your experience
 


* Strong experience building and evolving production-grade backend systems in Java.
* Solid experience with the Spring ecosystem, ideally Spring Boot, and designing APIs and service integrations in complex environments.
* Experience working with distributed systems and event-driven architecture, ideally with Kafka and/or Solace.
* Solid understanding of authentication and authorization concepts, including sessions, tokens, redirects, cookies, access control, and common implementation pitfalls.
* Knowledge of OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect is a strong advantage.
* Strong secure development mindset, with the ability to identify risks, think through abuse cases, and apply secure-by-default principles in design and implementation.
* Good understanding of common application security practices such as OWASP principles, dependency/security scanning, and safe handling of sensitive data and PII.
* Experience with testing strategies such as integration testing, contract testing, and test automation.
* Comfortable reviewing code, giving and receiving feedback, and maintaining a high quality bar.
* Able to break down requirements and technical designs into clear deliverables, and sequence work in a way that reduces delivery and operational risk.
* Strong communication skills, with the ability to represent the team clearly in technical and stakeholder discussions.
* Experience with production support, monitoring, incident handling, and driving improvements after incidents.
* Experience using CI/CD pipelines and engineering tools to improve code quality, security, and delivery confidence.
* Experience working with relational databases.
* Experience with performance testing and performance-aware design is an advantage.

title: Game Developer (backend)
description:

 Hacksaw Studios is a Stockholm-based game studio focused on creating innovative, high-quality gaming experiences. With a focus on performance and precision, we bring ideas to life through technical expertise and creative collaboration. We have wide distribution, and our games are played by millions of people every month by players all over the world.
   

  

 We are currently seeking to expand our development team with additional developers and are looking for both junior and senior candidates. You will be part of our game development team and work in a tight-knit team involving both back-end developers and designers.

**Your Key Responsibilities Include**

**What We’re Looking For**
 You value clean code, smart solutions, and the impact your work has behind the scenes.
   

  

**You Bring**
* A solid backend development background.
* Experience with a programming language suited for game development, such as C#, Java or C++ (We use C#).
* A high interest in or education in mathematics or statistics.


**Nice-to-have**

 What We Offer
   

  

* A modern office in central Stockholm.
* Work with experienced, passionate colleagues in the gaming industry.
* The opportunity to create games with a global audience.
* Real influence, ownership, and personal growth opportunities.

 Practical Details
   

  

* This is an on-site position in Stockholm.

 Ready to Join the Game Makers?
   

  

 Apply now! We review applications on a rolling basis.

title: Software Developer
description:
At Billogram, we believe it always pays off to treat people well. That's why we've built a payment platform that covers the full lifecycle, from the first payment to full resolution. We make money when our clients' customers pay on time, not from the friction when they don't. Whether it's recurring payments, consumer invoicing, or enterprise billing, the principle is the same: one platform, designed to keep payments working and relationships growing.
 



  





 To strengthen our position as a leading European payment platform, we're looking for a Software Developer to join our team in Stockholm.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 This is an individual contributor role for someone who wants to own their impact and shape real outcomes. You'll join a cross-functional team made up of engineers, a product manager, and an engineering manager, working closely together to build and evolve the backend of our product.
 



  





 You'll be involved early, helping define solutions, not just implementing them.
 



 How we work is a big part of this role. Engineers here are trusted to take a problem, understand it deeply, and drive it forward. That means working closely with Product, shaping solutions together and caring about what happens after things go live.
 



  





 You'll spend most of your time building and evolving core parts of the product. A big part of the role is also working with what's already there. You'll improve existing solutions, deal with technical debt where it matters and make sure we can handle increasing scale and complexity as we grow. Some of what's already there is written in PHP, though Python is what you'll mainly be building with.
 



  





 AI is a core part of how we build software here, and we're looking for engineers who already work this way, with hands-on experience in AI coding tools and agentic development in real projects, not just interest in the idea. Because you own what you ship in a regulated payments codebase, we need strong judgment about where AI helps and where it doesn't, and people who review and understand generated code rather than taking it at face value. We also want people who raise the level around them, trying new tooling and helping the team grow with them.
 



  





**What we look for** 




 You don't need to check every box below. If most of this sounds like you, we'd like to hear from you.
 



  




* Strong experience in Python, which is what you'll be building with at Billogram. Coming from another language? Apply anyway if you're confident you can ramp fast.
* Experience building and running software in the cloud, ideally AWS
* Comfortable working closely with Product in defining problems and shaping solutions
* Taking ownership of features through to production, building systems that are reliable and maintainable, and following up on how they perform
* Ability to break down complex problems and make pragmatic trade-offs to move things forward
* Hands-on with AI development tools, including planning mode, building skills, custom agents, or orchestrating workflows



  





**Nice to have** 



* Experience working with payment systems or other financial services
* Experience building systems that operate at scale or across multiple markets
* Background in both B2B and B2C products
* Working with domain-driven design concepts



  





**What we offer** 




 At Billogram we promise you an exciting journey as we break into new markets and grow at a rapid pace. That aside you will get lots of freedom and opportunity to develop together with great colleagues at our office, right in the center of Stockholm. title: Staff Backend Engineer - Grafana Second Horizon | Sweden | Remote
description:
Grafana Labs is the company behind Grafana Cloud, the fully managed observability platform trusted by more than 10,000 organizations to ensure reliability, resolve incidents faster, and optimize telemetry at scale. Built on open source and open standards and designed for interoperability across any stack, Grafana Cloud brings AI to observability and observability to AI, giving teams (and their agents) unified visibility so they can see, understand, and act on all their disparate data, wherever it lives, and move at the speed of their ambitions. Customers, including Anthropic, Bloomberg, NVIDIA, Microsoft, and Salesforce, rely on Grafana Labs. We are a 100% remote company with team members across 40+ countries, backed by leading investors including Lightspeed Venture Partners, Sequoia Capital, GIC, Coatue, J.P. Morgan, CapitalG, and Lead Edge Capital. Learn more at grafana.com and follow us on LinkedIn and X.
   

  

 We’re scaling fast and staying true to what makes us different: an open-source legacy, a global collaborative culture, and a passion for meaningful work. Our team thrives in an innovation-driven environment where transparency, autonomy, and trust fuel everything we do.
   

  

 You may not meet every requirement, and that’s okay. If this role excites you, we’d love you to raise your hand for what could be a truly career-defining opportunity.
   

  

**This is a remote opportunity, and we would be interested in applicants located in Spain, Sweden, UK, Ireland or Germany.**
**The Opportunity**
 At Grafana Labs, we build observability tools that help users understand, respond to, and improve their systems – regardless of scale, complexity, or tech stack. We recently started a skunkworks initiative with a mission to bring observability to the rest of the business. Our goal is to make Grafana the single best place where humans and AI agents understand and act on real-time data from across the enterprise. As part of this initiative, we are building an AI-native data intelligence system that gives agents reliable, governed access to enterprise context. This system helps agents retrieve the right data, metadata, definitions, lineage, quality signals, and institutional knowledge without every agent builder having to maintain their own brittle context files. The principle is simple: the context system retrieves, agents decide, and data teams maintain the intelligence.
   

  

 The new team is a mix of seasoned Grafanistas and new hires. We operate with a high degree of autonomy and ownership, both as individuals and as a team. Engineers are empowered to make decisions, move quickly, and validate ideas early – while being supported by a deeply collaborative culture that values curiosity, feedback, and cross-functional partnership.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Staff-level Backend Engineer to help build the first production services for this context layer management system. You will design and ship the core backend architecture that powers ingestion, context storage, retrieval APIs, and agent-facing integrations. This is an early-stage role on a high-autonomy team, so you should be comfortable working through ambiguity, making pragmatic architectural decisions, and building systems that can evolve from internal dogfooding to production-grade SaaS. As the team matures, there’s a broad opportunity to expand or redefine this role based on impact and initiative.
   

  

**What You'll Be Doing**
* Build the core backend services: Design, implement, test, and operate the first services for context ingestion, context indexing, retrieval orchestration, API access, source configuration, and system administration.
* Create a scalable SaaS foundation: Help define and build the architecture for a multi-tenant service, including tenant isolation, usage tracking, quotas, audit logs, background jobs, and reliable service boundaries.
* Power agent-facing retrieval workflows: Build APIs and service interfaces that allow AI agents, MCP tools, CLIs, and internal applications to retrieve relevant context, provenance, confidence signals, and warnings.
* Work across product and infrastructure: Partner with the team to make practical tradeoffs between fast experimentation and long-term reliability, especially as the project moves from prototype to production.
* Operate what you build: Instrument services with metrics, logs, traces, alerts, and dashboards. Use observability tools to understand system behavior and improve reliability.
* Contribute to technical direction: Help shape the architecture, service boundaries, storage choices, API contracts, deployment patterns, and engineering practices for a new product area.
* Effective communication: You’ll be working in a highly dynamic and collaborative environment, so we need someone who can communicate effectively and contribute across teams.
* Ownership and impact: Take full ownership of the AI solutions you develop, ensuring they are not only innovative but also scalable, maintainable, and aligned with real user workflows.


**What Makes You a Great Fit**
* Strong engineering skills: Solid experience building production-grade, user-facing software systems. You’re a self-starter, capable of tackling complex engineering problems and making UI design decisions with minimal supervision.
* AI experience with a practical mindset: You’re familiar with AI technologies and frameworks, and you focus on delivering high-quality solutions that work in the real world, not just in theory.
* Quick iteration and experimentation: You’re comfortable releasing prototypes, collecting feedback, and iterating with a pragmatic mindset.
* Proven initiative: You take ownership and drive projects forward, pushing boundaries to find the most impactful solutions. You can deal with ambiguity and are able to define scope where things are loosely defined.
* Collaborative attitude: You communicate effectively with your peers. You’re open to feedback, and you bring a solutions-oriented mindset to the table.
* Experience with LLMs, prompt engineering, and building applications powered by GenAI.
* Proven track record of delivering software that made it into production and is actively used by users.
* Exposure to working in cloud-native environments (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure).
* Experience using observability tools to understand and troubleshoot system behavior.


**Bonus Points For**
* Experience building or working with agent frameworks or multi‑agent workflows.
* Experience as a data analyst or work with data platforms (e.g., Looker, Tableau, PowerBI, Snowflake, DataBricks)
* Experience building tools for data engineering.


**How We Work**
 We are a remote-first team that meets regularly over video and does most of our work asynchronously, in writing. We value creativity, diverse perspectives, and clear communication. Tempo is relied upon by prominent global organizations to monitor critical applications and infrastructure, and we expect everyone on the team, including our Staff engineers, to contribute ideas that make it a more reliable, more useful, and more loved product.
   

  

**Compensation & Rewards**
 In Sweden, the Base compensation range for this role is SEK 878,578 - SEK 1,054,294. Actual compensation may vary based on level, experience, and skillset as assessed in the interview process. Benefits include equity, bonus (if applicable) and other benefits listed here.
   

  

* Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process
* Compensation ranges are country specific. If you are applying for this role from a different location than listed above, your recruiter will discuss your specific market’s defined pay range & benefits at the beginning of the process.


**Why You’ll Thrive At Grafana Labs**
* 100% Remote, Global Culture - As a remote-only company, we bring together talent from around the world, united by a culture of collaboration and shared purpose.
* Scaling Organization – Tackle meaningful work in a high-growth, ever-evolving environment.
* Transparent Communication – Expect open decision-making and regular company-wide updates.
* Innovation-Driven – Autonomy and support to ship great work and try new things.
* Open Source Roots – Built on community-driven values that shape how we work.
* Empowered Teams – High trust, low ego culture that values outcomes over optics.
* Career Growth Pathways – Defined opportunities to grow and develop your career.
* Approachable Leadership – Transparent execs who are involved, visible, and human.
* Passionate People – Join a team of smart, supportive folks who care deeply about what they do.
* In-Person onboarding - We want you to thrive from day 1 with your fellow new ‘Grafanistas’ to learn all about what we do and how we do it.
* Balance is Key - We operate a global annual leave policy of 30 days per annum. 3 days of your annual leave entitlement are reserved for Grafana Shutdown Days to allow the team to really disconnect. \*We will comply with local legislation where applicable.


**Equal Opportunity Employer:** 
*Grafana Labs is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from everyone regardless of race, colour, nationality, origin, caste, sex, gender reassignment identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, religion or belief, disability, veteran status, genetic information, pregnancy, maternity, marital, family or carer status, or any other characteristic which is protected by local law. We believe that equality and diversity build a strong organisation, and we work hard to ensure that is the foundation of our organisation as we grow.*
*Grafana Labs may utilize AI tools in its recruitment process to assist in matching information provided in CVs to job postings. The recruitment team will continue to review inbound CVs manually to identify alignment with current openings.*
*For information about how your personal data is used once you’ve applied to a job, check out our privacy policy.*

title: Javautvecklare till Accenture Digital Core Stockholm
description:
Är du en erfaren Javautvecklare som vill arbeta i komplexa systemmiljöer och bidra till samhällsviktiga lösningar inom offentlig sektor? Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta i moderna utvecklingsprojekt tillsammans med några av Sveriges mest spännande kunder.

**Accenture Technology** 
 hjälper företag att förverkliga innovation och skapa hållbar tillväxt genom användarcentrerad och kreativ problemlösning, djup branschförståelse samt moderna lösningar inom digitalisering och säkerhet.Med vår breda kompetens, starka leveransförmåga och omfattande erfarenhet är vi en pålitlig partner för våra kunder.
   

  

 Tillsammans med våra kunniga och engagerade kollegor runt om i världen arbetar vi för att förena verksamheters behov med de möjligheter som den snabba teknologiska utvecklingen erbjuder.

 Som Javautvecklare på Accenture Technology arbetar du i våra kunduppdrag tillsammans med kollegor från Accenture. Uppdragen varierar och anpassas efter din erfarenhet och utvecklingsplan. Just nu har vi flera spännande projekt inom offentlig sektor där vi behöver bli fler.

 Våra uppdrag innebär ofta en hybrid arbetsmodell där viss närvaro hos kund förväntas. Resterande tid har du flexibilitet att arbeta hemifrån eller från vårt kontor.

 Vi söker en erfaren Javautvecklare som trivs i komplexa miljöer och tar ansvar för tekniska lösningar. Du brinner för smarta tekniska lösningar och hållbar systemdesign, och din erfarenhet är viktig i att bygga skalbara, säkra och robusta system som skapar verkligt värde för våra kunder.

title: ServiceNow Utvecklare
description:
*Vill du vara med och utveckla en modern ServiceNow-plattform som verkligen gör skillnad för verksamheten? Hos oss får du kombinera teknisk fördjupning med nära samarbete med beställare och användare i ett team som delar kunskap, stöttar varandra och vågar testa nytt. Här får du stort eget ansvar, möjlighet att påverka och utrymme att växa.*
**Om jobbet**
 I den här rollen blir du en central person i utvecklingen av vår ServiceNow-plattform. Du arbetar nära verksamheten för att omsätta behov till smarta, skalbara och säkra lösningar som stärker våra processer och stöttar affären. Du blir en del av ett framåtlutat och kompetent team bestående av utvecklare, business analyst, configuration manager, portal manager, produktägare och service portfolio manager – tillsammans driver ni plattformen framåt med fokus på stabilitet, användarvänlighet och ständig förbättring.
   

  

 Dina arbetsuppgifter kommer bland annat vara att:
   

  

* Ansvara för utveckling, anpassning och underhåll av ServiceNow-plattformen utifrån verksamhetens behov.
* Föra dialog med beställare och användare för att förstå behov, samla in krav och ta fram kravspecifikationer.
* Utveckla, konfigurera och implementera lösningar, applikationer, arbetsflöden och automatiseringar i ServiceNow.
* Ta fram underlag för prioritering av arbetsinsatser och löpande kommunicera status och progress till relevanta intressenter.
* Testa, verifiera och driftsätta nya lösningar så att de uppfyller krav och inte påverkar befintlig drift negativt.
* Felsöka, analysera och åtgärda incidenter och problem relaterade till plattformen för att säkerställa hög tillgänglighet.
* Implementera och underhålla integrationer mellan ServiceNow och andra system.
* Dokumentera förändringar, lösningar och processer på ett sätt som underlättar fortsatt utveckling och förvaltning.
* Säkerställa att utvecklingen följer interna riktlinjer, best practice och gällande säkerhetskrav.
* Bidra aktivt till kontinuerlig förbättring av både ServiceNow-plattformen och relaterade arbetsprocesser.


 Följande kommer göra dig framgångsrik i denna tjänst:
   

  

* Högskoleutbildning inom IT, datavetenskap eller liknande område, eller motsvarande arbetslivserfarenhet.
* Några års erfarenhet av utveckling och konfigurering i ServiceNow eller liknande ITSM-plattformar.
* God förståelse för ITSM-processer och ramverk, exempelvis Incident, Problem och Change Management.
* Erfarenhet av integrationer mellan ServiceNow och andra system via API:er (REST/SOAP).
* Kunskap om skriptning i JavaScript och utveckling av automatiserade arbetsflöden i ServiceNow.
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med arbetsflöden, automatiseringar och systemintegrationer.
* Vana vid att dokumentera tekniska lösningar och förändringar för framtida underhåll.


 Meriterande är även om du har:
   

  

* Certifiering inom ServiceNow, exempelvis ServiceNow Certified System Administrator.
* ServiceNow Certified Application Developer.
* ServiceNow Certified Implementation Specialist (t.ex. ITSM, HR, CMDB, Discovery eller andra moduler).
* ITIL Foundation (gärna v3 eller v4).
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta i agila utvecklingsmetoder (t.ex. Scrum, Kanban).
* Erfarenhet av användarvänlig gränssnittsdesign (UI/UX) inom ServiceNow.
* Förmåga att analysera och optimera befintliga processer.
* Förståelse för informationssäkerhet och datahantering.
* Certifieringar inom relaterade områden, t.ex. integrationer, automatisering eller molnteknologier (Microsoft Azure, AWS eller Google Cloud).
* Tidigare erfarenhet av roller med kravhantering, teknisk problemlösning och nära samarbete med beställare/användare.


 Som person är du analytisk, nyfiken och trivs med att lösa komplexa problem på ett strukturerat och noggrant sätt. Du är kommunikativ och samarbetar gärna med både tekniska och icke-tekniska kollegor, samtidigt som du är självständig och tar ansvar för att driva ditt arbete framåt. Du har ett starkt servicefokus och god förståelse för användarnas behov, är flexibel och anpassningsbar när förutsättningar förändras och motiveras av att leverera resultat med hög kvalitet. Hos oss kommer du att trivas om du uppskattar självledarskap, gillar att lära dig nytt och vill utveckla din fulla potential i ett team där alla stöttar varandras utveckling.
   

  

**Kontaktpersoner**
 Rekryterande chef: Farhad.Tabari@lansforsakringar.se
   

  

 Facklig representant Forena: Jessica.loow@lansforsakringar.se
   

  

 Facklig representant Akademikerföreningen: Lisa-Maria.Carensjo@lansforsakringar.se
   

  

*Låter det spännande? Då vill vi veta mer om dig! Välkommen med din ansökan redan idag. Vi arbetar löpande med denna rekrytering och kan komma att tillsätta tjänsten innan sista ansökningsdag.*
**Observera att rekryteringsprocessen pågår under sommaren. På grund av semesterperioden kan återkoppling och handläggningstider vara något längre än vanligt. Vi tackar för ditt tålamod och ser fram emot din ansökan.**
 Länsförsäkringar AB är en inkluderande arbetsplats där mod, möjligheter och engagemang står i centrum. Vi erbjuder ett hållbart arbetsliv med flexibla villkor och satsar på att alla medarbetare ska kunna växa och trivas, oavsett bakgrund.
   

  

 Digital & IT är hjärtat i Länsförsäkringsgruppens digitala utveckling. Vi driver den gemensamma digitala transformationen och levererar förstklassiga IT-lösningar, datadrivna insikter och innovativa digitala tjänster som skapar värde för hela verksamheten. Vårt uppdrag är att bygga en robust och framtidssäker IT-miljö – både på plats och i molnet – som möjliggör kundnära och effektiva affärer i hela gruppen.
   

  

 Hos oss möts teknik, affär och innovation. Vi arbetar tvärfunktionellt ute i verksamheten i agila team där utveckling, drift och strategi går hand i hand. Vi ansvarar för allt från IT-styrning, enterprisearkitektur och leverantörshantering till applikationsutveckling, cybersäkerhet och verksamhetsberedskap.

title: Staff Engineer | Consumer Domain
description:
**We're building tomorrow's delivery platform**
 At Instabee, we're on a mission to become the undisputed #1 delivery service in the eyes of our consumers. We need exceptional engineers to help us get there.
   

  

 We're looking for a Staff Engineer who can bridge the gap between ambitious business goals and technical execution. Someone who identifies opportunities, builds the right solutions, and raises the bar for everyone around them.
   

  

 The role
   

  

 You will be embedded in one of our Consumer teams, the part of Instabee that sits closest to real users and real deliveries. This is a hands-on role where you will spend most of your time building, not reviewing architectural slide decks. Your job is ensuring we're building the right things, in the right way, at the right scale.
   

  

 Aside from the work within the team, you will be part of a community of Staff Engineers working on cross-organisation projects and challenges.
   

  

 You'll help translate business ambition into engineering execution, surface hard problems before they become expensive ones, and actively drive the engineering culture at Instabee by raising the bar, sharing knowledge, and making the organisation better at building software.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

**Ship things users notice** 
 Identify and build features that move the needle on user satisfaction. You'll own problems from idea to production, together with your team.
   

  

**Keep the team unblocked** 
 Spot friction before it becomes a bottleneck. That might mean improving test setup, fixing a flaky deploy pipeline, or untangling a service boundary that's slowing everyone down.
   

  

**Make technical trade-offs explicit** 
 Help the team choose solutions that are good enough now and don't paint us into a corner later. Scale and velocity both matter, and your job is to hold both at once.
   

  

**Connect code to outcomes** 
 Help engineers understand why what they're building matters. Work with Product and Data to make sure our systems produce the signals we need to make good decisions.
   

  

**Raise the bar around you** 
 Coach engineers, share what you know, and push for a culture where we learn from mistakes instead of hiding them.
   

  

 What we're looking for
   

  

 You don't need to be an expert in everything your team touches, but you should care deeply about succeeding together as a team.
   

  

**You're a doer.** 
 You don't just think about problems; you solve them.
   

  

**You're a technical leader** 
 who has built web and app (ideally consumer facing) solutions at scale, and can move fluidly between deep technical dives and high-level architectural trade-offs.
   

  

**You're strategic and pragmatic.** 
 You know that perfect is the enemy of good. You favor iteration, deliver value early and often, and ship before you have the ideal solution.
   

  

**You're a communicator and collaborator.** 
 You make complex technical concepts accessible to non-technical partners and thrive in cross-functional environments where engineering, product, and business move together.
   

  

**You're a quality advocate** 
 who holds a high bar for stability and security, without killing the pace of innovation.
   

  

 If this sounds like the kind of challenge you'd wake up excited to tackle, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

 What You'll Get
   

  

 We can promise you'll be challenged, develop your skills, and work with truly amazing and competent colleagues. If you like change and want to set new processes and ways of working — this is the place for you.
   

  

 Of course, we have all the standard benefits in place. But beyond that, we also offer:
   

  

**🌇 Sky-High Office —** 
 Modern and newly renovated with 360-degree views across Stockholm
   

  

**🐶 Puppy Friendly —** 
 Bring your dog to work (we've got a whole floor for our furry friends)
   

  

**🏓 Fun & Games —** 
 Ping pong, shuffleboard, foosball, and a karaoke room
   

  

**👶 Six Months Parental Pay —** 
 Step away and give your little one the care they deserve
   

  

**🎂 Your Birthday Off —** 
 Celebrate yourself with a day off each year
   

  

**⏰ Hybrid & Flexible —** 
 Work the way that works for you
   

  

 Our Commitment to You
   

  

 Diversity and inclusion are at the heart of who we are. We're committed to creating an inclusive work environment where everyone's perspectives are valued and every employee has the opportunity to thrive and reach their full potential.
   

  

 Next Steps
   

  

*This role requires a background check via Svensk Bakgrundsanalys, which includes a review of public criminal records. The results are handled confidentially as part of our standard recruitment process in Sweden.*
 Ready to join us? We'd love to hear how you think about technical leadership and what excites you about solving logistics at scale.
   

  

 Instabee Group, with consumer-facing brands Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy, brings together years of experience in delivery. Today, Instabee Group is present in five markets, serving thousands of online merchants and millions of consumers with seamless home deliveries and convenient parcel locker deliveries, using the best fuel available. With smart technology, a strong focus on sustainability, and a secure supply chain, Instabee has become a trusted partner for online merchants and a preferred choice for consumers.

title: Senior Backend Developer – Omni Core Platform
description:
**Om Omni**
 Omni har funnits på den svenska mediemarknaden sedan november 2013 och är ett självständigt bolag inom Schibsted. Vi är Sveriges femte största nyhetstjänst med runt 800 000 unika läsare och har flera gånger utsetts till Sveriges bästa nyhetstjänst. Vår huvudplattform är mobilen, men vi har också många läsare på desktop och surfplatta.
   

  

 Varje dag använder hundratusentals människor Omni för att förstå vad som händer i världen. Bakom upplevelsen finns en teknisk plattform som måste vara snabb, stabil och skalbar – dygnet runt.
   

  

 Hos oss arbetar Tech, redaktion och produkt nära varandra. AI och agentiska kodverktyg är en naturlig del av hur vi utvecklar, testar och levererar mjukvara. Nu söker vi en senior backendutvecklare som vill vara med och vidareutveckla Omnis kärnplattform.
   

  

**Rollen**
 Du blir en del av vårt ordinarie utvecklingsteam på tio personer och får en central roll i att utveckla systemen bakom en av Sveriges starkaste nyhetstjänster. Du bygger backendtjänster, API:er och integrationer, utvecklar arkitekturen och ser till att våra system fungerar stabilt i produktion.
   

  

 Du har ett arkitektperspektiv, vågar utmana hur vi gör saker idag och är lika hemma i koden som i pipelinen som tar den till produktion. DevOps är inte någon annans problem för dig – det är en naturlig del av hur du bygger.
   

  

*Det här är en projektanställning på 12 månader med goda möjligheter till förlängning.*
**Vad du gör**
* Designar och bygger skalbara backendtjänster, API:er och integrationer som driver en av Sveriges starkaste nyhetsprodukter.
* Sätter teknisk riktning och arkitektur i din domän, och utmanar status quo när det behövs.
* Äger dina tjänster i drift: bygger, deployar och håller dem stabila i produktion.
* Jobbar med vårt event-drivna flöde: ingestion, parsning, köer och pipelines.
* Förbättrar hur vi levererar kod, från CI/CD och containrar till observability.
* Granskar kod, delar kunskap och höjer ribban i teamet.


**Vår stack**
 Du behöver inte ha allt från dag ett, men det här är vad du jobbar med:
   

  

* Backend: Node.js med TypeScript, Hono och Express, tRPC, Zod, Drizzle
* Data: PostgreSQL, Redis
* Event/integration: AWS SQS/SNS, S3
* Infra & drift: AWS (EKS, RDS, S3, SQS/SNS), Kubernetes, Terraform, ArgoCD, Helm
* Leverans: GitHub Actions, Docker, GitOps, Grafana för observability
* Arbetssätt: pnpm/Turborepo-monorepos, Biome, Vitest, Playwright, MSW


 Frontend i React och Next.js finns nära, och det är ett plus om du kan röra dig dit när det behövs, men tyngdpunkten i rollen är backend och drift.
   

  

 Vi använder agentiska kodverktyg som Claude Code och Codex i det dagliga utvecklingsarbetet. Du behöver inte vara expert från start, men du är nyfiken på hur AI kan göra utveckling snabbare och bättre – och vill fortsätta utvecklas tillsammans med oss.
   

  

**Vi tror att du**
* Har gedigen backenderfarenhet inom arkitektur, API:er och integrationer, och har levererat produktionsdugliga system.
* Är stark på DevOps: CI/CD, containrar, Kubernetes och infrastruktur som kod.
* Har ett arkitektperspektiv och gillar att sätta teknisk riktning och förbättra plattformar över tid.
* Är prestigelös och pragmatisk, bryr dig mer om att lösa problemet än om att få cred.
* Är nyfiken på AI och moderna utvecklingsverktyg.
* Delar gärna med dig och lyfter teamet genom code reviews och kunskapsdelning.
* Kommunicerar tydligt på svenska och engelska.


 Det är ett plus om du också är bekväm i frontend, men det är backend och drift vi söker.
   

  

**Hur vi jobbar**
 Som en del av vårt kompakta och snabbrörliga team får du en miljö där varje röst väger tungt. Vi lever efter en prestigelös och pragmatisk kultur som vilar på genuint samarbete. Genom kontinuerliga code reviews främjar vi både kvalitetssäkring och aktiv kunskapsspridning. Vi prioriterar robusta och okomplicerade lösningar, samtidigt som vi drivs av en passion för att utforska nya tekniker som kan lyfta vår produkt ytterligare.
   

  

 Vi har en hybrid arbetsmiljö med kontor i Stockholm där majoriteten av teamet sitter, och kollegor i Oslo och Gdansk. Vi är flexibla kring distans kontra kontor, och du kan räkna med en sund balans mellan jobb och fritid.

title: Staff / Principal Software Engineer, Detection and Response
description:
**TL;DR** 
 You'll build the detection and response capability that catches attackers before they matter - across Lovable's corporate, production, and AI-agent surfaces.
   

  

**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
* 8+ years in detection engineering, incident response, or threat hunting, with at least 3 at staff/principal level.
* Strong engineering background - you build detections as code, not as saved searches in a SIEM.
* Deep experience with cloud telemetry (GCP/AWS/Cloudflare), endpoint EDR, identity logs, and modern SIEM/data-lake stacks (Panther, Elastic, Snowflake/Clickhouse).
* Battle-tested incident commander who has led real high-severity incidents from first alert to public post-mortem.
* Adversary-minded: comfortable with MITRE ATT&CK, threat intel, purple-teaming, and red team collaboration.
* Bonus: detection for LLM/agent abuse, prompt injection at scale, or insider risk in AI-augmented engineering orgs.


**What You'll Do**
* Build the detection engineering platform - pipelines, detections-as-code, automated triage, and response playbooks.
* Design and own security incident response process with 24/7 coverage, with a small, high-leverage human and agent team.
* Lead incidents end-to-end: detection, containment, eradication, post-mortem, and follow-through.
* Hunt proactively across corporate, production, and AI-agent surfaces - and turn every finding into a durable detection.
* Define what 'world-class D&R for an AI-native company' looks like, and build it.


**Our tech stack**
* Frontend: React and Typescript.
* Backend: Golang and Rust.
* Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, multiple LLM providers.
* DevOps & Tooling: GitHub Actions, Grafana, OTEL, infra-as-code (Terraform).
* Data: Clickhouse, Firestore, Spanner, BigQuery.


 And we’re always exploring what’s next!
   

  

**About Your Application**
 Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.
   

  

 We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description:
På Sogeti tror vi att det bästa finns inom var och en av oss. Genom vår gemensamma passion för teknologi, AI-drivna ansats, start-up-kultur och fokus på kontinuerligt lärande, ger vi dig förutsättningarna att nå din fulla potential och skapa värde för våra kunder. Med en stark drivkraft för kvalitet och agilitet stöttar vi dig genom hela din karriär så att du kan göra allt större avtryck och bli den bästa versionen av dig själv.
   

  

**Om rollen**
 Som ML Engineer hos Sogeti blir du en del av vårt lokala team inom Data & AI. I rollen arbetar du med att utveckla, produktionssätta och vidareutveckla AI- och machine learning-lösningar i moderna molnplattformar som Azure eller AWS.
   

  

 Du hjälper våra kunder att gå från idé, data och experiment till robusta lösningar som skapar verkligt affärsvärde. Rollen kan omfatta allt från modellutveckling och MLOps till generativ AI, RAG-lösningar, AI-agenter och integration av AI-funktionalitet i befintliga system.
   

  

*I den här rollen kommer du att ha en nyckelroll i:*
* Utveckling, träning, utvärdering och optimering av machine learning-modeller.
* Produktionssättning av AI- och ML-lösningar som API:er, batchflöden eller integrerade delar av kundens system.
* Arbete med MLOps, modellversionering, deployment, monitorering och retraining.
* Utveckling av data- och feature pipelines tillsammans med Data Engineers.
* Användning av teknologier som Python, Azure Machine Learning, Databricks, MLflow, Docker, CI/CD och moderna molnplattformar.
* Utforskande av generativ AI, LLM:er, RAG, embeddings, vektordatabaser och AI-agenter.


**Din profil**
* Flerårig erfarenhet av Python-programmering och machine learning.
* Erfarenhet av modellutveckling, modellutvärdering, feature engineering och produktionssättning av ML- eller AI-lösningar.
* God förståelse för MLOps och modellens livscykel från träning till produktion.
* Erfarenhet av Git, CI/CD, Docker, SQL och moderna utvecklingsflöden.
* Erfarenhet av molnbaserade AI-, ML- eller datalösningar i Azure och/eller AWS.
* Förmåga att samarbeta med Data Scientists, Data Engineers, utvecklare, arkitekter och verksamhet.
* Flytande svenska i tal och skrift samt god professionell kunskap i engelska.


**Vad vi tror kommer få dig att trivas** 
 .
   

  

* En kultur som präglas av närhet, samarbete och ett genuint kunskapsutbyte mellan kollegor
* Möjlighet att utvecklas inom data, AI och moderna dataplattformar – i uppdrag och genom tillgång till både lokala och globala kompetensnätverk
* Ett team där du får arbeta nära andra specialister inom data, analys och AI, i uppdrag som gör verklig skillnad för kund och samhälle


**Ansökan**
*Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess kommer identitetskontroll att genomföras genom granskning av ditt ID-kort, och bakgrundskontroller kan utföras vid behov. Just nu har vi semesterperiod och hoppas att även du njuter av en fin sommar. Vi ser framemot att läsa igenom din ansökan när vi är tillbaka från semester och förväntar oss att kunna återkoppla dig i augusti när vi är åter! Stort tack för ditt tålamod!*
**Om Sogeti**
 Sogeti Sverige, en del av Capgemini Group, med 19 kontor och 1200 medarbetare, gör teknologi enkelt och värdeskapande. Vi är specialiserade på AI-drivna lösningar inom quality engineering & testing, data och cloud och förvandlar snabbt idéer till handling. Sogeti levererar konkreta resultat, hjälper organisationer att innovera med självförtroende och skapar värde från dag ett. Vi är agila, snabbrörliga och drar nytta av starka partnerskap. Våra lokala team arbetar sida vid sida med våra kunder och bygger nära relationer genom att förstå deras verklighet. Tillsammans med Capgemini-koncernens globala styrka och branschexpertis skapar vi skalbara resultat.
   

  

***Right here. Right now.***
 | www.sogeti.se

title: Var med och forma framtidens teknik på Saab!
description:
*Vill du påverka och göra skillnad på riktigt? Här bidrar du till att skapa trygghet för människor och samhällen. Det du gör spelar roll.*
 Tekniken utvecklas snabbare än någonsin. AI förändrar hur vi arbetar, data skapar nya möjligheter och mjukvara blir alltmer avgörande för framtidens produkter och system. På Saab är du inte bara med och följer utvecklingen, du är en del av den.
   

  

 Vi befinner oss på en transformativ tillväxtresa med stora satsningar inom AI, Data, R&D och Software Factory. Här utvecklar vi teknik som stärker samhällen, ökar säkerheten och gör skillnad på riktigt. Nu vill vi komma i kontakt med dig som vill vara med och forma framtidens lösningar tillsammans med oss.
   

  

***Din roll***
 Bredden på tekniken inom Saab är unik. Här kan du vara med och utveckla allt från mjukvara, data- och AI-lösningar till komplexa system som möjliggör kommunikation, informationsdelning, beslutsfattande, situationsuppfattning och operativ förmåga i kritiska miljöer.
   

  

 Det innebär möjligheten att arbeta i teknikens framkant, nära några av branschens främsta specialister, och bidra till lösningar som möter verkliga utmaningar i luften, på marken, till sjöss och under vattenytan.
   

  

***Din profil***
 Vi söker särskilt dig med erfarenhet inom:
   

  

* Data & AI
* Mjukvaruutveckling
* Systemingenjörsarbete
* Teknisk ledning av komplexa system och mjukvarulösningar


 Vi tror att du har erfarenhet inom något av våra fokusområden och drivs av att lösa komplexa problem tillsammans med andra. Du är nyfiken på ny teknik, vill fortsätta utvecklas och trivs i en miljö där kunskapsdelning, samarbete och ständig förbättring är en naturlig del av vardagen.
   

  

*Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap.*
***Vad du blir en del av***
 Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas.
   

  

 Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med uppdrag att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidrar till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 26,100 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld.
   

  

 Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här.
   

  

**Välkommen till Saab. Där innovation möter mening, och där framtidens teknik byggs varje dag.**

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**Techster Solutions** 
 befinner i dagsläget sig i en spännande tillväxtfas och söker nu fler kollegor, inledningsvis dig med minst
 **3+** 
 års erfarenhet och som kan stärka teamet.
   

  

 Du kan förvänta dig en omväxlande miljö, dagarna kan se väldigt olika ut - men en sak är säkert, här får du använda dina kompetenser och sätter själv gränsen för hur mycket du vill utvecklas. Som ett kunskapsbolag är det viktigt för oss att våra specialister delar med sig av sin kompetens och får kollegorna att växa.
   

  

**Rollbeskrivning** 
 :
   

  

 Vi söker nu en senior Data Engineer.
   

  

 Uppdragsbeskrivning:
   

  

 Kund söker en driven och framåtsträvande senior data engineer till Digitaliseringsenheten. Enheten ingår i avdelningen för verksamhetsstöd och ansvarar för verksamhetsnära digitala lösningar som stöder myndighetens kärnverksamhet.
   

  

 Digitaliseringsenheten arbetar agilt i fyra utvecklingsteam och präglas av innovation, nytänkande och höga ambitioner.
   

  

 Som senior data engineer blir du en nyckelperson i utvecklingen och förvaltningen av vårt datalager och våra BI-lösningar. Du kommer att driva tekniska beslut, optimera dataprocesser och säkerställa robusta, långsiktiga lösningar som skapar värde för verksamheten samt analysera och lösa komplexa problem på djupet.
   

  

 Placering: kunds kontor i Stockholm men med möjlighet till visst distansarbete.
   

  

**Arbetsuppgifter**
* Designa, utveckla och underhålla datalager, ETL-flöden och SSAS-kuber för rapportering och analys.
* Bygga datamodeller i SSAS som möjliggör effektiva och användarvänliga Power BI-lösningar.
* Felsöka, analysera och lösa komplexa problem i datalager och dataprocesser, från rotorsak till färdig lösning.
* Driva tekniska beslut kring arkitektur, datamodellering, datakvalitet och optimering av kuber.
* Samarbeta nära verksamheten för att förstå behov och omvandla dem till datadrivna beslutsstöd.
* Coachning och mentorskap av kollegor i teamet, inklusive standardisering av kod och processer.
* Bidra till en insiktsdriven myndighet genom att identifiera förbättringsmöjligheter och föreslå nya lösningar.


 Krav
   

  

 Skallkrav:
   

  

* Relevant högskoleutbildning inom systemvetenskap, datavetenskap eller annan teknisk utbildning som bedöms relevant.
* Minst 3–5 års erfarenhet som data engineer med fokus på datalager, ETL, BI-lösningar eller motsvarande.
* Mycket goda kunskaper i SSAS (SQL Server Analysis Services) och erfarenhet av att bygga kuber, datamodeller och measures för analys och rapportering.
* Mycket goda kunskaper i SQL och erfarenhet av att skriva och optimera komplexa queries.
* Erfarenhet av Microsoft SQL Server on-prem, inklusive Management Studio och databasadministration på utvecklingsnivå.
* God förståelse för datamodellering och databasdesign (t.ex. 3NF och Kimball).
* Vana vid Git och versionshantering, samt dokumentation av kod och dataprocesser.
* Mycket god förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska.
* Utvärdering av de personliga egenskaperna kommer att ske vid en eventuell intervju


 Börkrav:
   

  

* Erfarenhet av att arbeta i agila team och nära kärnverksamheten.
* Erfarenhet av att driva förbättringar inom datakvalitet, datastyrning och best practices.


**Ansökan**
 Tror du att du är
 **Techster Solutions** 
 nästa stjärna? Tveka då inte att skicka in din ansökan redan nu. Urval sker löpande och tillträde sker enligt överenskommelse.
   

  

 Arbetsplats och kultur
   

  

 Vi är ett entreprenördrivet IT företag, med både produktkunskap och försäljning (Techster AB) och konsultativa tjänster (Techster Solutions AB). Det innebär att vi är mycket öppna för nya tekniska lösningar, kunskapsutbyte och ständigt lärande. Att ha roligt och samtidigt behålla den familjära andan utan hierarkier är lika viktigt.
   

  

 Vi vill skapa det konsultbolag som du alltid velat jobba för, men kanske inte hittat ännu. Redan idag har vi en blandning av seniora och yngre medarbetare, såväl som män och kvinnor. Det vill vi fortsätta att bygga på. Så välkommen med din ansökan!

title: Data Engineer
description:
*Norrin is an AI integrator, enabling end-to-end Enterprise AI and data solutions that turn ambition into production and drive real productivity gains. Norrin has strong roots in Finland while operating internationally across the Nordics, the United States, and APAC. Our presence across the Nordics has continued strengthening with BizOne recently joining the Norrin Group.*
 We’re looking for a
 **Data Engineer** 
 to join our growing team in Stockholm. You might be a data enthusiast with a couple of years under your belt or already a more seasoned professional. What matters most to us is your willingness to keep learning, take ownership, and work on solutions that create clear business value.
   

  

 In this role, you will work on a variety of cloud-based customer projects, designing and building modern data platforms and analytics solutions using Azure Data Platform services, Databricks, and AI-enabled tools. Your work may include data modelling, integrations, and architectural design, always in close collaboration with customers and internal experts. You will also be part of Norrin’s Data Engineering Guild, a community where knowledge is shared, skills are developed together, and people actively support each other’s growth.
   

  

**What We’re Looking For**
* 2-5 years of experience as a Data Engineer or in analytics solution development
* Experience building Databricks and/or Fabric-based solutions in an Azure environment
* Understanding of data warehousing, data modelling, and integrations
* Good collaboration skills and a customer-oriented mindset
* Curiosity and initiative to keep learning new things and stay up to date
* Ability to communicate technical solutions clearly, also to non-technical stakeholders
* Fluency in Swedish and English
* Strong skills in SQL and Python/PySpark
* Experience building data pipelines using Databricks, dbt, Microsoft Fabric or similar
* Solid understanding of data security and privacy principles
* Experience with dimensional modelling
* Knowledge of DevOps and CI/CD principles


**Nice to have**
* Experience with Power BI and automated reporting
* Experience with GenAI or machine learning, including MLOps
* Understanding and/or experience with cloud data warehouses such as Snowflake


**Why Norrin?**
 At Norrin, you'll join an
 **international team** 
 of 220 professionals working across Finland, Sweden, Thailand, Vietnam, and the United States. We work with nordic enterprises that have the ambition to be the forerunners in data and AI across a wide range of industries, from industrial and finance to retail and energy. The
 **diversity of projects, technologies, and business challenges** 
 keeps the work both meaningful and engaging. We never work alone but always together with clients and our colleagues.
   

  

 We invest in
 **continuous learning** 
 through training and certification opportunities, as well as our guild communities where knowledge is shared and built together. As a Microsoft and Databricks partner, we work with leading technologies and support you in continuously expanding your expertise. At Norrin, you'll have the opportunity to grow in a direction that matters to you. We believe that great work starts with a supportive environment. That's why we foster
 **a culture built on openness, equality, and mutual respect** 
 , with psychological safety at its core
 **.** 
 We're committed to promoting diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities in the tech industry.
   

  

 Our
 **hybrid working model** 
 combines flexibility with collaboration, giving you the freedom to work remotely while bringing people together when it creates the most value. To support your well-being, we also offer
 **wellbeing benefits** 
 like insurance coverage and an annual wellness allowance. Depending on the role, our
 **competitive compensation model**

title: Data Engineer
description:
*Vill du vara med och forma en ny datasatsning från ett tidigt skede?* 

*BDO söker en Data Engineer som vill bygga vidare på vår nya plattform i Microsoft Fabric, integrera fler datakällor och bygga stabila dataflöden för hela verksamheten.* 




  





**Om oss** 




 BDO är en av världens ledande revisions- och rådgivningsorganisationer, med cirka 700 medarbetare på 15 kontor i Sverige. Vi har utsetts till Sveriges mest attraktiva arbetsgivare flera år i rad av Karriärföretagen, och vår kultur bygger på People helping people – med samarbete, ansvar och kompetens i centrum.
 



  





**Om rollen** 




 Du blir en del av BDO:s nya dataplattformssatsning i Microsoft Fabric, med målet att centralisera och kvalitetssäkra kritisk företagsgemensam data för analys, uppföljning och datadrivna beslut i hela verksamheten.
 



  





 Ditt huvudsakliga fokus är backend: att integrera nya datakällor och bygga stabila, kvalitetssäkrade dataflöden genom plattformen. Du ingår i ett mindre dataplattformsteam och arbetar nära både tekniska kollegor och verksamheten. På sikt finns möjlighet att växa mot ett större ansvar för dataplattformen eller en mer arkitekturell roll.
 



  





**Dina ansvarsområden** 



* Utveckla, underhålla och optimera datapipelines, integrationsflöden och Lakehouse/Warehouse-lösningar i Fabric
* Integrera nya datakällor samt modellera och kvalitetssäkra data
* Stötta verksamhetens analysbehov, med visst inslag av Power BI
* Bidra till struktur, dokumentation och arbetssätt för hur plattformen byggs ut och förvaltas



  





**Om dig** 



* Några års erfarenhet av Data Engineering eller dataplattformsutveckling
* Stark grund i SQL, datamodellering och ETL/ELT-processer
* Eget driv och förmåga att ta ansvar för dina leveranser
* Kommunikativ och pedagogisk, med förmåga att förstå verksamhetens behov och omsätta dem i tekniska lösningar
* Talar och skriver svenska obehindrat



  





 Meriterande är erfarenhet av Power BI, Azure, DevOps eller agila arbetssätt samt ett intresse för hur AI kan skapa affärsnytta med hjälp av data.
 



  





**Vi erbjuder** 




 Här kommer du in i en långsiktig datasatsning där grunden finns på plats, men mycket fortfarande ska byggas och utvecklas. Du får goda möjligheter till kompetensutveckling, bra arbetsvillkor samt ett hybridupplägg som ger flexibilitet i vardagen.
 



  





 Hos oss får du en inkluderande och prestigelös kultur, med moderna lokaler på Sveavägen i centrala Stockholm.

title: Data Engineer
description:
At Fortum, data plays a central role in how we understand our customers, develop digital solutions, and support the transition to a cleaner energy future.
   

  

**About The Role**
 Here you will design, build, and continuously improve data engineering solutions that enable reliable analytics, faster insight generation, and data‑driven decision‑making across the business.
   

  

 In this role, your task will include but not be limited to:
   

  

* Provide contribution to the design, deployment, and maintenance of enterprise‑scale data platforms
* Together with the team design, implement, and support key datasets that provide structured and timely access to actionable insights in various topics, such strategic and operational KPIs, competence, quality and training data, consumption and revenue margin, customer interactions, digital engagement, customer feedback, and much more.
* Monitor existing metrics and data quality, analyze data, and lead improvements together with stakeholder teams.
* Orchestrate multi-task data workflows with parameterized, multi-brand execution and conditional logic for country-specific processing.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of data platforms through well‑researched and practical solutions.
* Collaborate with business units, analysts, other data engineering teams and source system teams to translate business needs into reliable, well-documented data models.


**About You**
 You’re a data engineering professional with a passion for building excellent analytical data solutions to facilitate data-driven decision-making. Since our team is committed to pursuing innovation and improvements through increased use of data. United by our passion for technology, curiosity about user experience, and dedication to excellence, we are looking for someone who shares our enthusiasm.
   

  

 To excel in this role, you are expected to have:
   

  

* Excellent communication and collaboration skills with stakeholders.
* Bachelor's or higher degree in computer science or another relevant field.
* Hands-on data engineering experience with Databricks (PySpark, Spark SQL, Delta Lake, Unity Catalog) and Azure or similar platforms.
* Experience building analytical data models based on the needs of stakeholders, and your own innovations and insights.
* Interest in utilizing AI agents and tools to accelerate development work.
* Good knowledge of Git version control and CI/CD for data pipelines.
* Good language skills, being able to express yourself verbally in English is a must, other Nordic language is considered a great asset.
* Proactive and independent problem-solver attitude with willingness to learn and share knowledge to others.


 We are excited to hire individuals who are as passionate about data engineering as we are and be eager to contribute to our innovative team. If you share this enthusiasm, we would love to hear from you!
   

  

 We offer a hybrid work model to support your productivity; you are expected to be at the office two to three times a week.
   

  

 The position can be located in our offices in Solna, Stockholm or Espoo, Helsinki.
   

  

**We offer you**
 At Fortum, we believe in a better future and want to be involved in shaping it. Our workplace is a safe place, both physically and mentally. You will grow with professional colleagues, being trusted and free to challenge yourself. We offer comprehensive benefits, flexible working hours, and hybrid work model to support your productivity, development and wellbeing. We are committed to build diverse teams where everyone feels included and is treated equally
   

  

 More information about our culture and benefits can be found here.
   

  

 Espoo office is a smoke-free workplace.
   

  

 For permanent employment with Fortum Sverige AB, you may be assigned a wartime posting within the organization. For further information regarding wartime posting, please refer to the Swedish Civil Defence and Resilience Agency.
   

  

**Interested?**
 Submit your application via our recruitment tool at the latest on 20th of September 2026. We may start contacting suitable candidates already during the application period, the position can be closed before last application date, please apply today! If you have questions and would like to hear more about the position, please contact recruiting manager Esben Fog at esben.fog@fortum.com
   

  

 Contact details to union representatives can be found on the bottom of this page.
   

  

 To be selected for the position, the applicant must go through background clearance and a health examination which may include a drug test.
   

  

**We are Fortum**
 Fortum is a Nordic energy company. We generate and deliver reliable energy to our customers and the Nordic energy system while at the same time helping industries decarbonise their processes and grow. Our core operations comprise efficient and best-in-class low-carbon power generation, customer services, and heating and cooling. Fortum’s power generation is already 99% from renewable or nuclear sources with one of the lowest specific CO2-emissions in Europe. We are guided by our ambitious SBTi-validated emission reduction targets on our way towards net-zero by 2040. For our :4,500 employees, we commit to be a safe and inspiring workplace. Fortum's share is listed on Nasdaq Helsinki. fortum.com
