title: Senior iOS Developer
description:
**What will you do?** 




 As a Senior iOS Engineer at Rebtel, you will be part of our Frontend team, helping modernize and evolve the Rebtel iOS app. The iOS team is two engineers, and you'd be the third. We're moving off legacy Objective-C toward a modern Swift, SwiftUI, and Combine stack, and shifting the architecture from VIPER to MVVM-C, all while continuously shipping product features to a global user base. You'll work in a small, empowered team where your technical decisions matter. This role is a mix of building new features, refactoring legacy code, collaborating cross-functionally, and shaping the future of our iOS platform.
 



  





**Areas Of Ownership** 



* Drive the modernization from legacy Objective-C to a modern Swift + SwiftUI stack
* Refactor code that slows us down and proactively pay down tech debt
* Build and modernize iOS features using Swift, SwiftUI, and Combine
* Contribute to architecture decisions (VIPER to MVVM-C transition, Combine, platform improvements)
* Collaborate closely with Android, Web, Product, Design to ship the right solutions
* Ship to the App Store and monitor what happens after release
* Improve tooling, testing practices, and CI/CD where needed
* Maintain and improve the overall health of the iOS platform



**Requirements** 



* 5+ years building iOS apps
* Proficient in Swift, SwiftUI, and Combine
* Comfortable maintaining and modernizing legacy Objective-C
* Solid grasp of iOS architecture patterns (MVVM-C, VIPER)
* Shipped production iOS apps to the App Store, including post-release monitoring
* Experience with REST and/or GraphQL, with solid error handling and async patterns
* Can work independently and ship without constant oversight
* Write unit tests, cover edge cases, and give code reviews that favor simple solutions
* Work effectively with AI coding tools



  





**Why Rebtel?** 




 Rebtel has been connecting people across borders for nearly 20 years. Today, we're profitable, growing, and at a pivotal moment in our journey. We make it cheap and easy for migrants to call and send money home. Millions of people move countries every year, and staying connected with family shouldn't cost a fortune. That's the problem we work on, from a small, international team based in Stockholm where speed and ownership matter more than process.
 



**Benefits** 



* Pension Plan
* Health Checkups, Influenza shots, and Private Medical Insurance
* Dental Insurance
* Occupational insurance
* Wellness allowance (5,000 SEK)
* Discount on gym memberships
* Bonus program
* Extra parental pay
* 30 days annual vacation
* Monday breakfasts
* Relocation Support



*We are Rebtel. We come from all around the world to create products for anyone who has crossed a border. We believe in equal opportunity and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.*

The work is backend-weighted and that's where you'll spend most of your time, but some of it will land in the frontend, and you should be comfortable going there when a feature or a bug takes you there. Madden's tech team is a collaborative, tight-knit group where creativity, teamwork, and initiative are highly valued. We foster a culture where learning, personal growth, and mutual support are encouraged.
   

  

**Your Tasks Will Include**
* Collaborating with leadership, product design, and other developers to improve solutions.
* Building and owning our backend (Golang, Postgres, ClickHouse), and the frontend on top of it (React, TypeScript).

 Office-first, in central Stockholm. Close collaboration and shared problem-solving are core to how we work, so the default is being in together - with flexibility when life requires it.

title: Software Engineer | Box Team
description:
**Where software meets the physical world**
 In 2022, Budbee and Instabox merged to form Instabee — now home to three consumer brands serving millions of deliveries across Europe. We move fast, we're growing across Scandinavia and continental Europe, and we're not slowing down. Always with the consumer at heart.
   

  

 The Team
   

  

 The Box team owns one of Instabee's most tangible products: our locker network.
   

  

 We build and maintain the full software ecosystem that powers 6,000+ lockers — from cloud backend services to the software running on the physical hardware itself. It's a space where reliability, scalability, and real-world constraints collide daily, and where the gap between a code change and a real-world outcome is remarkably short.
   

  

 We operate as an autonomous, cross-functional team with full ownership of our product lifecycle — from design and development through to deployment and iteration. If you've ever wanted to see your engineering decisions literally open a door, this is that job.
   

  

 What You'll Work On
   

  

 The team’s focus and responsibilities span a wide range of areas, but everything is centered around the user experience at the parcel lockers. This means working with supporting backend solutions (Golang), the user interface at the locker itself (React), cloud services (Google Cloud), and other related applications.
   

  

 With our roadmap mainly centered around the locker experience, much of the engineering work focuses on building and evolving the software that powers the devices themselves. It’s a pragmatic, flexible environment where no two problems look the same.
   

  

**As a Software Engineer, On a Daily Basis, You'll**
* Shape the architecture — Contribute to key technical decisions and drive solutions that balance robustness with speed of delivery
* Work across the stack — Hands-on implementation from cloud services to hardware-adjacent software
* Collaborate closely — Partner with product managers, designers, and engineers to refine requirements and build things that matter
* Raise the bar — Code reviews, knowledge sharing, and continuous improvement of systems and processes


 Who You Are
   

  

 You're a pragmatic engineer who enjoys working across boundaries — backend and frontend, software and hardware, ambiguity and clarity. You take ownership, collaborate naturally, and care about how your work functions in the real world.
   

  

**You Bring**
* Senior-level Software Engineering experience
* Proficiency in Golang, or the confidence and track record to pick it up fast
* Experience with working in a Linux environment
* You think in business outcomes, not just technical solutions
* Familiarity with cloud platforms like GCP or similar


**Bonus Points For**
* Experience with React
* Background in IoT or hardware-integrated systems
* Deeper knowledge of Embedded Linux


 The Culture
   

  

 We believe great products are built by teams that take real ownership and understand how their work is used in the world. In the Box team, that's not a platitude — it's the daily reality.
   

  

 You'll work in a highly collaborative, autonomous environment where experimentation is encouraged and fast iteration is the norm. Open communication, continuous learning, and genuine cross-functional partnership are how we operate. You'll have real influence over technical direction and product experience — not just tickets in a queue.
   

  

 What You'll Get
   

  

 Ambitious colleagues, real challenges, and plenty of room to grow.
   

  

**Plus**
 🌇
 **Sky-High Office** 
 Modern, newly renovated with 360° views over Stockholm
   

  

 🍸
 **Rooftop Fridays** 
 Wind down the week at our rooftop bar
   

  

 🥐
 **Monthly Tech Breakfasts** 
 Midweek talks, great food, smart people
   

  

 👾
 **Tech Demos** 
 Regular showcases of the latest innovations
   

  

 🏓
 **Games Room** 
 Ping pong, shuffleboard, foosball, and karaoke
   

  

 ⏰
 **Hybrid Hours** 
 Work patterns that fit your life
   

  

 👶
 **6 Months Parental Pay** 
 Full support when your family grows
   

  

 🎂
 **Birthday Day Off** 
 Your day, your way — every year
   

  

 If building systems that bridge the digital and physical worlds sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you!

This review examines public criminal records and is a mandatory step in our recruitment process. While the results are public information, we handle all data with the utmost confidentiality.*
 Instabee Group, with consumer-facing brands Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy, brings together years of experience in delivery. title: Backend Engineer
description:
We're at a pivotal moment for both Tibber and the planet. When joining Tibber, you won’t just help scale a forward-thinking tech company – you’ll contribute to a real shift in how people consume electricity. With millions of smart devices connected to the Tibber platform (like electric vehicles and smart thermostats), we have one of the most unique portfolios trading energy on the market.
   

  

*We’re looking for a*

 As a Backend Engineer, you'll play a key role in turning our trading models into robust, production-ready systems - helping Tibber trade smarter so we can pass better prices and a more reliable energy experience on to our customers. You'll work closely with our forecasting team, right where trading decisions meet real customer impact.
   

  

**What You'll Do ✅**
* Build forecasts that support Tibber's trading operations
* Bridge model development and production-ready backend systems, working closely with the team building our ML models
* Support both our retail trading and flex trading domains
* Work hands-on with time series data

**What We're Looking For⚡**
 You are driven by impact and know how to turn strategy into execution. You're used to fast-paced environments and thrive when given clear goals and high accountability. We believe you'll thrive here if you:
   

  

* Have strong Python skills and experience building backend systems in ML-heavy environments (production ML, not just notebooks)
* Have hands-on experience with time series data and forecasting
* Know how to move ML models from development into reliable, production-ready systems
* Are proactive and entrepreneurial, comfortable owning your work end-to-end in a small, high-impact team

 Tibber exists to drive energy independence - away from fossil dependency.  We win, fail, and grow together, staying curious and pushing for better every day. AI is shaping how we work - and we're on a journey to make it central to everything we do. The further we go, the more our Tibberinos matter - and yes, that's what we call ourselves!
   

  

 Started by two founders in 2016. Now 300+ Tibberinos across Stockholm, Oslo, Berlin, Amsterdam, and Førde. And we're still just getting started.

title: Senior Staff Machine Learning Engineer - Content Policy & Safety
description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. Du och dina kollegor arbetar med drift och förvaltning av Windows serverplattform, men också med att utveckla, effektivisera och automatisera arbetssätt.  Vi vill att det ska gå bra för dig och du får en gedigen introduktion så att du kommer in i jobbet väl.
   

  

**Vad kan vi som arbetsgivare erbjuda dig?**
 Vi är glada över att ha blivit rankade som en av Sveriges mest attraktiva arbetsgivare och kan bland annat erbjuda dig:
   

  

* Ett flexibelt arbete där du får möjlighet att arbeta på distans upp till två dagar i veckan.

 Vem är du?

Du är lyhörd, samarbetsorienterad och trivs med att arbeta både självständigt och tillsammans med andra. Du drivs av att utveckla, effektivisera och automatisera arbetssätt samt har ett intresse för ny teknik och moderna plattformar. Din nyfikenhet och vilja att lära nytt bidrar till verksamhetens utveckling och förmåga att skapa värde.
   

  

 Vi söker dig som
   

  

* har en teknisk examen på minst gymnasienivå, alternativt annan utbildning eller erfarenhet som Trafikverket bedömer likvärdig
* har aktuell, relevant och flerårig arbetserfarenhet inom drift och förvaltning av Windows Server On-Prem
* har aktuell och relevant erfarenhet av att ha arbetat med Microsoft Azure, alternativt annan modern molntjänst som Trafikverket bedömer likvärdig
* har aktuell och relevant arbetserfarenhet av att automatisera arbetsuppgifter genom script, alternativt annan erfarenhet som Trafikverket bedömer som likvärdig
* har goda kunskaper i svenska i tal och skrift


 Det är meriterande om du
   

  

* har aktuell och relevant arbetserfarenhet av virtuella servrar, nätverk, identitetstjänster och/eller plattformstjänster i Microsoft Azure
* har aktuell och relevant arbetserfarenhet av Powershell för automatisering av arbetsuppgifter inom drift
* har aktuell och relevant erfarenhet av att arbeta med Windows-kluster, alternativt annan arbetserfarenhet som Trafikverket bedömer likvärdig


**Övrig information**
 Anställningen är placerad i säkerhetsklass. För anställning krävs godkänt resultat i säkerhetsprövningen, som genomförs i enlighet med bestämmelser i säkerhetsskyddslagen (2018:585)
   

  

 Webbaserade tester kan komma att användas som en del i urvalet. Vi använder främst mail (från mejladress: noreply@heroma.se) för att göra utskick och kallelser. Kolla din inkorg och även skräppost/SPAM regelbundet under denna tid för att vara säker på att du får all information från oss! För att undvika att information gällande din ansökan klassas som SPAM kan du med fördel lägga till vår e-postadress: noreply@heroma.se i dina e-postkontakter.
   

  

 Valbar placeringsort för tjänsten är Borlänge, Gävle, Göteborg eller Solna.
   

  

 De första intervjuerna kommer preliminärt att hållas via Skype under vecka 42.
   

  

**Ansökan**
 De frågor som du får besvara när du skickar in din ansökan kommer att ligga till grund för det första urvalet vi gör. Om det inte står något annat i annonsen vill vi att du bifogar ditt CV. Vi har slutat begära in personligt brev eftersom vi inte har med det som del av urvalsunderlaget. Om du har skyddade personuppgifter ska du kontakta ansvarig chef för rekryteringen så att din ansökan blir hanterad enligt särskilda rutiner. Du hittar namn och kontaktuppgifter till chefen i annonsen.
   

  

 Inom vår IT-organisation är du med och utvecklar Sverige med hjälp av moderna och innovativa lösningar. Vi är mitt i en spännande förändring där vi försöker ta vara på digitaliseringens möjligheter till fullo. Digitaliseringen ställer allt större krav och vi vill därför anpassa oss vad gäller kompetens, arbetssätt och organisation i takt med utvecklingen. Vi har ett helhetsansvar för IT och telekom, en verksamhet som pågår dygnet runt, året om - precis som Sveriges transportsystem.
   

  

 På Trafikverket jobbar vi med att göra Sverige närmare. Vi tror på att en förening av olika erfarenheter, bakgrunder och perspektiv är den bästa grunden för att bygga en arbetsplats fri från diskriminering och en miljö där alla trivs och gör sitt bästa. Vi tror på mångfald där den gemensamma nämnaren är pålitlighet, engagemang och mod. För det är så vi bäst representerar vårt samhälle.

title: Senior Secure Boot Engineer, Stockholm
description:
**Job Title**
 Senior Secure Boot Engineer, Stockholm
   

  

**Job Description**
*Are you looking for an opportunity to work with cutting-edge embedded security while helping build something new?* 
*Axis R&D is growing its Stockholm office, and we are looking for a Secure Boot Engineer to join Technologies, the department responsible for developing the product platforms at the heart of all Axis video surveillance products. If embedded systems, constrained resources, and cyber security are your thing, read on.*
**Who is your future team?**
 You will join the Common Core Platform team, part of the Product Platforms department within Axis R&D’s Technologies organization.
   

  

 The Product Platforms department currently consists of four highly skilled and motivated R&D teams. Three of them are today entirely based in Lund, but Common Core Platform spans both Lund and Stockholm. All teams feature a great mix of junior and senior members. Our teams value personal growth, collaboration, and teamwork. If you're someone who enjoys making an impact and contributing to positive change, you'll feel right at home with us.
   

  

 We are now growing our Stockholm team to further strengthen our capabilities. The Common Core Platform team in Stockholm develops and configures software for some of Axis’ next-generation video surveillance platforms. These platforms are built on ARTPEC, Axis’ own system-on-chip, designed in-house. The platforms we develop are Linux-based and the development environment is also Linux. The team works on requirements, design, implementation, and validation of the boot, security and CPU subsystems. In addition to working closely with some of the Product Platform teams in Lund, the team also collaborates closely with the ASIC team based in our Stockholm office.
   

  

**What will you do as Secure Boot Engineer?**
 In your daily work, you will typically engage in the following activities:
   

  

* Collaborate with ASIC design engineers to develop secure and efficient boot solutions
* Write and maintain robust, secure, reliable and high-quality code
* Design, implement, and use test environments to validate your code.
* Participate in design reviews and technical discussions to ensure the quality and feasibility of solutions.
* Stay informed about industry advancements related to secure boot and incorporate relevant trends into your work.


 In this role, you will (together with some skilled colleagues) mainly be working in the following areas:
   

  

* BootROM and boot loader software (primary responsibility)
* Developing environment for pre-silicon development and validation (e.g. QEMU)
* Secure boot through all boot stages
* Firmware for subsystems with their own CPU core


**Who are we looking for:**
 We are looking for a senior engineer with at least 5 years of working experience in embedded systems development. You are an analytical and dedicated person with a strong personal drive and an ability to work both unsupervised and as a part of a team. You have the ability to think ahead and design future-proof solutions. You possess strong attention to detail and take pride in developing code that meets the highest quality and security standards.
   

  

**Required qualifications:**
* A Master's degree in Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field
* Experience in embedded C development, particularly close to hardware
* Knowledge and hands-on experience in secure development and testing practices
* Familiarity with version control systems and code review tools (preferably Git and Gerrit)


**Strongly preferred qualifications:**
* A strong interest and expertise in the boot process of embedded devices, with prior experience in developing BootROMs and first-stage bootloaders
* Experience with ARM architectures and platforms
* Experience working with RTL simulation and related tools to verify BootROM functionality before silicon is available
* Experience using QEMU to build or maintain system simulation environments
* Basic understanding of how functional blocks in an ASIC are designed


**Additional valuable qualifications:**
* Experience with Python and Rust development
* Experience developing or evaluating countermeasures against fault-injection attacks during the boot process


 The position is office-based and you will be located in Axis office in Stockholm, Sweden.
   

  

**What Axis Has To Offer**
 We are a world leader in network video, where cutting-edge technology meets global impact.
   

  

 Here, you’ll contribute to meaningful projects that shape the future of security and surveillance — developing solutions used worldwide.
   

  

 As a fast-growing company, we offer exciting career opportunities. You’ll grow professionally through continuous learning, supported by a collaborative team that values creativity, innovation, and work-life balance.
   

  

*This is a unique opportunity to be part of building our new R&D office in central Stockholm. You’ll enjoy the advantages of working at a small, agile site while also being part of a successful organization that is already the world leader in network video.* 
  

  

 Your well-being matters to us. We offer a range of benefits, including a company bonus, Friday cake, wellness allowance, health insurance — and even your own Axis bicycle.
   

  

 To learn more about Axis, our innovative products, solutions, and vibrant company culture, explore:
   

  

 Life at Axis blog
   

  

 Engineering at Axis blog
   

  

 Innovation at Axis
   

  

**Ready to Act?** 
  

  

 Axis is a company realizing the benefits of a diverse workforce. We know that diversity in groups creates a better working environment and promotes creativity, something that is fundamental for our success. We welcome all applications.
   

  

 We go through applications continuously so don’t wait – send in your application today!
   

  

 In case of questions, please reach out to recruiting manager Erik Thored, Engineering Manager for the Common Core Platform team, at +46 46 272 1800.
   

  

 Type of Employment
   

  

 Permanent Employment
   

  

 Posting End Date
   

  

 2026-09-20
   

  

*Certain roles at Axis require background checks, which means applicable verifications will be done in these recruitments.* 
*Notice will be provided before we take any action.*
**About Axis Communications**
 We enable a smarter, safer world by creating innovative solutions for improving security and business performance. As a network technology company and industry leader, we offer solutions in video surveillance, access control, intercom, and audio systems, enhanced by intelligent analytics applications.
   

  

 With around 6000 committed employees in over 50 countries, we collaborate with partners worldwide. Together, we thrive in our friendly, open, and collaborative culture and inspire each other to think beyond the expected. United by our commitment to inclusion, diversity, and sustainability, we consistently seek to develop our skills and way of working.
   

  

**Let´s create a smarter, safer world**
 For more information about Axis, please visit our website www.axis.com.
   

  

 Listen to Get To Know Axis – Podcast

title: Staff Data Scientist - Experience
description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.
   

  

 Content Platform is responsible for the full content lifecycle at Spotify — from ingestion through to delivery — across music, podcasts, and audiobooks. We ensure content is structured, evaluated, and delivered reliably at global scale, powered by deep content understanding. We bring valuable content to users while ensuring it remains trusted and high-quality over time. The Product Insights team works across the full content lifecycle to improve decision-making, improve our catalog understanding and ensure one of the world’s largest content catalogs is safe and engaging.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Staff Data Scientist to join the team and tackle complex, high-impact problems by combining strategic thinking with hands-on, tactical execution.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Lead analyses across user behavior and content data to shape product and strategy decisions.
* Shape how we evaluate and improve content classification and taxonomy, with a particular focus on safety, combining analytical depth with a broader view of product and business needs.
* Design evaluation frameworks, including sampling strategies, setting baselines, metrics, and annotation-based approaches, and guide how these methods are applied across the team.
* Build scalable analytical foundations, including metrics, dashboards, and the data and context needed to enable effective self-serve analysis and agents.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and Operations leadership to shape priorities and how data informs product strategy.
* Raise the analytical bar across Product Insights through methodological leadership, mentorship, and by identifying opportunities to improve how we work with data across domains.


 Who You Are
   

  

* You have deep experience as a product data scientist and have operated at Staff level or equivalent.
* You have a strong foundation in statistics and experience designing evaluation and measurement approaches, including annotation-based methods and settings where controlled experiments are not feasible.
* You have experience in building metrics and reporting systems that support product or policy decision-making.
* You have built self-serve analytical tools or data agents that enable others to answer questions effectively.
* You are proficient in SQL and experienced with Python, DBT, or similar tools for building and maintaining reliable analytical datasets
* You leverage state of the art LLM models to do your analysis while ensuring quality and accuracy in the output
* You communicate clearly across functions, influence decisions with senior stakeholders, and help raise analytical standards through mentorship and methodological leadership.
* You have experience working on content classification, taxonomy, safety, policy, or adjacent domains where data quality and judgment are important to product decisions.


 Where You'll Be
   

  

* This role is based in Stockholm or London.
* We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.


 We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us. Find our AI notice here: https://lifeatspotify.com/ai-notice
   

  

 Today, we are the world’s most popular audio streaming subscription service.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
About Us
 



**At FDJ UNITED, we don't just follow the game, we reinvent it.** 




 FDJ UNITED is one of Europe’s leading betting and gaming operators, with a vast portfolio of iconic brands and a reputation for technological excellence. With more than 5,000 employees and a presence in around fifteen regulated markets, the Group offers a diversified, responsible range of games, both under exclusive rights and open to competition. We set new standards, proving that entertainment and safety can go hand in hand. Here, you’ll work alongside a team of passionate individuals dedicated to delivering the best and safest entertaining experiences for our customers every day.
 



  





 We’re looking for bold people who are eager to succeed and ready to level-up the game. If you thrive on innovation, embrace challenges, and want to make a real impact at all levels, FDJ UNITED is your playing field.
 



**Join us in shaping the future of gaming. Are you ready to LEVEL-UP THE GAME?** 




  





**The role** 




 Our Platform Delivery and Reliability Services (PDRS) team is on the lookout for a highly skilled DevOps Engineer to take charge of provisioning and maintaining Kubernetes clusters and infrastructure pipelines for both on-prem and cloud deployments.
 



 You'll provision and maintain Kubernetes clusters, maintain infrastructure pipelines and manage our cloud infrastructure, ensuring our applications are always performing at their best.
 



 Your expertise in developing scripts and automation tools will streamline operations and reduce manual workflows, making everything run smoothly. When technical issues arise, you'll be the go-to person for diagnosing and resolving them. Your hands-on skills with Docker, Kubernetes, Python, CI/CD tools, and Terraform will grow as you tackle real infrastructure challenges!
 



 If you're ready to join us and make a real impact, we want to hear from you!
 



  





**What you will do** 



* Manage and maintain cloud infrastructure and resources to ensure high availability, performance, and security of applications.
* Develop pipelines and automation tools to streamline operations and reduce manual workflows.
* Diagnose and resolve technical issues in development, test, and production environments.
* Work collaboratively with software engineering teams to design and implement CI/CD pipelines and automate deployment processes.



  





**Your experience** 



* Proven experience working as a DevOps engineer (Min. 3 years of experience)
* Experience working with:



 1.Container Orchestration (preferably Kubernetes - or equivalents such as open shift, Rancher, EKS, GKS, AKS, open tofu)
 



 2.Python
 



 3.Containers (Docker)
 



 4.CI/CD (Jenkins, ArgoCD)
 



 5.Proven Automation skills (Ansible)
 



 6.Terraform
 



 7.IaC Tools (Terraform)
 



 8.Jenkins
 



 9.Python or other scripting languages
 



 10.Groovy
 



 11.Troubleshooting
 



 12.AWS experience with services such as EKS is nice to have
 


* Good communication skills with the ability to contribute to team discussion and collaborate with different teams.

title: Manager, Product Development - Tieto Caretech (m/f/d)
description:
**Job Description**
**At Tieto Caretech you’ll get a chance to provide patients and end users with purposeful technology and product offerings that help them in their life. If that sounds interesting, please keep on reading.**
**About Us**
 Through advanced, intuitive technology, Tieto Caretech reduces administrative work, improves decision-making, and strengthens safety and quality in health and social care. With the Lifecare software portfolio we enable health and social care professionals to focus on what matters most: people.
   

  

 We are a global team of professionals working on providing products and services to different sectors from intensive care to laboratory and social care. In addition to working closely with our customers, we also have our own products that we build and develop for various fields in society. From enabling healthcare professionals to spend more valuable time with their patients to providing data for professional athletes to achieve even better results, we make all that possible. With us you can be part of advancing societies through purposeful technology and make your mark on the health and wellbeing of people.
   

  

**About The Role**
 We are looking for a
 **People Manager** 
 to manage, develop and build engineering teams that are developing and delivering next generation healthcare IT solutions to care providers across Europe. You will report to Head of Product Development, be a member of the engineering management team and collaborate with product, delivery and business management.
   

  

**In this role you will**
* Lead, support and develop a team consisting of people with different skills: software developers, data scientists, cloud engineers, data engineers and architects.
* Creating a strong, positive working culture where different roles and teams work together towards common goals.
* Facilitate continuous improvement through ways of working, processes and competence development.
* Ensuring that the teams thrive, grow and deliver.


**We are looking for someone with**
* Proven track record as a line manager with responsibility of managing and building high performing teams.
* Ability to drive changes, improvements, and measures.
* A systematic approach to identifying bottlenecks in both technology and organization.
* Good knowledge of software engineering, delivery and customer services processes.
* Excellent communication skills (written and verbal) in both Swedish and English.


**AI knowledge requirement**
 AI literacy is expected for this role. You will be comfortable using approved AI tools to improve quality and productivity in everyday work (e.g., drafting, summarising, analysing, and automating routine tasks). You can write clear prompts/instructions, critically evaluate and validate AI outputs, and apply sound judgement when results are incomplete, biased, or incorrect. You understand and follow company policies and applicable legal/regulatory requirements for confidentiality, privacy, security, and responsible AI use (including not sharing sensitive data in unapproved tools).
   

  

**What’s in it for you?**
 With us you will be part of the important and meaningful work of developing healthcare for all of us. You have an important mission to make a difference that really matters. In addition, as a company we offer you professional growth, open and friendly culture, and an outstanding work-life balance! We believe that our organizational culture is an important part of enabling you to be successful. We provide a flexible hybrid work model as part of our culture and way of working.
   

  

 Finally, we also believe in curiosity and learning as a lifestyle. We want to encourage you to keep up that curiosity and deepen your knowledge on topics you’re interested in. For example, we host a ‘Keep Learning Week’ twice a year, a week where everyone at Tieto has the possibility to join different training courses in a truly global setting.
   

  

**Could you be our new colleague?**
 We look forward to hearing from you! We will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply today. If you have any questions regarding this role, please contact the hiring manager Kari-Antti Kuosa @ kari-antti.kuosa@tieto.com.
   

  

*We perform background checks on all final candidates.*
*Tieto declines calls from recruitment companies.*
 Additional Information
   

  

 At Tieto, we believe in the power of diversity, equity, and inclusion. We encourage applicants of all backgrounds, genders (m/f/d), and walks of life to join our team, as we believe that this fosters an inspiring workplace and fuels innovation. Our commitment to openness, trust, and diversity is at the heart of our mission to create digital futures that benefit businesses, societies, and humanity.
   

  

 Diversity, equity and inclusion | Sustainability | Tieto
   

  

**Stay Alert To Recruitment Scams**
* Tieto only communicates via @tieto.com email addresses.
* We never ask candidates to pay fees or share financial details during recruitment.
* If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Tieto, don't respond — verify it via our official careers site.
* For more information visit Important Advisory Regarding Recruitment Fraud | Tieto Blog

title: Senior Application Specialist
description:
Apollo och Dertour satsar stort på CRM, kommunikation, kundnöjdhet, kundinsikt och kundrelationer! Därför söker vi nu en ny medarbetare till vårt nordiska CRM team som kan lyfta våra kundinteraktioner till nya nivåer. Är du vår nästa Applikationsspecialist?
   

 Jobbar du idag som applikationskonsult men letar efter en fast plats i tillvaron? Eller arbetar du kanske med Dynamics365 som systemadministratör eller med användarsupport? Apollo erbjuder nu en spännande roll i gränslandet mellan IT och affär. Som Senior Application Specialist hos oss får du möjligheten att arbeta tillsammans med ett härligt och extremt kompetent team.
 


  


 Ta chansen - ansök och arbeta på ett resebolag i framkant!
   




  


 I rollen som Senior Application Specialist kommer du att vara en del av Dertour Groups Dynamics 365 & Power Platform Competence center. Vi är ett tvärfunktionellt team som består av allt från applikationsspecialister, utvecklare till marknadsförare och analytiker. Teamet är en del av den nordiska IT avdelningen, men servar alla Apollos affärsområden och marknader liksom många andra företag inom koncernen, varför du även kommer att arbeta en del internationellt.
   




  





  


**Vad du kommer att göra** 



  

* Anpassning och konfiguration av Dynamics 365 och Power Platform
* Uppsättning av flöden i Power Automate och Co-pilot Studio
* Uppsättning och optimering av Canvas och modelldrivna appar i Power apps
* Driva workshops avseende t.ex. kravställning
* Driva designarbete och föreslå olika lösningsmöjligheter, inklusive vad de innebär och konsekvenser med de olika lösningarna
* Kunna leda dig själv och ibland andra Application Specialists i design och utveckling av lösningar
* Test och optimering av automationer, processer och funktioner
* Delta i test-, release- och driftsättningsaktiviteter samt stötta UAT
* Hantera incidenter, användarsupport och applikationsrelaterade problem
* Bidra till förbättringar av metoder och processer internt på Apollo, och inom Dertour Group.


  


 Vi letar efter dig som har en gedigen kunskap inom power platform och Dynamics365. Du bör vara nyfiken, kreativ och tycka att det är självklart att agera på kundinsikter och jobba datadrivet i alla touchpoints.
   




  


 Rollen ansvarar tillsammans med teamets övriga applikationsspecialister, projektledare och utvecklare för att Dertour och Apollo ska ha ett CRM system i absolut världsklass. För oss är det viktiga att vi hittar rätt person, oavsett hur din bakgrund ser ut.
 


  





  

  

**Kvalifikationer**
* Minst 5 års erfarenhet av Dynamics 365 och Power Platform, som applikationsspecialist, funktionell konsult eller liknande
* Erfarenhet av att bygga canvas- och modell-drivna appar
* Erfarenhet av Copilot Studio, Microsoft Copilot eller andra AI-verktyg
* Erfarenhet av att leda eller ansvara för andras arbete, eller leda andra personer i delprojekt
* Relevanta Microsoft-certifieringar
* En flexibel och kreativ person som tycker att det är kul att anta nya utmaningar
* En "hands on" person som levererar enligt överenskommelse
* Du är datadriven, analytisk, metodisk & logisk
* Någon som älskar att ha koll på och testa de senaste apparna och funktionerna inom Microsofts ekosystem
* Du är självgående, men gillar att jobba i ett team
* Du är flytande i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.


  


**Vi ser att det är meriterande om du har:**
 Erfarenhet av större marknadsföringsplattformar t.ex. D365 Customer Insights, Salesforce marketing cloud, Adobe eller liknande. (Vi använder D365 Customer Insights Journeys idag). Det är även meriterande om du har arbetat i någon form av analysverktyg t.ex. Power BI eller Google Analytics
   

  

 Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid, med placering på vårt huvudkontor i Norrtull, Stockholm. Vi tillämpar hybrid arbetsplatspolicy.
 


  


 Låter detta som en möjlighet för dig? Skicka in din ansökan redan idag - vi ser verkligen fram emot att höra från dig!
 


  


 Observera att urval sker löpande, så vänta inte för länge.

title: Erfaren produktägare Analysdata
description:
**Erfaren produktägare till Analysdata**




 Vill du leda utvecklingen av en verksamhetskritisk datalagerförmåga och skapa bättre förutsättningar för datadrivna beslut? Vi söker en erfaren produktägare till produkten Analysdata på Arbetsförmedlingen. Du får en central roll i att omsätta verksamhetens och IT-produkternas behov till prioriterade, genomförbara och långsiktigt hållbara datalagerleveranser. Tillsammans får vi Sverige i arbete. Vill du bli en av oss?
   

  





**Sektionens uppdrag**




 Analysdata ansvarar för förmågor inom datainsamling, dataförsörjning, datamodellering, dataförädling, datakvalitet och tillgängliggörande av data. Produkten befinner sig i en viktig utvecklingsfas där vi både förvaltar befintliga datalager och genomför en flerårig modernisering mot ett sammanhållet och modernt Enterprise Data Warehouse.
   

  





 Sektionen samlar kompetens och tekniska förmågor inom data warehouse och analysdata. Produktägare tillhandahåller resurser och kompetens till IT-produkter som utvecklar och förvaltar lösningar utifrån verksamhetens behov. I uppdraget ingår både förvaltning av befintliga datalager och den fortsatta utvecklingen mot en modern, sammanhållen och skalbar datalagerförmåga.
   

  





**Om rollen**




 Som produktägare ansvarar du för att styra och prioritera arbetet inom Analysdata. Du skapar en tydlig och transparent backlogg där verksamhetsbehov, produktleveranser, modernisering, teknisk skuld och förvaltningsbehov vägs samman.
   

  





 Du arbetar nära andra produktägare och produktansvarig för inom Analysdata, IT-produkternas produktägare, krav- och dataanalytiker, arkitekter, utvecklingsteam och andra berörda verksamheter. Rollen kräver att du kan röra dig mellan verksamhet, data och teknik och göra komplexa beroenden begripliga och hanterbara.
   

  





 Du leder prioriteringen i en miljö där stabila leveranser ska kombineras med en omfattande teknisk och organisatorisk modernisering. För att lyckas i rollen behöver du vara trygg i ditt mandat och kunna fatta beslut även när behoven är fler än kapaciteten. Du skapar riktning och framdrift utan att tappa den långsiktiga helheten.
   

  





**Som produktägare för Analysdata ansvarar du för att:** 



* Äga, strukturera och prioritera byggstenens gemensamma backlogg
* Omsätta verksamhetsbehov och produktplaner till tydliga mål, initiativ och leveranser
* Säkerställa att uppdrag är tillräckligt analyserade och förberedda inför utveckling
* Balansera nya behov mot modernisering, förvaltning, incidenter, teknisk skuld och livscykelhantering
* Samordna beroenden och prioriteringar med IT-produkter, arkitektur och andra byggstenar
* Formulera mål, effekter, acceptanskriterier och tydliga prioriteringsgrunder
* Ge utvecklingsteamen riktning och fatta löpande beslut om vad som ska göras och i vilken ordning
* Följa upp leveranser, datakvalitet, nyttor, risker och avvikelser
* Bidra till gemensamma arbetssätt, begrepp, informationsmodeller och principer för datalagerutveckling
* Kommunicera beslut, prioriteringar och utvecklingsplaner till berörda intressenter.



**Vårt erbjudande**




 Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på heltid som kan komma att inledas med sex månaders provanställning. Placeringsorten är Solna. Vi erbjuder dig möjligheten att arbeta på en arbetsplats där vi värdesätter balans mellan arbete och privatliv. Du får tillgång till ett generöst semesteravtal, flexibla arbetstider samt möjlighet att arbeta på distans upp till 49 procent på årsbasis. Hos oss ingår även friskvård under arbetstid och ett förmånligt friskvårdsbidrag. Som anställd på Arbetsförmedlingen har du också tillgång till kompetensutveckling och karriärmöjligheter inom myndigheten. Genom vårt arbete bidrar vi till ett inkluderande och hållbart samhälle, där du får möjlighet att göra en verklig skillnad för individer och för samhället i stort.  Mer om att jobba hos oss

title: Lagersamordnare till SJ
description:
Vill du arbeta i en verksamhet där rätt material på rätt plats vid rätt tidpunkt är avgörande för att tågen ska kunna rulla? Har du erfarenhet av lager, logistik eller materialhantering och trivs i en roll med stort ansvar och många kontaktytor?
   

  

 Hos SJ Underhåll får du en viktig roll i att säkerställa materialförsörjningen till underhållsproduktionen och därmed bidra till att våra tåg är hela, rena och trafiksäkra.
   

  

**Din kommande roll**
 Som Lagersamordnare inom Depåproduktionens underhållsverksamhet är du en viktig länk i kedjan som säkerställer att rätt material finns tillgängligt när våra fordon ska underhållas. Tillsammans med dina kollegor skapar du förutsättningar för en effektiv materialförsörjning och bidrar till att SJ kan leverera hela, rena och trafiksäkra tåg i tid.
   

  

 Rollen omfattar både operativt lagerarbete och utvecklingsarbete. Som den första Lagersamordnaren i den nya organisationen kommer du att vara med och färdigställa samt vidareutveckla lager- och materialförsörjningen för våra nya fordonsflottor X45 och SJ250 i Hagalund. Du kommer även att arbeta med reservdelshantering kopplat till X55 Midlife-programmet och kommande revisioner, samtidigt som du bidrar till att utveckla lagerprocesser, rutiner och arbetssätt för framtiden.
   

  

 En viktig del av uppdraget är också att stödja den fortsatta uppbyggnaden av lagerorganisationen genom att bidra till introduktion och upplärning av framtida Lagersamordnare. Du förväntas även delta aktivt i den digitala utvecklingen av lagerverksamheten genom att bidra till förbättrade systemstöd, ökad spårbarhet och mer effektiva arbetssätt. Detta gör rollen särskilt intressant för dig som trivs med att kombinera praktiskt lagerarbete med utveckling, förbättringar och förändringsarbete.
   

  

 Rollen innebär bland annat att du:
   

  

* Kontrollerar inkommande och utgående gods mot inköps- och arbetsorder.
* Genomför godsmottagning inklusive avsyning av gods och följesedlar.
* Tar emot, packar upp, märker, registrerar och lagerför material.
* Hanterar reklamationer av avvikande material.
* Skapar inköpsrekvisitioner för material som ska upparbetas.
* Hanterar reparabelflöden och transportbokningar.
* Plockar och sammanställer materialkit till underhållsproduktionen.
* Hanterar kemikalier, indirekt material och övriga lagerflöden.
* Genomför inventering av lagerfört material.
* Medverkar vid skrotning av inkurant material.
* Säkerställer att ordning och reda råder i lagerutrymmen.
* Ansvarar för miljöstationer och spilloljehantering


 Division Fordon ansvarar för fordonsflottans livscykel och ska säkerställa att i rätt tid leverera hela, rena och trafiksäkra tåg. Division Fordon ska utveckla och upprätthålla SJs fordonspark, säkerställa rätt fordonskvalitet, en effektiv underhållsproduktion genom god planering samt balansering av underhållsbehov och kapacitet.
   

  

**Förväntningar på den vi söker**
 Är ansvarstagande, strukturerad och noggrann. Du har ett starkt säkerhetsmedvetande och trivs i en verksamhet där kvalitet, ordning och samarbete är avgörande för resultatet.
   

  

 Du har god förmåga att planera, prioritera och lösa problem i en verksamhet där förutsättningarna ibland förändras snabbt. Samtidigt är du serviceinriktad och tycker om att samarbeta med många olika funktioner.
   

  

 Vi ser att du har:
   

  

* Vi söker dig med gymnasieexamen eller tidigare erfarenhet inom lager/logistik.
* Du har intyg att framföra lagerfordon såsom Motviktstruck (B1) och Ledstaplare (A2).
* Vi ser även att du har B-körkort.
* God datorvana och vana inom olika system
* Goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska, både i tal och skrift.


 Det är meriterande om du har:
   

  

* Erfarenhet av SAP eller andra affärs- och lagersystem.
* Erfarenhet från teknisk verksamhet, industri eller underhållsproduktion.
* Kunskap om materialflöden, inventering och logistikprocesser.


**Ansökan och information**
 Urval sker löpande så skicka in din ansökan så snart som möjligt, dock senast 2026-09-30. Vid frågor om tjänsten kontakta Christopher Carlström, Projektledare Underhåll Zeta & Delta: christopher.carlstrom@sj.se

title: Senior Network Engineer
description:
**Senior Network Engineer – Shape the Network Services Behind the Nordics**
*Would you like your engineering work to reach far beyond a single platform or customer? At GlobalConnect, you’ll help shape network services on infrastructure that carries more than half of Scandinavia’s internet connections — connecting businesses, hospitals and public services. This is an opportunity to combine practical engineering with service design and turn complex network needs into reliable solutions that work on a Nordic scale.*
**Build services that people and businesses rely on every day**
 As our
 **Senior Network Engineer – Underlay & Service Development** 
 , you’ll work at the intersection of network engineering, technology and product. Your focus will be to turn service concepts into repeatable, scalable network offerings across our Nordic infrastructure.
   

  

 Your day could start with discussing what a new service needs to offer customers. From there, you might translate those needs into an underlay architecture, define service models and configuration templates, or validate a new setup in the lab. Later, you could work with OSS/BSS, Security, Operations or a technology supplier to make sure automation, observability and operational requirements are covered before launch.
   

  

 You’ll work across technologies including BGP, MPLS, EVPN and Segment Routing, while using automation and APIs to make provisioning more consistent and scalable. You’ll also contribute throughout the service lifecycle — from technical design and validation to launch, documentation and ongoing improvements.
   

  

 In short, you’ll help turn good network engineering into services that customers can depend on.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities Will Include**
* Designing and evolving underlay architecture for new and existing network services.
* Translating service requirements into scalable architectures, service models, configuration templates and APIs.
* Building automation and OSS integrations using technologies such as Python, Ansible, YANG/NETCONF, gNMI and REST.
* Running lab validation and pilots, followed by post-launch tuning and service lifecycle work.
* Working across Product, OSS/BSS, NOC, Security and suppliers to establish service KPIs, acceptance criteria and smooth operational handovers.


**Join the team behind the Nordics’ digital infrastructure**
 You’ll join a Nordic group of experienced network engineers working with Internet, IP-VPN, L2 and DDoS mitigation services. Knowledge sharing is a natural part of the job, and you’ll have plenty of opportunities to exchange ideas with colleagues in engineering, product and operations.
   

  

**Why GlobalConnect?**
 Our fiber and network infrastructure forms part of the digital foundation of Scandinavia, carrying connections used by organizations ranging from smaller businesses to hospitals, enterprises and public services.
   

  

 That scale creates interesting engineering problems — and room to explore new technologies, improve how services are built and automated, and broaden your knowledge across the Nordics.
   

  

**To Thrive Here, We Think You Need**
* 5+ years of experience in carrier or large-enterprise networking, including practical underlay work supporting telecom services.
* Deep technical knowledge of technologies such as BGP, MPLS L3VPN/L2VPN, EVPN, Segment Routing and OSPF/IS-IS, plus experience with multi-tenant services, wholesale interconnects or peering.
* Practical experience connecting networks with OSS/BSS, orchestration platforms or service controllers using technologies such as REST APIs and YANG/NETCONF.
* Experience with vendors such as Cisco, Juniper, Nokia or Arista is relevant.
* Fluent in English, fluency in a Scandinavian language is a plus.
* Based in either Copenhagen, Stockholm, Uppsala, or Oslo, where we have our offices.


**Ready to help shape what runs underneath the connected Nordics?**
 If you’re motivated by solving substantial technical problems, sharing knowledge and seeing your engineering become reliable services used across society, this could be your next step. At GlobalConnect, you’ll have room to deepen your technical skills while contributing to network infrastructure that matters every day.
   

  

 Send us your CV or LinkedIn profile.
 **We don’t need a personal letter** 
 unless there’s something that requires a special explanation and isn’t covered in your CV or LinkedIn profile.
   

  

 We review applications and invite candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis. We look forward to hearing from you.
   

  

**About Us**
 GlobalConnect is one of the leading connectivity providers in Northern Europe. We’re 2000 passionate and talented individuals who want to make a difference, turning our customers’ visions into reality through connectivity. Our goal is to create the best possible conditions for engaged employees, a place where you can develop and grow, and create unforgettable memories and enjoyable experiences.
   

  

 We have helped develop and digitize societies across the Nordics for more than two decades. Our purpose is what drives us to continue - turning visions into reality by empowering society with connectivity.

title: Examensarbete - AI för prediktivt underhåll av kollektivtrafikens anläggningar
description:
Stockholmsregionen växer kraftigt – och allt fler pendlar till, från och inom länet. Snabb tillväxt och ökade krav från resenärer ställer krav på mer och attraktivare kollektivtrafik. Den växande regionen innebär också utmaningar för framkomlighet i vägnät och belastningar på miljö och klimat. Trafikförvaltningen har som mål att inte bara erbjuda befintliga resenärer en attraktiv kollektivtrafik utan även höja kollektivtrafikens konkurrenskraft och därigenom utöka användandet av kollektivtrafik. På så sätt blir kollektivtrafiken en pusselbit för att lösa Stockholms utmaningar i framtiden.
   

  

 Bakgrund
   

  

 Trafikförvaltningen ansvarar för de tekniska systemen på cirka 100 tunnelbanestationer, 50 pendeltågsstationer och drygt 30 depåer. Det är bland annat ventilation, pumpar, hissar, rulltrappor och reservkraft. Systemen övervakas dygnet runt från vår driftledning via styr- och övervakningssystemet iFIX, som hanterar omkring 300 000 mätvärden varav ungefär 75 000 av dem sparas historiskt.
   

  

 Underhållet är i dag i huvudsak kalenderstyrt eller avhjälpande. Åtgärder görs vid fasta intervall eller när något redan har gått sönder. Samtidigt innehåller larmflödet till driftledningen mycket brus. Vi utvärderar därför i en pilot om historiska driftdata och AI kan upptäcka begynnande fel innan de blir driftstörningar, och om en språkmodell som körs i vår egen miljö kan formulera trolig orsak och lämplig åtgärd. Ingen data lämnar våra system.
   

  

 Syfte
   

  

 Inom ramen för ex-jobbet blir din uppgift:
   

  

* Datakvalitet: undersöka om historiken faktiskt bär de mönster metoden förutsätter: samplingsintervall, dödband, lagringstid och verklig mätpunktstäthet för de utvalda pilotobjektens mätvärden.
* Avvikelsedetektering och modelldrift: träna en modell på hur 30–50 mätvärden för ett installationsobjekt normalt hänger ihop, och lösa hur modellen ska lära om sig efter ett servicebesök. Annars larmar den på utrustning som just har servats och fungerar.
* Textgenerering: utvärdera hur väl en lokalt körd språkmodell med uppslag i våra egna driftkort och serviceprotokoll kan beskriva orsak och åtgärd, och hur den kvaliteten bör mätas.


 Omfattningen anpassas efter kandidat- eller masternivå. Du behöver eventuellt inte täcka alla tre delarna utan vi bestämmer avgränsningen tillsammans vid uppstart.
   

  

 Metod och genomförande
   

  

* Inläsning på anläggningen, driftledningens arbetssätt och befintligt pilotunderlag.
* Uttag och kvalitetsgranskning av historiska driftdata för ett eller ett par pilotobjekt, exempelvis ett ventilationsaggregat på en depå.
* Modellering och experiment i Python. Språkmodellen körs på hårdvara hos oss.
* Validering mot kända servicebesök och felhistorik, kompletterat med intervjuer med drifttekniker och underhållsentreprenör.
* Rapport och presentation med en rekommendation vi kan agera på.


 Du sitter hos oss på Kungsholmen och har tillgång till handledare, driftledning och testmiljö.
   

  

 Din utbildning och erfarenhet
   

  

 Du läser sista året på civilingenjörs- eller masterprogram inom datateknik, teknisk fysik, elektroteknik, automation, energi- och fastighetsteknik eller motsvarande.
   

  

 Vi söker dig som:
   

  

* kan programmera i Python och har grundläggande kunskaper i maskininlärning
* arbetar självständigt och strukturerat
* behärskar svenska i tal och skrift då driftkort, serviceprotokoll och underlag är på svenska


 Meriterande:
   

  

* erfarenhet av tidsseriedata eller anomalidetektering

title: Senior Data Scientist
description:
**⚡️ What We Do**
 Flower is Flexible Power. We are a next-gen energy company leveraging AI and machine learning to make renewable energy stable and always available – even when the sun isn’t shining and the wind isn’t blowing.
   

  

 Through smart optimization and trading of energy assets like wind and solar farms, battery systems, and EV chargers, we make renewable energy reliable and predictable, leading the charge towards the energy system of tomorrow.
   

  

**🌟Who We Are**
 Tech company at heart. Purpose-driven at core. Flower consists of a diverse group of innovative individuals with a strong desire to improve the state of the world.
   

  

 At Flower, we believe trust, collaboration and diversity are essential to not only create an inclusive work environment, but also drive career growth. By embracing varying perspectives, we allow creativity and progress to flourish.
   

  

 To accelerate towards our goal of becoming the pioneering force powering the energy system of tomorrow, we are now looking for a passionate and skilled Senior Data Scientist to join us!
   

  

**👩‍💻 About The Role**
 As a Senior Data Scientist, you will shape the foundation of Flower’s short-term forecasting capabilities - powering the models that directly drive our daily trading decisions. You will be part of a small, highly skilled team operating at the intersection of data science, energy systems, and close-to-real-time market dynamics.
   

  

 You will own the full lifecycle of your models - from idea to production - working closely with Data Engineers, Machine Learning Engineers, and Energy Market Experts to ensure our forecasting stack runs smoothly and is continuously improving. This is a hands-on role focussed on time-series modelling, rapid experimentation, and the ability to translate data into high-impact operational decisions.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Build & maintain short term operational forecasting models for energy volumes & prices that drive our trading decisions on a day-to-day basis
* Build time series models to understand and explain recurring patterns across different measurements, products and regions to distill signals as features for your next model
* Prototype quickly: iterate on simple models, validate rigorously, and scale what works in a dynamic market environment
* Own the full model lifecycle: EDA, feature engineering, model development, validation, deployment and continuous evaluation, supported by our team of DEs, MLEs & Energy Market Experts
* Write your models in Python, version your code in Git, use CI/CD to ensure full reproducibility
* Partner with DEs to evaluate and integrate new data sources (weather, grid conditions, market signals)
* Collaborate & mentor across other data scientists, quants and engineers


**Who You Are**
* Master’s or PhD in Statistics, Machine Learning, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Engineering Physics, or a related quantitative field
* 5+ years building and deploying time-series prediction models in production using machine learning or classical methods
* Strong command of Python and no stranger to the command line; comfortable writing clean, maintainable, production-ready code
* Deep understanding of time-series forecasting and real-world modeling challenges
* Prior experience in energy markets or power systems
* Strong mentorship and coaching skills
* Highly driven by our mission and your impact, yet humble enough to know we are all always learning
* Eagerness to apply yourself in a mostly automated trading floor environment
* Thrive in a fast-moving environment and adapt models as markets evolve


**📍 Location**
 Our beautiful office is located in the heart of Södermalm, just a short walk from Slussen subway station. We encourage in-office collaboration but support a hybrid work model.
   

  

**✉️ Apply**
 Our corporate language is English, as we have over 30 nationalities in the office. We therefore appreciate it if you could submit your CV in English.
   

  

 Throughout the recruitment process you will meet with the Talent Partner, Head of Predictions and Optimization, the Team, VP of Engineering and VP of Product.
   

  

 We look forward to hearing from you!
   

  

*We kindly but firmly decline any engagement in recruitment assistance for our hiring processes. This includes partnership offers or the sale of recruitment tools.*

title: Data Scientist
description:
Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions.
   

  

 At Xylem, we're tackling some of the world's biggest water challenges through innovation, technology, and data. We're looking for a Data Scientist who is curious, collaborative, and excited about turning complex data into meaningful solutions that help our customers operate more efficiently and sustainably.
   

  

 In this role, you'll work with operational and sensor data to develop machine learning models, advanced analytics, and AI-powered solutions that generate real-world impact. You'll collaborate with product managers, engineers, domain experts, and customers to uncover opportunities, solve complex problems, and create products that deliver measurable value.
   

  

 Success in this role comes from combining strong analytical skills with a genuine interest in understanding the systems, processes, and operational environments behind the data.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Analyze complex operational and sensor data to uncover patterns, trends, and opportunities for improvement.
* Design, develop, validate, and deploy machine learning models and advanced analytics solutions.
* Build algorithms for forecasting, anomaly detection, and predictive decision support.
* Transform business and customer challenges into scalable, data-driven solutions.
* Develop a deep understanding of the systems, processes, and operational context behind the data to create impactful analytical solutions.
* Collaborate closely with product managers, software engineers, domain experts, and customers to define and deliver new capabilities.
* Leverage modern AI tools and technologies to support data exploration, experimentation, model development, and solution delivery.
* Monitor and continuously improve the performance of analytics solutions and machine learning models.
* Communicate insights and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Stay up to date with emerging technologies, AI advancements, and analytical methods that can drive innovation and continuous improvement.


**Qualifications**
 We're interested in people with different backgrounds and experiences. If you're excited about the opportunity and believe you can contribute, we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience developing machine learning models and advanced analytics solutions.
* Strong Python skills and experience working with large or complex datasets.
* Good understanding of statistics, data analysis, and predictive modeling techniques.
* Ability to translate business and operational challenges into practical data-driven solutions.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a curiosity for discovering meaningful insights from data.
* Interest in understanding the systems and processes behind the data and applying that knowledge to analytical solutions.
* Ability to communicate complex concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively across teams and disciplines.


**Nice to Have**
 Experience with time-series data, anomaly detection, forecasting, predictive analytics, industrial systems, IoT, or sensor data would be valuable. Familiarity with cloud-based analytics and machine learning platforms, AI-assisted development tools, or cross-functional product development environments is also a plus. Most importantly, we're looking for someone who is curious, eager to learn, enjoys collaborating with others, and is motivated by creating meaningful impact through data.
   

  

**Why Join Xylem?**
 At Xylem, you'll be part of a global team dedicated to solving critical water and infrastructure challenges. We offer a collaborative and international environment where you'll have opportunities to grow your skills, develop your career, and contribute to innovative solutions that make a difference around the world.
   

  

 You'll also have the opportunity to engage with
 **Xylem Watermark** 
 , our corporate citizenship program focused on education, community involvement, and water stewardship. Learn more at www.xylemwatermark.com.
   

  

**Belonging at Xylem**
 At Xylem, we believe that diverse perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds strengthen our teams and drive innovation. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcomed, respected, and empowered to do their best work.
   

  

 We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if their experience doesn't perfectly match every qualification listed. Your unique skills, experiences, and potential may make you the ideal fit for this role.
   

  

**Application**
 We look forward to receiving your application in English.
   

  

 Please note that we review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the recruitment process once we have found the right candidate.
   

  

 If you have any questions about the position, please contact: Leila.sayyad@xylem.com
   

  

 Please submit your application through our careers site. We do not accept applications via email.
   

  

 Join the global Xylem team to be a part of innovative technology solutions transforming water usage, conservation, and re-use. Our products impact public utilities, industrial sectors, residential areas, and commercial buildings, with a commitment to providing smart metering, network technologies, and advanced analytics for water, electric, and gas utilities. Partner with us in creating a world where water challenges are met with ingenuity and dedication; where we recognize the power of inclusion and belonging in driving innovation and allowing us to compete more effectively around the world.

title: GCP Looker Practice Lead - Nordics
description:
Are you ready to shape the future of Business Intelligence across the Nordics?
   

  

 At
 **Devoteam** 
 , we deliver innovative technology consulting, and as a premier
 **Google Cloud Partner** 
 we sit at the forefront of the data space. We are looking for a
 **Nordic Looker Practice Lead** 
 to own our Looker capability, drive regional growth, and cement our position as the go-to partner for Google Cloud data solutions.
   

  

 Reporting directly to our
 **Head of Data** 
 , you will own the Looker strategy across the Nordic region. It is a hybrid role that combines technical mastery, strategic leadership, and alliance management.
   

  

 Curious about our projects? We got you: Check out our success stories
   

  

**Job Description**
**What you will do**
* Grow the practice: Lead and scale our Looker engagements across the Nordics, spot new business opportunities, and advise clients on modern analytics.
* Own delivery quality: Act as the guardian of technical excellence — set the standard for LookML development, review the team's work, and ensure our deliverables exceed client expectations.
* Strengthen the Google alliance: Build deep, trust-based relationships with Google's local and regional teams, positioning Devoteam as the preferred partner for selling, architecting, and delivering on Looker.
* Mentor and lead: Develop and upskill our data team, fostering a culture of continuous learning around the modern data stack.
* Partner with sales: Connect market trends with new Looker features and capabilities — including conversational analytics — to shape what we take to clients.


 Want to know more? Check out our people stories on Youtube
   

  

**Qualifications**
**Who you are**
 You are a seasoned data professional who lives and breathes data modelling. You understand that Looker isn't just a visualisation tool — it's a semantic layer that transforms how a business works with data.
   

  

* Looker expertise: Several years of hands-on experience designing, developing, and deploying enterprise Looker solutions. You know LookML deeply, and caching policies, PDTs, and hub-and-spoke architectures are second nature.
* The modern data stack: Strong proficiency on Google Cloud, specifically BigQuery — query optimisation and partitioning come naturally.
* Solution architecture: You design BI and analytics solutions end to end — from the warehouse and modelling layer, through the semantic layer, to consumption. You make deliberate trade-offs about where logic lives (dbt vs LookML and PDTs), how it's governed, and how it scales across teams and environments.
* Data modelling and engineering: Deep SQL knowledge and hands-on experience with transformation tools such as dbt.
* Leadership and advisory: A track record of leading technical teams and the confidence to command the room in stakeholder presentations.


**The ultimate bonus 🚀 Conversational analytics:** 
 Experience bridging data insights and natural language puts you at the very top of our list.
   

  

**Additional Information**
 Devoteam is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels valued and respected. We encourage applications from individuals with diverse backgrounds and experiences.
   

  

* Competitive Compensation: Enjoy a competitive compensation package with an uncapped commission structure, rewarding your hard work and success.
* Comprehensive Benefits: Benefit from comprehensive health insurance, a retirement plan, and generous paid time off.
* Growth Opportunities: Take advantage of excellent opportunities for professional development and career advancement within our growing Google Cloud practice.
* Cutting-Edge Technology: Work with the latest Google Cloud technologies and contribute to impactful projects that transform businesses.
* Dynamic Culture: Be part of a dynamic, supportive, and collaborative team culture that values innovation and personal growth.
* Flexible Work Arrangements: Enjoy flexible work arrangements that allow you to balance your professional and personal life.


 We do plenty of activities, like meet-ups, hackathons, and partnerships. Don’t lose any of them: follow us on LinkedIn and our Instagram page
   

  

**Ready to lead the change?**
 If you have the expertise to scale our Looker practice and the drive to partner with Google, we want to hear from you. Apply today.
   

  

 Devoteam is an equal-opportunity employer. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and are committed to building an inclusive team.

title: CRM Analytics Lead
description:
Gjensidige är ett av Nordens ledande försäkringsbolag noterade på Oslo Börs. Vi är verksamma i Sverige, Norge och Danmark och har totalt cirka 4600 medarbetare. I Sverige etablerades Gjensidige Försäkring år 2007. Här är vi cirka 300 medarbetare placerade i Stockholm, Luleå, Malmö eller Gävle och erbjuder försäkringsprodukter till privatpersoner och företag. Vi säkrar liv, hälsa och värden med utgångspunkt i vår vision "Vi ska känna kunden bäst och bry oss mest".
   

  

****CRM Analytics Lead****
 Nu stärker vi vår CRM- och analysförmåga och söker en
 **CRM Analytics Lead** 
 som vill ta en central roll i att utveckla datadrivna kundstrategier och avancerade analyslösningar. Vi är övertygade om att data, analys och AI kommer att vara avgörande för framtidens kundupplevelser och affärsutveckling inom försäkring.
   

  

****Din roll****
 Som
 **CRM Analytics Lead** 
 blir du en nyckelperson i allt från datautforskning till färdiga modeller i produktion. I rollen har du ett övergripande ansvar för kundanalys, insikter och modellering, och du samarbetar nära både affärens stakeholders och analytiker i andra delar av organisationen. Rollen passar dig som uppskattar variation, tar naturligt ägarskap och framför allt vill använda din kompetens för att skapa verkligt värde. Du kommer att tillhöra organisationen Marknad & Utveckling och rapportera till Chef CRM & Data.
   

  

 Du kommer att:
   

  

* Ta ansvar för hela kedjan: från datautforskning och modellutveckling till drift och uppföljning.
* Utveckla och produktionssätta modeller för churn, retention, kundvärde, segmentering och NBO.
* Analysera kund-, försäljnings- och försäkringsdata för att identifiera affärsmöjligheter.
* Bygga robusta analyslösningar i Databricks med Python och SQL.
* Utveckla dashboards och visualiseringar för ledning och verksamhet.
* Arbeta med både stora datamängder och komplexa, ofullständiga dataset.
* Utforska och implementera nya AI- och analysmetoder.
* Vara en drivande kraft i utvecklingen av datadrivna arbetssätt och strategi inom CRM.


****Vi söker dig som****
* Är självgående, tar egna initiativ och trivs med att äga både strategiska och operativa uppgifter.
* Har erfarenhet av avancerad analys inom försäkring eller närliggande bransch.
* Har erfarenhet av att bygga, validera och produktionssätta prediktiva modeller.
* Har god förståelse för statistiska metoder och maskininlärning.
* Trivs med att arbeta både strategiskt och operativt.
* Omsätter idéer och analyser till handling och arbetar affärsnära för att skapa resultat.
* Har en akademisk utbildning inom statistik, datavetenskap, matematik, teknisk fysik, industriell ekonomi eller motsvarande kvantitativ utbildning.


****Därför ska du välja Gjensidige****
 Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta med några av försäkringsbranschens mest intressanta datautmaningar. Du får stort eget ansvar, moderna verktyg och möjlighet att påverka både teknikval och arbetssätt. Samtidigt blir du en del av en organisation där samarbete, utveckling och kundfokus står i centrum.
   

  

****Vi hörs!****
 Tjänsten är placerad i Stockholm.
   

  

 Låter det intressant? Varmt välkommen med din ansökan senast den 13 september genom att skicka in ditt CV och svara på några frågor i samband med ansökan. Kontakta gärna rekryterande chef Andreas Stenberg, Andreas.Stenberg@gjensidige.se om du har funderingar om tjänsten. Intervjuer görs löpande, så vänta inte med din ansökan.

title: Cloud Security Tech Lead till Handelsbanken
description:
*Vi söker en Cloud Security Tech Lead som vill vara med och forma Handelsbankens molnsäkerhet. Vi har stort fokus på tillgänglighet och säkerhet med strävan mot PaaS och Cloud Native i Azure.*
**Ditt team** 
 Du kommer bli del av ett agilt och tvärfunktionellt team som ansvarar för Cloud-plattformen i Azure. Teamet består av säkerhetsingenjörer, utvecklare och supportpersonal som tillsammans arbetar med att designa, implementera och vidareutveckla lösningar i Azure.
   

  

 Vi samarbetar med andra operativa team inom teknikavdelningen och IT-säkerhetsavdelningen för design, implementation och förvaltning av våra lösningar i Azure. Då vi har högt ställda krav på låg risk och hög säkerhetsnivå är det viktigt att bygga upp ett gott samarbete internt inom IT-säkerhet och compliance.
   

  

**Din roll**
 Rollen som Cloud Security Tech Lead är både operativ och strategisk. Du kommer ansvara för design, implementera och vidareutveckla säkerhetslösningar och vara delaktig i vidareutveckling av arkitektur för Azure. Ditt ansvar innefattar att utvärdera och integrera nya säkerhetsteknologier inom bankens infrastruktur.
   

  

 Du kommer också delta i strategiska beslut som kopplat till bankens moln- och säkerhetsstrategier. Rollen innebär även att du tekniskt kommer vägleda teamet inom säkerhet, och då arbeta nära flera utvecklingsteam för att kontinuerligt integrera säkerhetstänket.
   

  

**Din profil**
 Du har omfattande erfarenhet av att arbeta med molnsäkerhet i Azure, och Microsoft Defender for Cloud. Därtill har du kunskap och praktisk erfarenhet inom infrastruktur, Azure Kubernetes och relevanta PaaS-tjänster. Du är tydligt insatt inom säkerhetsprotokoll och -standarder och kan praktiskt omvandla det till tekniska krav.
   

  

 Du har tidigare ansvarat för att leda säkerhetsarbetet inom närmsta teamet där det är meriterande om du har haft ansvar som säkerhetsarkitekt eller liknande. Vi ser det som meriterande om du har arbetat med andra plattformar on-prem, har Microsoft-certifieringar inom molnsäkerhet, automatisering, IaC, eller JSON.
   

  

 Då vi samarbetar med hela koncernen behöver du behärska god svenska och engelska i både tal och skrift.
   

  

 Rollen innebär samarbete med flera olika delar av koncernen så vi ser det som viktigt att du kan anpassa din kommunikation beroende på mottagaren. Du inkluderar olika perspektiv och framför samtidigt din åsikt på ett tydligt, inlyssnande och respektfullt sätt. Ditt arbetssätt är lösningsorienterat där du tar dig an problemet med den kompetens som finns i teamet. Samtidigt har du förmåga att fatta självständiga beslut och leda teamet mot ett gemensamt mål.

 Som ett steg i Handelsbankens rekryteringsprocess krävs en godkänd bakgrundskontroll på slutkandidat, utförd av en extern part, innan anställning kan ske.
   

  

 Handelsbanken är en del av Sveriges totalförsvar och som bank fyller vi en samhällsviktig funktion tillsammans med den finansiella sektorn. Rollen kan därför komma att omfattas av krigsplacering inom Handelsbanken.
