No
**Job Description:**

**The opportunity**

Are you passionate about engineering and problem solving? Maybe you are – or want to become – an expert within HVDC? Then this opportunity is for you!


We are currently looking for HVDC System Design Engineers. In this role you are responsible for the electrical design and functionality of HVDC converter stations, focusing on the high-voltage system, including main circuit design, insulation coordination and harmonic design.


This advertisement is for the backbone office within HVDC System Design department, where your main task is to support the project execution offices by improving base design and ways of working.


This role is based in Ludvika or Västerås, Sweden.


**How you’ll make an impact**

* Ensure the base design and engineering solutions used in the HVDC converter stations are modularized, robust, productified and useful for the current HVDC market.
* Ensure ways of working (study processes, base reports & models, design principles and design rules etc.) are up to date, simple to use, robust and useful for the project execution departments.
* Actively contribute in internal transformation projects and initiatives.
* Effectively participate in problem-solving discussions where you can present your work, discuss challenges and propose a path forward on a higher level.
* Write clear technical reports describing your complex work in a professional manner.
* Take responsibility for your work activities, deliver with quality and on time.
* Living Hitachi Energy core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business

**Your background**

* You hold a university degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent, with focus on Power Systems or Power Electronics.
* You have a general understanding of electrical power systems and its equipments.
* You encounter problems with a practical engineering mindset, understanding that models and calculations are estimations. But also, that input data could be arbitrary and that some requirements must be challenged and discussed to solve real problems.
* You are a team player with excellent communication and report writing skills.
* Fluent in English both written and verbal.
* Programming experience in MATLAB and Python, and experience of EMT tools like PSCAD is highly advantageous. Experience of working in Azure DevOps is also beneficial.
* Experience in high voltage system engineering, and especially within HVDC, is highly advantageous.
* Experience in process development and productification work is advantageous.

**More about us**

We believe great work thrives in an environment where people feel genuinely supported and fairly rewarded. Our benefits are designed to create real value for every individual – fueling engagement, performance, and growth. By prioritizing well‑being, we build a workplace where personal and organizational success grow together.


Our benefits offering for our roles generally includes:


* Collective agreement, occupational pension & possibility of salary exchange to pension (for ITP1 and ITP2)
* Group life insurance and additional insurances.
* Flex-time and shortening of working hours in time bank
* Hybrid work & allowances for setting up a workplace at home (in agreement with line manager)
* Health care and wellness allowance
* Health insurance incl. dental, spectacles & contact lenses allowance (employee pay 140 sek/month via salary deduction)
* Psychological support program
* Supplementary compensation for parental leave
* Various trainings and education supporting employee development
* Internal career possibilities both within Sweden and globally
* Employee Benefit Portal with thousands of discounts and perks

The benefits listed above are an excerpt only and may vary depending on job grade, location and contract type. Eligibility is subject to local regulations.


Are you ready for a new and exciting opportunity? Does this role sound like a good match for your skills and ambitions? Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, so we encourage you to apply today.


Recruiting manager Casper Karlsson, casper.x.karlsson@hitachienergy.com will be happy to answer your questions regarding this position. All other questions should be directed to Talent Partner Oliver Chicaiza, oliver.chicaiza@hitachienergy.com .


Union representatives – Sveriges Ingenjörer: Mikael Hjort, +46 107-38 29 86; Unionen: Fredrik Holmgren, +46 107-38 21 85; Ledarna: Frank Hollstedt, +46 107-38 70 42.

**Qualified individuals with a disability may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Hitachi Energy career site as a result of your disability. You may request reasonable accommodations by completing a** **general inquiry form** **on our website. Please include your contact information and specific details about your required accommodation to support you during the job application process.**

**As part of our recruitment process, Hitachi Energy uses digital and automated tools, including Al-supported solutions, to assist with activities such as application screening, job matching, and interview scheduling. These tools are designed to support our recruiters and do not replace human decision-making. Candidate data is processed in accordance with applicable data protection and employment laws as well as** **Hitachi's Global Data Privacy Notice.**

**As part of the hiring process, Hitachi Energy conducts pre-employment background checks that may include verification of employment history, education, criminal records, and other relevant information, in accordance with applicable laws.**

title: Cybersecurity Test Engineer-Luleå
description:
**Cybersecurity Test Engineer – Consultant Assignment in Industrial IoT & Cybersecurity**


We at WeQuel are now looking for a Cybersecurity Test Engineer in Luleå, where you become an important part of the client's cybersecurity and product development team with focus on securing industrial IoT solutions against cyber threats. In this role you design and implement security testing strategies and frameworks, and you work closely with the client's existing Cybersecurity Test Engineer to ensure compliance with cybersecurity standards, customer expectations and regulatory requirements.


As a consultant with us, you get the opportunity to work at one of our clients who are leading companies within the bearing industry, industrial technology and IoT, where you contribute to driving the green transition, implementing new technology and creating sustainable, secure solutions. In Northern Sweden the client develops and maintains software, firmware and hardware solutions for industrial condition monitoring – IoT solutions that provide detailed machine health information and actionable insights, enabling the client's customers to predict failures and minimize downtime.

**Your responsibilities:**

* Design and implementation of security testing systems and test environments
* Integration of security testing into the product development lifecycle
* Vulnerability assessments, penetration testing and security scanning of products
* Responsibility for test laboratory equipment and environments
* Maintenance and improvement of test rig equipment
* Identification, investigation and analysis of security breaches and vulnerabilities
* Reporting of test results and support in incident response when security gaps are identified
* Forensic investigations and root cause analyses
* Regular system testing and risk assessments
* Development and promotion of cybersecurity testing best practices across the organization
* Support in customer-facing activities during development when required


You work in a dynamic environment where you independently drive your own flow forward while collaborating with several interfaces within the organization.

**Requirements:**

* Proven experience as Cybersecurity Engineer, Test Engineer or similar role
* University degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity or related field
* Fluent in Swedish and English, spoken and written, with excellent communication skills in English
* Experience with security testing tools, methodologies and technologies
* Strong understanding of cybersecurity risks related to digital product security
* Knowledge of network security protocols, security architecture and IP networking
* Experience from agile development environments
* Self-motivated, proactive and accountable

**Preferred qualifications:**

* 3–5 years of experience testing embedded systems
* Cybersecurity and product security standards such as EN 18031 and IEC 62443
* Strong programming skills in C, C++ and/or Python
* Embedded Linux and Yocto
* Azure DevOps (ADO), Git and GitHub
* Wi-Fi, BLE, LTE, Ethernet and eMMC
* Wireless Mesh Networks
* MQTT, Modbus TCP and OPC UA
* U-Boot and Over-the-Air (OTA) firmware updates
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
* Ability to work effectively under pressure
* High attention to detail and strong interest in emerging technologies and cybersecurity threats

**Assignment details**

* Location: Luleå, Sweden
* Start: 2026-10-01
* End: 2027-05-02
* Workload: 100%
* Remote: 0% – 100% ONSITE in Luleå

**We offer:**


At WeQuel you become part of a consultant team that values people first – we believe success is created through commitment, collaboration and development. We offer a flat organization with short decision paths, a strong sense of community and the opportunity to influence your own development.

title: Site Reliability Engineer – Data & Analytics at SEB in Stockholm
description:
*SEB is more than a bank. We are a technology-driven financial institution where everything starts from our customer needs and business outcomes. AI, data and modern engineering are natural parts of how we work, build and deliver value. From core banking platforms to agentic AI , automation, cybersecurity and cloud, we offer a broad tech landscape and many paths to grow. Together, we are shaping secure, responsible and future- proof solutions for our customers and society. Are you ready to take on a new challenge?*
 Our tribe Data and Analytics lead all parts of SEB in becoming a data driven company, and we are looking for a Site Reliability Engineer to strengthen our team in Stockholm working in the area of large-scale data solutions
   

  

  

  

**About The Job**
 You will be part of our Data & AI Platform Foundation team with the mission to provide a future-proof, reliable and efficient data platform for SEB. Together with your colleagues you will be responsible for building platform services that support , batch processing and operations, workflow automation and orchestration, monitoring, hybrid cloud integration with GCP and much more. Everything with security and automation in mind. You will have the opportunity to broaden your competence and will be given a generous amount of time for your own ideas and projects.
   

  

 We belong to the SEB Data & Analytics tribe, an international environment with multiple agile development teams located in Stockholm and Vilnius, consisting of experts in various Big Data technologies.
   

  

**Who are you?**
 In order to thrive here you should be interested in data engineering and like finding creative solutions to complex problems. If you are analytical, curious and have a passion for discovering new ways of working, you will enjoy it here.
   

  

**Required Skills**
* Experience from working in Linux environments.
* Cloud engineering experience.
* Programming and scripting skills (e.g. bash, python)
* An automation, DevOps, SRE mindset.
* Collaboration skills and high sense of responsibility. We are working team/squad based, and the ability to share knowledge and experience is fundamental.


 Nice-to-have

title: Cloud Site Reliability Engineer
description:
*Drivs du av att se dina idéer bli verklighet? Välkommen till vår spännande och teknikintensiva värld.*
**Din roll**
 Vi söker en Cloud Site Reliability Engineer som vill kombinera mjukvaruutveckling, automatisering och systemdrift för att skapa robusta och skalbara molnplattformar. Här får du arbeta med teknik som är central för våra digitala lösningar och bidra till att våra plattformar är stabila, säkra och tillgängliga över tid.
   

  

 Som Cloud Site Reliability Engineer blir du en del av Cloud & Infrastructure inom Core Development Platform. Teamet utvecklar och förvaltar gemensamma moln- och IT-plattformstjänster inom Saab Surveillance.
   

  

 I rollen arbetar du i gränslandet mellan utveckling och drift med fokus på stabilitet, automation och kontinuerliga förbättringar. Du arbetar med våra hybrida molnmiljöer och bidrar till att minska manuellt arbete genom automatisering, samtidigt som du säkerställer hög tillgänglighet, prestanda och säkerhet.
   

  

 Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter inkluderar:
   

  

* Utveckla, driftsätta och vidareutveckla plattformar baserade på Kubernetes, OpenStack och Ceph
* Automatisera infrastruktur och deployment med Infrastructure as Code och CI/CD
* Utveckla och övervaka robusta och skalbara nätverkslösningar
* Arbeta med incidenthantering, analys, post-mortems och kapacitetsplanering
* Administrera och vidareutveckla Linux-baserade system, exempelvis OpenStack-kontrollplan, worker-noder och Ceph-kluster
* Bidra till observability, monitorering och kontinuerliga förbättringar av plattformens stabilitet och prestanda


**Din profil**
 Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av Site Reliability Engineering, Platform Engineering eller liknande roller och som trivs med att arbeta nära både utveckling och drift. Du har en bred teknisk förståelse och är van vid att arbeta med komplexa plattformsmiljöer där automatisering, säkerhet och stabilitet står i fokus.
   

  

 Du har ett genuint intresse för AI och ny teknik, och drivs av att utforska hur dessa verktyg kan användas för att utveckla både våra lösningar och våra arbetssätt. Du är nyfiken, lösningsorienterad och initiativtagande, tycker om att samarbeta och dela kunskap.
   

  

 Vi tror att du har erfarenhet av flera av följande områden:
   

  

* Kubernetes, OpenStack och Ceph
* AWS och hybrida molnmiljöer
* Linux och nätverk
* Infrastructure as Code och CI/CD
* Observability och monitorering
* DevSecOps och automatiserad säkerhetsskanning
* Security hardening av infrastruktur och plattformar


 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av att ta ett tekniskt ledarskap och driva frågor tillsammans med tvärfunktionella team.
   

  

*Befattningen kräver att du genomgår och godkänns enligt vid var tid gällande bestämmelser för säkerhetsskydd. För befattningar där Saab har krav på säkerhetsklassinplacering kan, i förekommande fall, medföra krav på visst medborgarskap.*
 Vad du blir en del av
   

  

 Upptäck oändliga möjligheter. Anta utmaningar, skapa smarta innovationer och uppgradera dina förmågor. Det här är en plats för kluriga tänkare, modiga pionjärer och alla däremellan. Tillsammans uppnår vi det extraordinära, var och en tar med sitt unika perspektiv. Varje bidrag räknas.
   

  

 Saab är ett ledande försvars- och säkerhetsföretag med uppdrag att hjälpa nationer att skydda sin befolkning och bidrar till trygghet för människor och samhällen. Med 26,100 talangfulla medarbetare utvecklar Saab teknik och lösningar för en säkrare och mer hållbar värld.
   

  

 Saab utvecklar, tillverkar och underhåller avancerade system inom flygteknik, vapen, ledningssystem, sensorer och undervattenssystem. Saab har sitt huvudkontor i Sverige men en global verksamhet där Saab är en del av många nationers försvarsförmåga. Läs mer om oss här

title: Senior Platform Engineer
description:
EQT is looking for a Senior Platform Engineer to join our engineering platform team in Stockholm. This is a hands-on role for an experienced engineer who enjoys building reliable platforms, working closely with teams, and driving long-term impact.
   

  

**About The Engineering Platform Team**
 The engineering platform team builds and operates EQT’s core platform, enabling product teams to run secure, reliable, and scalable services, data-products and agentic ai. The team works closely with developers and security partners, with a strong focus on automation, standards, and operational excellence.
   

  

**About The Role**
 In this role, you will work across EQT’s engineering platform and lead the design and delivery of key platform initiatives. You will collaborate with teams across the organization to drive adoption, improve reliability, and enhance the developer experience.
   

  

* Lead the design, architecture, and rollout of platform projects from start to finish.
* Collaborate with engineers across the organization to align on platform standards and best practices.
* Operate and continuously improve the engineering platform.
* Contribute to on-call rotations and support platform reliability.
* Improve platform reliability, security, and developer experience.
* Support incident response, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis.


**About You**
 You enjoy working in a high-trust environment and take ownership of building strong technical foundations. You are collaborative, structured in your approach, and motivated by enabling others to succeed.
   

  

**Essential skills and experience:**
* Experience as a senior Platform, SRE, or Infrastructure Engineer.
* Proven experience leading platform projects from concept through to production.
* Hands-on experience running Kubernetes production environments.
* Experience working with cloud platforms, preferably Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Experience with infrastructure as code, preferably Terraform.
* Familiarity with GitOps and CI/CD workflows.


 Tech Stack / Environment: GCP, GKE, ArgoCD, Gatekeeper, Cilium, Terraform, CircleCI, GitHub, Cloudflare, Datadog, incident.io, Snowflake, DBT, Hex, Go, Python, Next.js
   

  

**Nice to have:**
* Experience with platform security.
* Knowledge of authentication and identity systems.
* Strong networking knowledge across cloud and Kubernetes environments.
* Interest in the Agentic AI ecosystem
* Experience improving platform and production environment resilience.


**What We Offer**
 At EQT, you will work in a collaborative and high-trust environment where your ideas and contributions matter. You will have the opportunity to shape a modern engineering platform, work with experienced colleagues, and continue to grow your skills while delivering meaningful impact.
   

  

**Inclusion at** 
**EQT**
*Our vision for EQT employees is to build high performing & engaged teams. Our competitive edge comes from fostering an environment where every individual feels valued, empowered, and motivated to drive business impact. Our commitment to inclusion is not just about fairness; We understand and believe that being a great place to work drives the best performance.At EQT, inclusion is a business imperative and it's embedded into our talent strategy, decision-making, and culture to ensure that every individual and team operates at their full potential. By doing so, we unlock better collaboration, stronger innovation, and superior investment outcomes.*
**About EQT**
*EQT is a purpose-driven global investment organization focused on active ownership strategies. With a Nordic heritage and a global mindset, EQT has a track record of over three decades of developing companies across multiple geographies, sectors and strategies. EQT has investment strategies covering all phases of a business’ development, from start-up to maturity. EQT has EUR ‌ 270 billion in total assets under management (EUR ‌ ‌141 billion in fee-generating assets under management), within two business segments – Private Capital and Real Assets.
   

  

 With its roots in the Wallenberg family’s entrepreneurial mindset and philosophy of long-term ownership, EQT is guided by a set of strong values and a distinct corporate culture. EQT manages and advises funds and vehicles that invest across the world with the mission to future-proof companies, generate attractive returns and make a positive impact with everything EQT does. EQT has offices in more than 25 countries across Europe, Asia and the Americas and has more than 1,900 employees.*
*More info: www.eqtgroup.com
   

  

 Follow EQT on LinkedIn, X, YouTube and Instagram*

title: Staff / Principal Software Engineer, Infrastructure Security
description:
**TL;DR** 
 You'll be the most senior engineer making sure Lovable's infrastructure is impossible to compromise. Cloud, identity, build pipelines, and runtime - yours to harden.
   

  

**Why Lovable?**
 Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.
   

  

 We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.
   

  

 Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.
   

  

**What We're Looking For**
* 8+ years in infrastructure or cloud security, with at least 3 at staff/principal level.
* Deep expertise in GCP, AWS, and Cloudflare security primitives - IAM, network, KMS, workload identity, edge security.
* Hands-on with Kubernetes, Terraform, Wiz, GitHub Actions, and modern CI/CD - and a clear view on supply-chain security (SLSA, sigstore, SBOMs).
* Comfort writing Go, Python, or Rust to ship guardrails as code, not policies as PDFs.
* Track record of measurably reducing blast radius - secrets, lateral movement, prod access - at a high-growth company.
* Bonus: experience securing multi-tenant platforms or LLM/agent-driven infrastructure.


**What You'll Do**
* Set the technical direction for cloud, identity, and build/runtime security at Lovable.
* Design and ship guardrails: workload identity, least-privilege IAM, network segmentation, secrets management, and prod access.
* Harden the supply chain end-to-end - from developer laptop to production deploy.
* Partner with Platform, SRE, and the Lovable Apps Platform team to make the secure path the easy path.
* Mentor engineers across the company and raise the security bar by default, not by review.


 Our tech stack
   

  

* Frontend: React and Typescript.
* Backend: Golang and Rust.
* Cloud: Cloudflare, GCP, AWS, multiple LLM providers.
* DevOps & Tooling: GitHub Actions, Grafana, OTEL, infra-as-code (Terraform).
* Data: Clickhouse, Firestore, Spanner, BigQuery.


 And we’re always exploring what’s next!
   

  

**About Your Application**
 Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.
   

  

 We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

title: Senior Backend Engineer | Routing Team
description:
The challenge
   

  

 Every day, thousands of parcels need to find the fastest, cheapest, most accurate route to someone's door — across Sweden and beyond. That's a Traveling Salesman Problem at massive scale, and it's what the Routing Team solves, live, in production.
   

  

 As a Senior Backend Engineer, your code doesn't sit in a backlog. It ships, and the next day it's already changing distribution costs, delivery accuracy, and the experience of thousands of customers.
   

  

 The team
   

  

 You'll join a small, senior, highly collaborative squad: three backend developers, one frontend developer, two algorithm engineers, one ML engineer, an Engineering Manager, a Product Manager, and a Staff Engineer. Low cross-team dependencies mean you can actually drive projects from idea to production — fast.
   

  

 Tech stack
   

  

 🐹 Backend
   

  

 Golang (primary), with legacy Java and Node.js
   

  

 🖥️ Frontend
   

  

 React + Next.js
   

  

 🗄️ Data
   

  

 PostgreSQL, MongoDB
   

  

 ☁️ Infra
   

  

 GCP, Kubernetes (Helm), Terraform
   

  

 🔁 CI/CD & Observability
   

  

 GitHub Actions, Grafana
   

  

 What you'll own
   

  

* Design, build, and ship backend features end-to-end — including proposing the projects worth building
* Modernize legacy services (Java/Node) into scalable Go-based architecture
* Set the bar for clean, maintainable, well-documented code
* Partner with Product to turn technical solutions into KPI impact
* Lead incident response and turn root causes into long-term fixes
* Mentor engineers and help shape a strong technical culture


 What we're looking for
   

  

* Solid, hands-on experience with Go (or another strongly-typed language) in production
* A track record of designing and scaling distributed systems/APIs in the cloud — GCP or AWS
* Comfortable with Kubernetes/Helm, Terraform, and SQL
* You raise problems before they become incidents, and you help fix them
* You make sound decisions under ambiguity, and you enjoy giving/getting feedback
* You care where your code actually lands — in a truck, on a route, at someone's door
* Bonus: you've worked across legacy stacks and enjoy bringing old systems up to modern standards.


 Why this role
   

  

* Real-world impact, fast. Your work reaches thousands of people daily — not after a year of roadmap, but this quarter.
* See it in action. Visit our sorting terminals, ride along with a delivery driver, or shadow ops for a day — build with real context, not assumptions.
* Build, don't just maintain. Regular Hack Days let you take an idea from proof-of-concept to production.
* Tools that keep up with you. Paid licenses for IDEs and AI coding agents.
* Grow with modern tech, without being cut off from where it came from — you'll touch legacy systems too, and get to fix them properly.


 Perks
   

  

 🏢 Newly renovated office with a 360° view over Stockholm
   

  

 🐶 Dog-friendly, with a floor for your furry coworker
   

  

 🏓 Ping pong, shuffleboard, foosball, karaoke room
   

  

 ⏰ Flexible hybrid hours
   

  

 👶 6 months of parental pay top-up
   

  

 🎂 A day off on your birthday
   

  

 We're committed to building an inclusive team where different perspectives are valued and everyone has room to grow.
   

  

*This role requires a background check via Svensk Bakgrundsanalys, which includes a review of public criminal records. The results are handled confidentially as part of our standard recruitment process in Sweden.*
**Ready to make thousands of routes a little smarter every day?** 
 Apply below — we'd love to hear from you.
   

  

 Instabee Group, with consumer-facing brands Budbee, Instabox, and Porterbuddy, brings together years of experience in delivery. Today, Instabee Group is present in five markets, serving thousands of online merchants and millions of consumers with seamless home deliveries and convenient parcel locker deliveries, using the best fuel available. With smart technology, a strong focus on sustainability, and a secure supply chain, Instabee has become a trusted partner for online merchants and a preferred choice for consumers.

title: Teknisk informationsspecialist till Regionarkivet
description:
Vi söker dig som vill vara med och utveckla och förvalta Regionarkivets digitala tjänster och tekniska lösningar för e-arkiv. Vill du vara med och forma framtidens informationshantering i en verksamhet som ligger i nationell framkant? Då kan detta vara rätt uppdrag för dig!
   

  





**Om oss**




 Enheten för arkiv- och informationsförvaltning ansvarar för att bevara och tillgängliggöra Region Stockholms information, från historiska arkiv från 1800-talet till dagens digitala informationsflöden. Vi arbetar med att ta emot, förbereda och långsiktigt förvalta både analoga och digitala arkiv, med ett framåtblickande fokus på e-arkiv och information inom e-hälsoområdet.
   

  





 Regionarkivet är nationellt ledande inom e-arkiv och driver utvecklingen av framtidens digitala långtidsbevarande. Som Region Stockholms arkivmyndighet säkerställer vi att information bevaras, vårdas och görs tillgänglig för verksamheter, myndigheter, forskning och allmänhet, både idag och för kommande generationer.
   

  





**Om tjänsten** 



 I rollen arbetar du med förvaltning, utveckling och support av Regionarkivets e-tjänster för arkivering. Du arbetar med teknisk förvaltning av bland annat e-arkiv, ETL-lösningar, databaser och andra centrala tjänster, samt utvecklar verktyg för hantering av digital information. Arbetet omfattar även systemadministration, informationssäkerhet, behörighetshantering och lokal support för våra tjänster. Du deltar i utvecklingsinitiativ och bidrar till att skapa effektiva lösningar för långsiktigt bevarande, tillgängliggörande och användning av information i Region Stockholms e-arkiv.
 
**Vem är du?**




 Som person trivs du med att samarbeta med andra för att nå gemensamma mål. Du har ett positivt, nyfiket och professionellt förhållningssätt och tycker om att lära dig nya saker och sätta dig in i ny teknik. Du är självgående, strukturerad och tar ansvar för att planera och driva ditt arbete framåt. Rollen innebär både självständigt arbete och nära samarbete med kollegor och andra kontaktytor, vilket ställer krav på god kommunikationsförmåga och förmåga att förklara tekniska frågor på ett tydligt och pedagogiskt sätt. Du är lösningsorienterad och motiveras av att analysera problem och hitta effektiva lösningar. Vidare har du ett helhetsperspektiv och förstår hur ditt arbete bidrar till verksamhetens övergripande mål och utveckling.
   

  





 För att lyckas med uppdraget har du:
 


* Högskoleutbildning inom IT, exempelvis inom datavetenskap, systemvetenskap, datateknik, data engineering eller programvaruutveckling alternativt annan utbildning som arbetsgivaren bedömer som likvärdig.
* Erfarenhet av arbete med objektorienterad programmering, exempelvis i Python eller C#, samt utveckling i JavaScript och gärna moderna ramverk som React eller .NET.
* Erfarenhet av arbete med databashantering och SQL, gärna Microsoft SQL Server och Transact-SQL.
* Erfarenhet av arbete med XML, XSLT samt ETL-processer, dataintegration eller andra lösningar för dataflöden och informationshantering.
* God förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska.


 Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av IT-support, data engineering, Windowsadministration, Active Directory och GPO:er samt arbete med Elasticsearch eller liknande sök- och analysplattformar. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.
 
**Vårt erbjudande**




 Vi erbjuder dig en utvecklande roll där du får vara med och utveckla, förvalta och vidareutveckla framtidens e-arkiv i en verksamhet med stor samhällsnytta. Tillsammans med ett kompetent och engagerat team arbetar du med tekniska lösningar som säkerställer att viktig information kan bevaras, tillgängliggöras och användas över tid. Som en del av ett regionarkiv i framkant får du arbeta i en unik miljö med ett av Sveriges största medicinska arkiv, komplex informationshantering och en specialiserad IT-miljö där du bidrar till en samhällsviktig funktion.
   

  





 Vi har kollektivavtal och med det följer kollektivavtalade försäkringar, tjänstepension och möjlighet till löneväxling. För att du ska kunna ta ansvar för din hälsa erbjuder vi friskvårdstimme och friskvårdsbidrag, subventionerad sjukvård i form av kostnadsfri öppensjukvård samt flexibel arbetstid. Här kan du läsa mer om förmånerna i vårt kollektivavtal.
   

  





 Regionarkivet finns i rymliga och nyrenoverade lokaler i Flemingsberg med egna kontor och tillgång till eget gym.
   

  





**Ansökan**




 Låter det här som något för dig ser vi gärna att du söker så snart som möjligt. För en komplett ansökan räcker det med att bifoga ditt CV. När du ansöker kommer du att få besvara ett antal frågor, dessa ersätter personligt brev.
   

  





 Har du frågor om uppdraget är du välkommen att kontakta rekryterande chef, Anders Söderlind, anders.soderlind@regionstockholm.se.
   

  





**Övrigt**




 Tester kan komma att ingå i rekryteringsprocessen. Vi använder oss av Assessios tester MAP och Matrigma. MAP är ett personlighetstest och Matrigma är ett problemlösningstest som båda bygger på arbetspsykologisk forskning. Testerna används som ett komplement till dina erfarenheter och kompetenser. 
   

  





 Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!
   

  





 Kulturförvaltningen arbetar för att regionens invånare får tillgång till ett rikt och mångsidigt kulturliv. Med ekonomiskt stöd, som beslutas av Region Stockholms kulturnämnd, stöttar förvaltningen kultur- och föreningslivet i länet. Kulturförvaltningen arbetar också med konst och kultur i vården. Kulturnämnden är även arkivmyndighet för Region Stockholm. Läs mer här. Följ oss gärna på Linkedin.
   

  





****Att söka jobb i Region Stockholm****




 Vi eftersträvar jämställdhet och jämlikhet på vår arbetsplats och ser gärna sökande med olika bakgrund och förutsättningar.
   

  





 Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via detta system. Ansök genom att klicka på knappen ”Ansök”. Ansökningar per brev eller e-post beaktas inte. Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt säljare av ytterligare jobbannonser.
   

  





 Vårt rekryteringssystem kan inte hantera anonyma ansökningar eller sökande med skyddade personuppgifter. Om du har skyddade personuppgifter ber vi dig att kontakta den kontaktpersonen som finns angiven i annonsen. Din ansökan kommer då att hanteras utanför rekryteringssystemet. Du bör även vara försiktig med vilken information du lämnar i din ansökan och endast ta med information som är relevant för den aktuella befattningen.

title: Solution Architect FX for the Trading Technology Area | SEB, Solna
description:
Do you want to be part of strengthening SEB's market position in FX? We're currently looking for a Solution Architect to join our team.
   

  

 SEB is more than a bank. We are a technology-driven financial institution where everything starts from our customer needs and business outcomes. AI, data and modern engineering are natural parts of how we work, build and deliver value. From core banking platforms to agentic AI , automation, cybersecurity and cloud, we offer a broad tech landscape and many paths to grow. Together, we are shaping secure, responsible and future- proof solutions for our customers and society. Are you ready to take on a new challenge?
   

  

**About the role:**
 As a Solution Architect within Trading, you will be part of a team accountable for driving the architectural agenda for FX. Your responsibility will be to evolve the architecture in line with the business objectives for FX, with a strong focus on Cloud, AI/Data, API and Security. You will help shape the strategic agenda for the application portfolio, design solutions, provide solution alternatives, and detail roadmaps towards the target architecture.
   

  

 We are looking for a Solution Architect with a solid developer background, who can combine hands-on technical depth with leadership abilities and strong collaboration skills. You are expected to have been part of technology transformation journeys, including modernizing existing IT landscapes as well as major system replacements.
   

  

 The architecture team within Trading consists of Solution Architects led by a Domain Architect. Together we combine deep technical skills with strong business knowledge. We believe in teamwork, learning from each other, and building solutions together.
   

  

 You will also be part of the FX Tribe, which includes teams from Trading Technology and Trading Services, all working closely together to support the FX business.
   

  

 While technical skills and experience are important, we believe that motivation, curiosity, and the ability to learn are equally critical for success in this role. In addition to describing your qualifications, we would like applicants to explain what motivates them to apply for this role and what interests them about working with architecture, trading technology, and large-scale modernization initiatives at SEB.
   

  

**To be successful in this role, we believe you have:**
* A strong developer background with experience in designing and building system
* Experience in designing architectures that integrate diverse technologies and platforms
* Proven ability to drive and contribute to large-scale technology transformations, both modernization of existing platforms and full-scale system replacements
* Broad interest in various architecture domains, including business, application, information, and technology
* Experience with APIs, modular architecture, test-driven development, and data-centric designs
* Strong collaboration skills with the ability to influence, engage, and guide both business, IT stakeholders and tech leads.
* Experience in regulations and directives relevant to financial markets
* A proactive and strategic mindset, with the ability to translate vision into actionable roadmaps
* Experience in cyber security and security architecture is merited
* Experience from the financial industry, particularly capital markets, is a strong plus. If not, a strong interest in learning about financial instruments is expected
* Experience using LLMs as part of your development workflow, either professionally or through personal projects.
* Fluency in English


 Our selection process includes a programming test, a final architecture case interview, and HR assessments. The final stage is a case interview based on a realistic technology modernization scenario. No prior preparation is required.
   

  

 As part of the application, the candidate must explicitly describe:
   

  

* their experience in designing and building systems
* their role in large-scale technology transformations
* their collaboration skills.


 We are not looking for a perfect answer, but for how you think as an architect. We will assess your ability to analyze complex challenges, evaluate trade-offs, balance business and technical needs, and communicate clear architectural recommendations. Strong performance is characterized by structured thinking, curiosity, sound reasoning, and the ability to translate strategy into actionable roadmaps.
   

  

**What we offer:**
* Extensive training and learning opportunities
* Attractive compensation and benefits
* Access to SEB staff banking with exclusive benefits
* Opportunities to help transform an industry
* Chances to make an impact on social or environmental issues
* Agile and modern ways of working
* Deliver world-class service to customers


 Do you want to be part of SEB? It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.
   

  

 Since we select candidates continuously, feel free to send in your application today via the link in this ad, but no later than
 **30-09-2026.** 
 If you have questions about the position, please contact Andreas Höjgård, andreas.hojgard@seb.se, but we will not process applications via email.
   

  

 Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes for example identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and history of crime. In some cases, we also apply random drug checks. During employment, employees within SEB can also expect to undergo recurring background checks. SEB Sweden has a redeployment responsibility, why this position might be covered by internal redeployment.
   

  

 Learn more about working at SEB on our Career website or through our Career podcasts. https://sebgroup.com/career

title: Senior Backend Developer
description:
**Role Description**
 In your new developer role, you will take part in building the
 **3DAI™ City platform** 
 . It is a scalable answer to the growing demand for data about the urban environment and part of our efforts in smart city development. You will play an important role in designing, building and scaling the platform. 3DAI™ City is still a young product, and you will have a lot to contribute and freedom to shape the project.
   

  

* You will be responsible for growing our platform for storing, processing, and visualizing massive amounts of geospatial and time-series data.
* You will use your experience to design efficient solutions for our backend systems.
* You will have the opportunity to create innovative technologies that will directly help road managers reduce carbon emissions and save lives by improving road safety.


**Who You Are**
* You have 5+ years of backend experience (or a proven track record of equivalent depth) building production-grade services using Node.js, TypeScript, and AWS, with a solid grasp of REST APIs and GraphQL.
* You are highly experienced with geospatial and time-series data, bringing hands-on knowledge of specialized tools and databases (such as PostGIS) to solve complex spatial and temporal data challenges.
* You have hands-on experience with Serverless computing or Infrastructure as Code (IaC), using tools like AWS CloudFormation, Docker, or the Serverless Framework to reliably deploy, manage, and scale cloud resources.
* You can own features end-to-end, translating high-level specifications into clean, maintainable web services—handling everything from database schemas and security to logging, monitoring, and scaling.
* You understand distributed systems and are comfortable designing and reasoning about asynchronous processing, caching, queues, and service-to-service communication.
* You embrace agentic workflows and AI-assisted development, leveraging tools like Cursor or Claude Code to accelerate delivery, refactor complex codebases, and automate tasks, all while maintaining strict engineering standards.
* You champion code quality, treating unit and integration testing as essential, while continuously keeping up with modern software engineering best practices.
* You are a collaborative team player who enjoys sharing knowledge, embraces feedback, and is driven by the desire to see your ideas successfully deployed into production.


**Bonus points**
 You have experience working with any of these systems or technologies:
   

  

* High-performance relational, analytical, or NoSQL databases.
* Messaging and event-driven systems such as SQS, SNS, Kafka, or similar.
* Observability tools for logging, monitoring, tracing, and alerting.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines and production deployment workflows.


**What We Offer**
**Environment**
* Prime Stockholm location – Modern, bright facilities steps from Skanstull (Södermalm), one of Stockholm's most vibrant neighborhoods
* A Global Tribe: Join a world-class team of experts from every corner of the globe. We pride ourselves on an open, inclusive, and genuinely friendly culture where your voice is heard.
* Culture of Learning: Stay at the bleeding edge with our Weekly Lunch & Learns—we provide the food, you provide the curiosity.


****Freedom & Flexibility****
* Work Your Way: We trust our experts. Enjoy flexible work hours and a hybrid setup that allows for a seamless work-from-home balance.


****Health & Wealth****
* Wellness First: We support your active lifestyle with a 5,000 SEK annual wellness grant (friskvårdsbidrag) to use on gym memberships, yoga, or whatever keeps you moving.
* Securing Your Future: Rest easy knowing you’re covered by a comprehensive occupational pension plan (tjänstepension) and a benefits package designed for long-term peace of mind.

title: Objektledare it till stadsledningskontoret
description:
**Välkommen till oss**
 Enheten för systemstöd arbetar dagligen med stadens fortsatta digitalisering, där stadens kvalitetsprogram vägleder arbetet. Våra förvaltningsobjekt utvecklas kontinuerligt för att skapa nytta för stadens verksamheter och öka förmågan att hantera och nyttiggöra information, data och statistik. Enheten för systemstöd samordnar, förvaltar och utvecklar de system och förvaltningsobjekt utvecklings- och hr-avdelningen ansvarar för, bland annat Centrala hr-system, Beslutsstöd, Öppna och delade data samt Stadens geografiska informationssystem.
   

  

 Enheten kommer från och med nästa år att även ansvara för den it-nära förvaltningen av fler av avdelningens system bland annat ett centralt hyresadminstrativt system och ett centralt system för verksamhetsplanering och verksamhetsuppföljning.
   

  

 I ansvaret ingår att enheten:
   

  

* förvaltar och utvecklar Beslutsstöd (stadens Business Intelligence-plattform)
* möjliggör framtagning av statistik och information för stadens verksamheter
* förvaltar stadens geografiska informationssystem
* samordnar stadens geodataarbete
* förvaltar och utvecklar stadens interna och externa dataportal
* driver stadens arbete med öppna och delade data
* utvecklar och förvaltar stadens lönesystem och övriga centrala hr-system i enlighet med lagar, avtal och processer
* erbjuder utbildning i systemen och driver nätverk i staden för de system som enheten ansvarar för
* ansvarar för upphandling, konfigurering och införande av system
* är beställare gentemot serviceförvaltningen inom området lön och pension samt rekrytering.


 Hos oss arbetar du med möjliggörande teknik i nära samverkan med verksamheten med ett tydligt fokus på att skapa nytta för stadens verksamheter och invånare.
   

  

**Vi erbjuder dig**
 Hos oss får du möjlighet att arbeta i en dynamisk och framåtblickande miljö där ditt arbete gör skillnad för Stockholms utveckling. Du kommer att samarbeta med engagerade kollegor på avdelningen och i staden och tillsammans med stadens leverantörer vara med och driva utveckling och innovativa lösningar som skapar nytta för stadens verksamheter. Ett nytt metodstöd inom området informations- och it-säkerhet samt dataskydd kommer att stötta dig i det it-nära arbetet så att dessa viktiga frågor omhändertas och säkerställs.
   

  

 Arbetsplatsen är centralt belägen i fina lokaler på Kungsholmen. Vi har flextidsavtal, friskvårdsbidrag samt möjlighet till växling av semesterdagstillägg mot extra ledighet. Här kan du läsa mer om Stockholms stads förmåner.
   

  

**Din roll**
 Som objektledare it ansvarar du för den it-nära förvaltningen och utvecklingen av enhetens system och förvaltningsobjekt. Inledningsvis kommer du bland annat att arbeta med ett centralt hyresadministrativt system samt ett centralt system för verksamhetsplanering och verksamhetsuppföljning.
   

  

 Du är länken mellan teknik och verksamhet och säkerställer att system och it-lösningar är stabila, säkra och hållbara över tid samt ligger i linje med gällande lagar och regelverk. I uppdraget ingår leverantörsstyrning, beställaransvar, kravställning och nära samverkan med objektledare och andra intressenter i och utanför Stockholms stad.
   

  

 Rollen innebär att du växlar mellan strategiskt arbete med målbild och tekniska prioriteringar och operativt arbete med förvaltning och utveckling av systemen.
   

  

**Din kompetens och erfarenhet**
 För denna tjänst krävs det att du har:
   

  

* relevant akademisk examen inom it eller systemvetenskap, eller annan utbildning/erfarenhet som arbetsgivaren bedömer likvärdig
* erfarenhet av leverantörsstyrning samt arbete med leverans av it-tjänster, antingen i en beställarroll eller från leverantörssidan
* aktuell erfarenhet av systemförvaltning och arbete enligt förvaltningsmodeller såsom pm3
* aktuell kunskap och erfarenhet inom informationssäkerhet inklusive kravställning
* gediget intresse för teknik och säkerhetsfrågor inom it
* goda kunskaper i svenska i tal och skrift.


 Det är meriterande om du har:
   

  

* certifiering så som CISM, CISSP eller motsvarande
* aktuell kunskap och erfarenhet inom cybersäkerhet och it-säkerhetsområdet
* erfarenhet av uppdrag inom offentlig/kommunal verksamhet
* erfarenhet som beställare inom offentlig/kommunal verksamhet
* kunskap om metoder inom området informationsarkitektur/verksamhetsarkitektur
* erfarenhet av avtalsuppföljning.


 Vi söker dig som har ett gediget intresse för digitalisering och som drivs av att skapa verksamhetsnytta genom utveckling och ständiga förbättringar. Du är utvecklingsinriktad, ser möjligheter i förändring och arbetar långsiktigt med hållbara och säkra lösningar.
   

  

 Du har god samarbetsförmåga och bygger förtroendefulla relationer med kollegor i stadens olika verksamheter och med stadens leverantörer. Med din helhetssyn ser du samband mellan verksamhetens processer, teknik och mål, och kan göra väl avvägda prioriteringar.
   

  

 Du är kommunikativ och uttrycker dig tydligt i både tal och skrift. Du kan förklara komplexa frågor på ett pedagogiskt sätt och anpassar din kommunikation efter målgrupp och situation samt har ett strukturerat arbetssätt och en förmåga att skapa ordning och tydlighet i komplexa sammanhang
   

  

 Du trivs med att arbeta i en miljö där samarbete, ansvarstagande och lösningsfokus är avgörande för framgång. Du är självgående och tar initiativ för att driva arbetet framåt, även när förutsättningarna förändras.
   

  

**Övrigt**
 Vi rekryterar utan det personliga brevet i denna rekrytering för att stärka fokus på de kompetenser och erfarenheter som efterfrågas för denna roll. Vid bedömningen av din ansökan kommer vi endast att utgå ifrån ditt CV och ett antal frågor du får besvara i samband med att du söker tjänsten. Vi önskar att du svarar konkret och kortfattat på frågorna, och att det finns en tydlig koppling mellan dina svar och ditt CV. Ansökan ska vara på svenska.
   

  

 För att matcha rätt kompetens till rätt jobb använder vi oss av tester. Forskning visar att arbetspsykologiska test, som personlighets- och kapacitetstester, är en av de bästa metoderna. Vi strävar efter en fördomsfri, jämförbar och objektiv rekryteringsprocess där arbetspsykologiska tester är ett komplement i helhetsbedömningen. Du som söker ett jobb hos oss ska vara trygg i att vi fokuserar på att bedöma de kompetenser som är avgörande för jobbet du har sökt.

title: Area Software Architect - Communication Area
description:
Every day, millions of messages are created, personalized, scheduled, and delivered through Voyado Engage. Behind that seemingly simple experience lies one of the most complex distributed systems in our platform.
   

  

 As retailers expect richer personalization, more channels, and increasingly real-time experiences, that complexity is only growing. Our Communication Area owns the end-to-end communication platform, from content creation and personalization to orchestration, delivery, and message tracking across multiple channels.
   

  

 We’re now continuing to evolve the architecture behind that platform. This isn’t about maintaining what already exists. It’s about making sure a business-critical system can keep evolving as our ambitions, volumes, and customer expectations grow.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As Area Architect, you’ll help set the technical direction across the Communication Area. You’ll work closely with engineering teams, tech leads, Area Leadership, and fellow architects, helping teams make architectural decisions that balance what we need to deliver today with where the platform needs to be years from now.
   

  

 This role is about seeing the system beyond individual services and features. You’ll challenge assumptions, identify risks and opportunities before they become blockers, and help teams understand how local decisions affect scalability, reliability, and the evolution of the communication platform as a whole.
   

  

 As part of the Area Leadership, you’ll work alongside our Engineering Manager, Product Lead, and UX Lead, shaping both what we build and how we build it.
   

  

**Some of the things you'll be up to:**
* Shape the technical direction of the Communication Area together with tech leads, engineering teams, and Area Leadership
* Guide teams through architectural trade-offs around scalability, reliability, performance, developer experience, and long-term maintainability
* Review and challenge significant technical proposals, exploring alternatives and strengthening designs before decisions become difficult to reverse
* Look beyond today’s roadmap to identify emerging technical risks, opportunities, and foundational investments that will matter in the years ahead
* Facilitate architectural discussions across teams, creating shared direction rather than isolated solutions
* Coach tech leads and senior engineers, helping them strengthen their architectural thinking and technical leadership
* Collaborate with architects across Voyado to ensure the Communication Area evolves as part of a coherent Engage platform


 So, who are you?
   

  

 We believe you’re an experienced architect or senior technical leader who enjoys working with complex distributed systems where technical decisions have real impact at scale.
   

  

 You combine curiosity with decisiveness. You’ll be joining teams with years of accumulated knowledge about the communication platform, and you won’t be expected to walk in with all the answers. Instead, you take the time to understand the system, its history, and the reasoning behind existing decisions before setting a new direction.
   

  

 You naturally look beyond individual components to understand dependencies, downstream effects, and how today’s decisions shape tomorrow’s platform.
   

  

 We believe you have:
   

  

* Architectural leadership experience across multiple teams or domains, with a track record of guiding others toward consistent technical direction as a technical lead, architect or senior engineer.
* Deep experience with distributed systems and event-driven architecture, including asynchronous processing, message queuing, delivery guarantees, retry strategies, idempotency, and fault tolerance
* Experience with communication or messaging systems at scale, ideally covering several parts of the lifecycle from content creation and personalization to scheduling, delivery, and tracking
* Experience designing integration architectures involving external systems or providers, such as email, SMS, push, or similar delivery services


 Experience with .NET/C#, Azure, high-volume transactional databases, content rendering or templating systems, or communication platforms such as martech, CRM, CDP, or email marketing products is highly valued.
   

  

 What's in it for you?
   

  

 Communication at scale is a genuinely difficult engineering problem. Reliability, personalization, automation, multi-channel complexity, external providers, and high message volumes all need to work together as one coherent system. You’ll be joining while we’re actively investing in the next generation of that platform, including greater channel extensibility, deeper personalization, and more sophisticated automation. That means real architectural problems to solve and the mandate to influence how we solve them.
   

  

**Voyado wouldn’t be the powerful platform it is without the people behind it. We really care for our Voyadoers, and some examples of what we can offer you are:**
* You’ll operate in a culture that values curiosity, open discussion, and constructive challenge - where good ideas triumphs hierarchy
* Summits where we hang out, workshop, discuss, and have a good time together
* Opportunities for personal and professional growth and learning in a dynamic and supportive environment.
* Work-life balance – we don't have a long work-hours culture; we value engagement over hours worked.


 Some of our benefits:
   

  

* 30 days of vacation, so you can spend time on the things you love
* Beneficial bike lease, including e-bikes
* Breakfast buffet on Fridays
* In-house gym only for Voyadoers
* A generous gadget-and-phone package (your choice!)
* 5000 SEK per year in wellness allowance
* Parental leave top-up: additional support for new parents
* A wellness hour you can use every week


**About Voyado**
 Voyado is the ultimate solution for personalization and relevance across all channels—online and offline. Used by retailers and e-commerce companies worldwide, Voyado makes it possible for every brand to engage customers, elevate shopping experiences, and evolve their own businesses.
   

  

 We are now a company of 350+ colleagues on an exciting journey and have recently established a presence in new markets to strengthen our position in Europe. If you are ready for your next adventure and want to join our team on our expansion throughout Europe and have an interest in customer care, e-commerce, retail, and tech - let's get in touch!
   

  

**Be yourself 🏳️‍🌈**
 At Voyado, we believe in gender equality. We are proud sponsors of Womengineer as well as Tjejer Kodar! Read more about Tjejer Kodar & Voyado here
   

  

  

  

 Equality is not only about gender but also about making everyone feel welcome and heard in a multicultural and diverse environment. We at Voyado strive to make everyone feel like they can bring their true self to work every day. Gender-equal and diverse teams have more perspectives on life and bring different ideas to the table, which in the end leads not only to making a better working environment but also a better product.
   

  

 Ready to find out more?
   

  

 Lovely! 🎉
   

  

*Before one applies it can always feel like you need a better resume, more polish, or just another year of experience, but we say if you think this sounds like a place where you can shine don't hesitate to send in your resume!*
**Making it personal with AI**
 We truly believe you’ll position yourself best for success in the interview process by being yourself with support from AI where it makes sense, later in the process you will even be expected to use AI. But at the end of the day, what matters is meeting you, the person behind the application.
   

  

 There is no such thing as a perfect candidate; we’re all human so please, bring your authentic self! Don’t let AI over polish your CV or answers to the point where we can’t hear your real voice because that’s what we care about the most.
   

  

*Note: As of right now we are unable to proceed with applicants outside of the EU, and a requirement of eligibility to work at Voyado is the right to work in the EU without limitations. Needless to say, this is something we are actively working on to be able to onboard colleagues from all over the world.*
 In today’s hyper-competitive market, we help over 500 retail brands across 100 markets attract, convert, and retain loyal customers.
   

  

 With AI-driven CRM, loyalty, e-commerce personalization, and retail media, Voyado turns every interaction - online or in-store - into lasting growth.
   

  

 By combining customer data with product intelligence, we empower retailers to deliver the right message, product, or offer at exactly the right time. The result? Stronger customer relationships and measurable business impact.

title: Infrastructure & Security Manager | Cibes Lift Group | Solna
description:
Are you passionate about IT infrastructure and security? Do you combine strategic leadership with a hands-on approach? Join Cibes Lift Group and play a key role in shaping and securing the future IT landscape of a growing global organization. This position is based on-site in Solna.
   

  

**Shape the Future of Infrastructure & Security**
 As Infrastructure & Security Manager, you will lead the development of the infrastructure and security capabilities that support Cibes Lift Group's operations. From production facilities and offices to field technicians serving customers around the world, you will ensure that critical IT services remain secure, reliable, and fit for future growth.
   

  

 This is a highly visible role where you will work closely with local IT teams, business stakeholders, and colleagues across the group. You will lead a team of specialists while collaborating with managed service providers and strategic partners to drive modernization, standardization, and operational excellence.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities Include**
* Leading and evolving the group's Infrastructure & Security function.
* Ensuring secure, stable, and cost-efficient IT operations across a global organization.
* Driving continuous improvement, collaboration, and accountability within the domain.
* Managing budgets, investments, and service performance while balancing risk, quality, and cost.
* Defining and implementing global IT policies, standards, and governance frameworks.
* Acting as a trusted advisor to business stakeholders and local IT teams.
* Supporting acquisitions and leading IT integration activities for newly acquired companies.
* Contributing to both long-term strategy and hands-on operational initiatives.


**Are You the Leader We're Looking For?**
 We are looking for an experienced IT leader who understands how technology can enable business success. You are equally comfortable discussing long-term strategy with senior stakeholders as you are rolling up your sleeves to solve operational challenges.
   

  

**To succeed in this role, you likely have**
* A relevant university degree or equivalent professional experience.
* Several years of experience within IT Infrastructure and Security.
* Experience driving modernization, transformation, and operational excellence initiatives.
* Strong knowledge of Information Security principles and best practices.
* Proven leadership experience, preferably in an international or/and decentralized environment.
* Experience leading projects and cross-functional initiatives.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Fluent in Swedish and English both written and spoken.
* Permanent authorization to work in Sweden.


**It is considered an advantage if you have**
* Experience with mergers and acquisitions, including IT integration projects.
* Experience with cloud platforms and modern workplace technologies, preferably within the Microsoft ecosystem.


**About You**
 You are a business-oriented and collaborative leader who thrives on translating technology into business value. While you are comfortable setting strategic direction, you are equally willing to engage in operational challenges when needed. Your ability to build trust, foster collaboration, and navigate the balance between global standardization and local requirements enables you to successfully drive change in an international environment.
   

  

**Application**
 In this recruitment process, Cibes Lift Group is partnering with Jefferson Wells. You will be employed directly by Cibes Lift Group.
   

  

 Apply by clicking "Ansök nu" in the advertisement. Please note that, due to GDPR regulations, we do not accept applications via email.
   

  

 For more information about the position or the recruitment process, please contact
   

  

 Marjo Carlson, recruitment consultant; 070 377 06 64, marjo.carlson@jeffersonwells.se
   

  

 Please submit your application as soon as possible, and no later than
 **September 25, 2026.** 
 Selection and interviews are conducted on a rolling basis, and the position may be filled before the closing date.
   

  

 Welcome to Cibes Lift Group and the opportunity to make a real impact on the future of Infrastructure & Security.
   

  

*Cibes Lift Group is one of the world's most innovative manufacturers of space-saving lifts designed for fast and easy installation, also offering a wide range of conventional lift solutions. Thanks to the wide range of lift products and a flexible design concept, the lift solutions of Cibes Lift Group adapt to the requirements of public, commercial, and private settings. Sales, installation, and maintenance services are provided by a global network of subsidiaries and partners. The company group is headquartered in Gävle, Sweden, and has production facilities in Sweden, Poland, China, and USA. In 2026 the Group had approximately 1980 employees and a revenue of 3,6 billion SEK.*

title: Tech Lead
description:
About Evora Labs
  
Evora Labs develops technology for the operation, integration, and management of battery energy storage systems and other distributed energy assets.
  
Our platform helps energy asset owners integrate assets, achieve market readiness, maintain operational availability, and manage technical requirements across energy markets and grid services.
  
About the role
  
As Tech Lead, you will own the technical direction and day-to-day engineering of the Evora platform: the cloud backend, the operator frontend, the EMS edge software that runs at battery sites, and the infrastructure that connects them.
  
You will work close to real assets. The code you write reads Modbus registers from live battery systems, runs prequalification tests against the Swedish TSO's technical requirements, ingests Nordic and continental market data, and dispatches setpoints that a safety envelope on the edge is the last line of defense for.
  
The position combines hands-on full-stack development, system architecture, ownership of the edge and integration layer, technical leadership of a small team, and continuous translation of field experience from live BESS projects into the product.
  
Key responsibilities
  
* Own the architecture and technical roadmap of the Evora platform across backend, frontend, edge, and cloud infrastructure.
* Design and build backend services in Python (FastAPI, SQLAlchemy, asyncpg, Alembic) on top of TimescaleDB, Redis, and MQTT.
* Develop and maintain the EMS edge software: Modbus and vendor-protocol drivers, register maps, control loops, safety envelope, and store-and-forward telemetry over AWS IoT Core.
* Build operator-facing product in the Next.js and React frontend: fleet monitoring, asset and site management, the visual workflow builder, dashboards, and market explorers.
* Own the prequalification engine that drives FCR-N, FCR-D, FFR, aFRR, and mFRR test programs, validates the response against TSO technical requirements, and produces the evidence and


application values.
  
* Integrate battery management systems, power conversion systems, meters, inverters, EV chargers, and heat pumps through Modbus, vendor cloud APIs, and gateway hardware.
* Build and operate the market-data pipelines (ENTSO-E, Svenska kraftnät, Nord Pool style sources) that feed spot, ancillary, and forecast views.
* Extend the platform's agent layer: LLM-driven operations assistants, morning briefings, diagnosis and remediation workflows, and the AI workflow builder, using Claude on AWS Bedrock.
* Run the AWS infrastructure with Terraform: EC2, IoT Core, ECR, S3, IAM, and the CI/CD pipeline that ships backend images and the Vercel-hosted frontend.
* Keep the full-system test suite (app, broker, edge, database) green and extend it as the control loop grows.
* Support commissioning of live BESS sites together with the operations and prequalification team, and investigate communication, control-system, and data issues in the field.
* Set engineering standards for code review, testing, migrations, observability, and documentation, and grow the team as Evora scales.
* Contribute technical expertise in customer discovery, partner integrations, and pre-sales discussions.


Qualifications
  
We are looking for someone who has built and operated production software end to end and who is comfortable going from a battery's register map to a React component in the same day.
  
  

**You should have:**  

* University degree in computer science, software engineering, electrical engineering, automation, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Several years of professional experience building and operating backend systems in Python, preferably with FastAPI or a similar async framework.
* Strong SQL and PostgreSQL skills, and experience with time-series data at scale (TimescaleDB, continuous aggregates, compression, partitioning).
* Experience building modern web frontends with TypeScript and React, preferably Next.js.
* Experience with industrial or IoT communication: Modbus TCP/RTU, MQTT, or comparable protocols, and with software that runs on edge devices or gateways.
* Experience running software on AWS or a comparable cloud, including infrastructure as code (Terraform), containers, and CI/CD.
* Ability to read technical documentation, device specifications, and grid or market requirements, and turn them into working, tested software.
* Experience leading technical work: setting architecture, reviewing code, and mentoring engineers.


Meritorious experience
  
  

**It is considered an advantage if you have experience with:**  

* Battery energy storage systems, EMS, BMS, PCS, meters, or other distributed energy resources.
* Nordic ancillary-service markets and prequalification for FCR, aFRR, mFRR, or FFR.
* Electricity-market data sources such as ENTSO-E, Svenska kraftnät, or Nord Pool.
* LLM-based applications, tool-calling agents, or AI-assisted operational tooling.
* Workflow or orchestration engines (Temporal or similar) and event-driven architectures.
* Federated learning or privacy-preserving analytics on distributed data.
* Edge hardware, balena or similar fleet management, and cellular gateways.
* Full-system or hardware-in-the-loop testing of control systems.


Personal profile
  
You are technically hands-on and enjoy owning a system from the field device up to the user interface.
  
You work systematically, write code that others can read and test, and are comfortable investigating problems that span hardware, communications, databases, and user-facing product.
  
What we offer
  
You will join Evora Labs at an early stage and take a central role in shaping how distributed energy assets are integrated, qualified, and operated through software.
  
The position provides the opportunity to work across the whole stack, from Modbus registers on a battery site to market participation and AI-assisted operations, and to set the technical direction of a growing engineering team.
  
The role is based in Stockholm.

title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer (ML & Data) Stockholm - Hybrid
description:
Senior Full-Stack Engineer (ML & Data)
  
Own our prediction models from training pipeline to customer-facing feature. Strong applied ML — calibration, evals, leakage — plus full-stack TypeScript to ship it.
  
We build AI agents that audit and optimize e-commerce advertising. Our platform syncs live data from Google Ads, Meta, Merchant Center, and Google Analytics, runs it through a rule engine, LLM-powered audit agents, and our own prediction models, and turns findings into concrete actions marketers can apply with one click.
  
**What sets us apart is measurement:** we connect real profit data from our customers' e-commerce platforms to their ad accounts and build models that tell them what their marketing actually returns — not what ad platforms self-report. The ML in our product isn't decoration. Prediction models, calibration, and evaluation pipelines are core to what customers pay for.
  
We're a small team shipping fast on a modern, strictly-typed stack. You'd report directly to the CTO, with real ownership: features you design end-to-end, and models you own from training data to the number a customer sees on screen.
  
The role
  
This is a hybrid role — roughly 60% product engineering, 40% ML & data science. You'll ship full-stack features in our TypeScript monorepo and own prediction models as production software: framing the problem, building training and evaluation pipelines, monitoring calibration drift, and wiring outputs into the product.
  
We're not looking for a research scientist, or a pure web engineer. We want someone who treats a model the way a good engineer treats a service: tested, monitored, versioned, and honest about its failure modes.
  
What you'll do
  
Own prediction models end-to-end — models that predict product returns and net profit per order — training data pipelines, feature engineering, evaluation (ranking quality and calibration), recalibration strategies, and serving model output into the product.
  
Build and maintain data pipelines — SQL feature builders on PostgreSQL shared by training and serving, versioned dataset exports, backfills, and data quality checks that keep training data honest (no leakage, no silent schema drift).
  
Design and build features across our TypeScript monorepo — tRPC procedures and NestJS services on the backend, React on the frontend — so model insights become actions marketers can apply with one click.
  
Work on the AI audit agent — prompt design, rule evaluation, structured-output evals, and plumbing that turns LLM output into reliable, deduplicated actions across multiple model providers.
  
Extend integration workers — sync campaign, product, and analytics data from Google and Meta APIs via Cloud Pub/Sub pipelines.
  
Evolve the data model in PostgreSQL/Prisma — keep migrations, multi-tenancy, and role-based access clean as the product grows.
  
Own quality — write tests (Jest on TypeScript, pytest on Python), review PRs, and keep our CI/CD pipeline to Cloud Run fast and boring.
  
  

Our stack
  
Backend — TypeScript, Node, js, NestJS + Fastify, tRPC, Zod, Prisma, PostgreSQL, ML & data — Python, pandas, scikit-learn, XGBoost, PyTorch, ONNX, SQL on PostgreSQL, BigQuery, Calibration pipelines, Bayesian MMM (Google Meridian)
  
Model serving — FastAPI on Cloud Run · Cloud Run Jobs · GPU training on GCP Batch
  
Frontend — React · Vite · Tailwind · End-to-end types via tRPC
  
Infrastructure — Google Cloud Run · Pub/Sub · Docker · Terraform · GitHub Actions · pnpm workspaces
  
AI & integrations — Multiple LLM providers · Google Ads · Meta · Merchant Center · GA4
  
What we're looking for
  
5+ years building production software, with strong TypeScript on both server and client — or strong TypeScript on one side plus deep Python, with the willingness to close the gap fast.
  
**Hands-on applied ML:** you've trained, evaluated, and shipped prediction models that real users depended on. You can explain the difference between good ranking and good calibration, know what data leakage looks like, and have debugged a model that was confidently wrong.
  
Fluent Python for data work (pandas, scikit-learn or similar) and strong SQL — comfortable with large datasets in PostgreSQL or BigQuery.
  
Solid relational database instincts — schema design, migrations, and query performance in PostgreSQL (Prisma is a plus).
  
Experience with event-driven or queue-based architectures (Pub/Sub, SQS, Kafka, or similar) and their failure modes.
  
**A habit of testing:** you write tests because they let you move faster, not because someone told you to.
  
Pragmatic product sense — you ask why before how, and you'd rather ship a focused, well-measured model than a state-of-the-art one nobody can maintain.
  
  

Nice to have
  
Bayesian modeling or marketing mix modeling experience (priors, ROI calibration, health diagnostics).
  
Hands-on work with LLM APIs in production — prompting, evals, structured output, cost control, switching providers.
  
Experience serving models on GCP (Cloud Run, GCP Batch, Vertex AI) and monitoring for drift.
  
Familiarity with Google Ads, Meta, or Merchant Center APIs, or ad-tech / e-commerce domain experience.
  
NestJS, tRPC, or GCP (Cloud Run, Artifact Registry, Workload Identity) in a previous role.
  
  

How we work
  
Small team, short feedback loops, no ceremony for ceremony's sake. Strict TypeScript, code review on everything, CI that deploys to Cloud Run on merge. Models are held to the same standard as code: evaluated before they ship, monitored after. We optimize for shipping value weekly and keeping the codebase a place people enjoy working in.
  
We're a fast-growing team building AI agents that handle the repetitive work — so companies can focus on vision, strategy, and innovation. Here, you'll own ideas from first sketch to finished product, work closely with the founders, and see your impact immediately. We celebrate success, learn from challenges, and believe true magic happens through collaboration.
  
Want to shape the future of AI-driven marketing?
  
Interviews are conducted on an ongoing basis, so please submit your application as soon as possible.
  
You will be employed directly by the company. You will receive information about which company the advertisement refers to when you are in contact with the recruiter. Bumbli Group is therefore not the employer but the recruitment agency.
  
Welcome to submit your application!
  
Bumbli Group is part of House of Recruitment — a personal, traditional and quality-driven recruitment agency in Gothenburg.
