title: Data Scientist
description:
Xylem is a Fortune 500 global water solutions company dedicated to advancing sustainable impact and empowering the people who make water work every day. As a leading water technology company with 23,000 employees operating in over 150 countries, Xylem is at the forefront of addressing the world's most critical water challenges. We invite passionate individuals to join our team, dedicated to exceeding customer expectations through innovative and sustainable solutions.


At Xylem, we're tackling some of the world's biggest water challenges through innovation, technology, and data. We're looking for a Data Scientist who is curious, collaborative, and excited about turning complex data into meaningful solutions that help our customers operate more efficiently and sustainably.


In this role, you'll work with operational and sensor data to develop machine learning models, advanced analytics, and AI-powered solutions that generate real-world impact. You'll collaborate with product managers, engineers, domain experts, and customers to uncover opportunities, solve complex problems, and create products that deliver measurable value.


Success in this role comes from combining strong analytical skills with a genuine interest in understanding the systems, processes, and operational environments behind the data.

**Responsibilities**

* Analyze complex operational and sensor data to uncover patterns, trends, and opportunities for improvement.
* Design, develop, validate, and deploy machine learning models and advanced analytics solutions.
* Build algorithms for forecasting, anomaly detection, and predictive decision support.
* Transform business and customer challenges into scalable, data-driven solutions.
* Develop a deep understanding of the systems, processes, and operational context behind the data to create impactful analytical solutions.
* Collaborate closely with product managers, software engineers, domain experts, and customers to define and deliver new capabilities.
* Leverage modern AI tools and technologies to support data exploration, experimentation, model development, and solution delivery.
* Monitor and continuously improve the performance of analytics solutions and machine learning models.
* Communicate insights and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Stay up to date with emerging technologies, AI advancements, and analytical methods that can drive innovation and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**


We're interested in people with different backgrounds and experiences. If you're excited about the opportunity and believe you can contribute, we'd love to hear from you.

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Experience developing machine learning models and advanced analytics solutions.
* Strong Python skills and experience working with large or complex datasets.
* Good understanding of statistics, data analysis, and predictive modeling techniques.
* Ability to translate business and operational challenges into practical data-driven solutions.
* Strong problem-solving skills and a curiosity for discovering meaningful insights from data.
* Interest in understanding the systems and processes behind the data and applying that knowledge to analytical solutions.
* Ability to communicate complex concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Strong collaboration skills and the ability to work effectively across teams and disciplines.

**Nice to Have**


Experience with time-series data, anomaly detection, forecasting, predictive analytics, industrial systems, IoT, or sensor data would be valuable. Familiarity with cloud-based analytics and machine learning platforms, AI-assisted development tools, or cross-functional product development environments is also a plus. Most importantly, we're looking for someone who is curious, eager to learn, enjoys collaborating with others, and is motivated by creating meaningful impact through data.

**Why Join Xylem?**


At Xylem, you'll be part of a global team dedicated to solving critical water and infrastructure challenges. We offer a collaborative and international environment where you'll have opportunities to grow your skills, develop your career, and contribute to innovative solutions that make a difference around the world.


You'll also have the opportunity to engage with **Xylem Watermark**, our corporate citizenship program focused on education, community involvement, and water stewardship. Learn more at www.xylemwatermark.com.

**Belonging at Xylem**


At Xylem, we believe that diverse perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds strengthen our teams and drive innovation. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels welcomed, respected, and empowered to do their best work.


We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if their experience doesn't perfectly match every qualification listed. Your unique skills, experiences, and potential may make you the ideal fit for this role.

**Application**


We look forward to receiving your application in English.


Please note that we review applications on an ongoing basis and may close the recruitment process once we have found the right candidate.


If you have any questions about the position, please contact: Leila.sayyad@xylem.com


Please submit your application through our careers site. We do not accept applications via email.


Join the global Xylem team to be a part of innovative technology solutions transforming water usage, conservation, and re-use. Our products impact public utilities, industrial sectors, residential areas, and commercial buildings, with a commitment to providing smart metering, network technologies, and advanced analytics for water, electric, and gas utilities. Partner with us in creating a world where water challenges are met with ingenuity and dedication; where we recognize the power of inclusion and belonging in driving innovation and allowing us to compete more effectively around the world.

title: Receptionist & Konferensvärd Scandic Alvik, extra vid behov
description:
Ansök nu
* Stockholm
* Arbete på plats
**Arbetsuppgifter**
-------------------

**Scandic Alvik** är ett hotell beläget i Alvik, endast 10 min från Stockholm city och ett stenkast från Mälaren. Vår ambition är att vara bäst på gästupplevelser inom Scandic. Hos oss ingår du i ett härligt team med engagerade medarbetare som hjälper varandra och sätter gästen i fokus i allt vi gör. Hotellet har en variation av gäster bestående av allt ifrån affärsresenärer, nyfikna turister till konferenssällskap. Älskar du att leverera oförglömlig service i världsklass och att skratta på arbetstid? Då passar du perfekt i vårt team!



**Nu söker vi en person som vill arbeta extra som receptionist och/eller konferensvärd till Scandic Alvik.**



Oavsett varför gästen kommer till oss är det få saker som är så uppskattade som ett vänligt ansikte som hälsar välkommen. Du agerar värd tillsammans med övriga teamet på hotellet och skapar en gästupplevelse i världsklass.



Hos oss får du ta ett stort eget ansvar för att ta de beslut som krävs för att göra gästen nöjd och teamen utvecklar och förbättrar arbetssätt och service i takt med att omvärlden förändras. Vi är nämligen övertygade om att det är när du får utvecklas och bidra med all din kompetens och erfarenhet som vi överträffar gästens förväntningar. På köpet får vi kul på jobbet!



Så ta med dig dina erfarenheter, ditt engagemang och ditt sätt att tänka till oss – och bidra till en kultur där vi bryr oss på riktigt: om varandra, våra gäster och vår planet. Välkommen till Scandic!


**Vad är innebär rollen?**


**När du arbetar i receptionen** är du ansvarig för att våra gäster får service i världsklass. Du är spindeln i nätet som ser till att gästen alltid är i fokus. Du är den som går igenom ankomstlistan och lägger tid på detaljerna. Ser till att gästens önskemål uppfylls. Du har alltid ett leende på läpparna och en kreativ lösning i bakfickan. Du löser det mesta och är en stjärna på att vända en missnöjd gäst till en nöjd gäst. Din arbetsplats är vår lobby. För det är där du möter flest gäster. I ansvarsområdet ingår även administrativt arbete, säkerhetsarbete och arbete med försäljning.


Arbetet i receptionen innebär att checka in och ut hotellets gäster, hälsa välkommen och ge gästen den information den behöver om sin vistelse. Du hanterar bokningar i systemet Opera Cloud och hanterar administrativa uppgifter runt gäster och säkerhet. Allt arbete sker med gästnöjdhet och försäljning i fokus.


**När du arbetar på konferensvåningen** är det du som ansvarar för att allt fungerar när gästerna är på plats för sin konferens. Du säkerställer att lokal, teknik, fika och övriga beställningar är i sin ordning enligt kundens bokning och förväntan. Du planerar din arbetsdag och tid samt utgår från en checklista och arbetar ensam eller tillsammans med kollegor.


Hotellet har öppet dygnet runt och det är därför viktigt att du trivs med att arbeta i skift (förmiddagar, eftermiddagar och helger).


**Vem är du?**



För att passa i rollen tror vi att du har en väl utvecklad social förmåga och är kapabel att hantera att det händer många olika saker samtidigt. Du har ett öga för detaljer och är bra på att planera din tid och prioritera ditt arbete. Det är mycket viktigt att du kan förmedla ett gott värdskap till hotellets gäster.


Du har också vana och kunskap i att arbeta med dator som arbetsredskap.


Eftersom arbetet till stor del består av att kommunicera med gäster är goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska en förutsättning. Talar du ytterligare ett språk är det meriterande.


Allra viktigast är dock dina personliga egenskaper och din inställning. För att passa i rollen behöver du vara en lyhörd och prestigelös lagspelare som tar ett stort ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter och helhetsresultatet.


**Information om tjänsten**



Tjänsten är en anställning för enstaka dagar på extra vid behov.


Vi tar enbart emot ansökningar via vår hemsida. Alla ansökningar kommer att behandlas löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag, varför vi ber dig att ansöka så snart som möjligt. I denna rekrytering använder vi oss av ett enklare test om service vid urvalet.



Vi ser fram emot att välkomna dig till oss på Scandic!



Ps. på vår hemsida kan du läsa mer om vår kultur, vad tjänsten innebär och om våra förmåner!

title: Technical Lead Engineer ﻿
description:
*Vill du påverka och göra skillnad på riktigt? Här bidrar du till att skapa trygghet för människor och samhällen. Det du gör spelar roll.*


Common Tech har en central roll i att möjliggöra Saabs digitala transformation genom att tillhandahålla gemensamma tekniska plattformar, kompetenser och arbetssätt som accelererar utvecklingen av mjukvara, data och AI-förmågor inom hela Saab. Genom att standardisera, återanvända och skala gemensamma lösningar skapar vi förutsättningar för snabbare innovation, effektivare leveranser och kortare ledtider från utveckling till driftsättning.


Organisationen bidrar också genom att säkerställa att våra produkter och system utvecklas med en modern och flexibel arkitektur som möjliggör kontinuerliga uppgraderingar, integration av nya teknologier samt datadrivna och mjukvarudefinierade förmågor. På så sätt stärker Common Tech Saabs förmåga att möta förändrade kundbehov, dra nytta av framsteg inom AI och autonomi samt bibehålla och utveckla vår konkurrenskraft på den globala försvarsmarknaden.


Inom Common Tech organisationen har avdelningen Product Tech en unik roll att driva innovation och förändring genom olika projekt brett över hela Saabs affärsområden. Leveransteamen arbetar tillsammans med övriga Common Tech i riktiga verksamhetsnära produktbyggen för att skapa nya förmågor inom exempelvis AI, Cloud, mjukvara samt modulär arkitektur och design, och säkerställer även att de förmågor som byggs inte bara blir tillgängliga för resten av Saab, utan också implementeras, integreras och används där de gör störst skillnad: i riktiga produkter och av riktiga team.

### **Din roll**


Som Technical Lead Engineer inom Product Tech arbetar du både operativt med hands-on utvecklingsarbete och strategiskt med tekniskt ledarskap. Du bidrar till att utveckla nya tekniska förmågor samtidigt som du hjälper verksamheten att omsätta dem till praktisk nytta.


Du kommer bland annat att:

* Designa, utveckla och integrera lösningar inom Cloud, data och AI.
* Arbeta med modulär arkitektur, designmönster samt återanvändbara byggblock och gemensamma komponenter.
* Sätta teknisk riktning och vägleda team kring moderna utvecklingsmetoder, Cloud-first-principer och AI-drivna arbetssätt.
* Samarbeta nära verksamheten för att implementera och operationalisera nya tekniska lösningar.

title: Senior Cloud & Backend Architect
description:
**At Framna, we’re looking for a Senior Cloud & Backend Developer who likes thinking beyond the code itself. Apply now!**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

  



**Do you like designing backend and cloud solutions that don’t just work today, but continue to perform as products, traffic, and complexity grow? At Framna, we’re looking for a Senior Cloud & Backend Architect with deep experience in .NET and Azure who can take ownership of the bigger technical picture — from application architecture and infrastructure to scalability, resilience, security, and multi-region cloud setups.**


You’ll be someone who can zoom in on a complex backend challenge, zoom out to understand how the whole system fits together, and make architectural decisions that create reliable, scalable, and maintainable products for the long term.

**Become part of the team**
---------------------------


Framna partners with some of the world’s most ambitious brands, like Swish, SJ, Essity, and SEB, to create digital products that define markets and deliver real-world impact. We are more than 600 people across our studios, building apps and digital products used by millions every day.


As our next Senior Cloud & Backend Architect, you’ll join our team in **Stockholm**, working alongside developers, designers, QA engineers, analysts, and product leads to take ideas from first sketch to live product.


You’ll play a key role in shaping the technical foundations behind the products we build, working across backend architecture, cloud infrastructure, scalability, security, and operations. Depending on the project, that might mean designing a new cloud architecture from the ground up, evolving an existing platform to handle significantly greater scale, or defining how services and infrastructure should operate reliably across multiple regions.


You’ll also become part of Framna’s wider engineering and cloud community across our studios — sharing knowledge, challenging technical assumptions, discussing architecture, and helping us continuously improve how we build.


And while we collaborate across locations, Stockholm is where you’ll call home. We’re looking for someone who genuinely enjoys being around their colleagues and wants the office to be a natural part of their working week.

**What you’ll do**
------------------


This is a senior architectural role for someone who enjoys taking ownership of complex technical systems and making decisions that hold up over time.


You’ll work across backend development, cloud architecture, infrastructure, and operations, with a particular focus on .NET and Microsoft Azure.


More specifically, you will:

* Design and evolve scalable backend and cloud architectures primarily using .NET and Microsoft Azure.
* Define technical architectures for products that need to remain reliable, performant, and maintainable as usage and complexity grow.
* Design cloud infrastructure with high availability, resilience, disaster recovery, and scalability in mind.
* Architect and implement multi-region solutions, considering areas such as data replication, failover, latency, availability, and regional dependencies.
* Make architectural decisions around services, APIs, databases, networking, messaging, caching, storage, and other cloud components.
* Help teams choose the right architectural patterns and level of complexity for the problem at hand.
* Identify technical risks, bottlenecks, and scaling challenges before they become problems in production.
* Work with infrastructure as code, deployment strategies, observability, monitoring, and operational readiness.
* Ensure security is considered throughout the architecture, from infrastructure and networking to identity, access, and application design.
* Collaborate closely with developers, product teams, and partners to translate business requirements into robust technical solutions.
* Act as a senior technical advisor in client and project discussions, explaining architectural choices, trade-offs, and recommendations clearly.
* Mentor developers and engineers, lead technical discussions, and help raise the architectural capability of the teams around you.

**Who you are**
---------------


We imagine you have **10+ years of professional experience within backend engineering, cloud infrastructure, software architecture, or a combination of these**, with substantial hands-on experience working with **C#/.NET and Microsoft Azure**.


At this level, we’re looking for more than deep technical knowledge. You’ve built enough systems, seen enough things go wrong, and made enough architectural decisions to understand the trade-offs behind them.


You know that good architecture isn’t about making something as sophisticated as possible. It’s about designing the right solution for the context — and making sure it can evolve when that context changes.


You might recognise yourself if you:

* Have deep professional experience with **C#/.NET and Microsoft Azure**.
* Have designed and owned architecture for complex, business-critical backend systems.
* Have strong experience with **cloud infrastructure and distributed systems**.
* Understand how to design systems for **horizontal scaling, high availability, resilience, and fault tolerance**.
* Have experience designing or operating multi-region cloud architectures and understand the trade-offs involved.
* Are comfortable making decisions around databases, APIs, networking, messaging, caching, identity, security, and cloud services.
* Understand infrastructure as code and modern approaches to CI/CD and cloud operations.
* Think beyond application code and consider the complete system, including infrastructure, observability, deployment, security, and operational support.
* Know how to evaluate architectural trade-offs around performance, complexity, cost, maintainability, and time to market.
* Can move comfortably between strategic architecture discussions and hands-on technical problem-solving.
* Are comfortable communicating complex technical decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Enjoy mentoring engineers and helping teams make stronger technical decisions.
* Take pride in building systems that are not only technically impressive, but genuinely dependable and easy to operate.
* Enjoy working from the office and being part of the everyday life of a team.

**About Framna**
----------------


Framna means ‘to bring forward’ in Old Norse. And that is exactly what we do. We partner with industry leaders (and those about to be) to create excellent digital products that define markets, reshape industries, and deliver meaningful impact.


Born from the union of digital agencies Bontouch, Move, and Shape, Framna emerged from a strong, product-led culture. Today, over 600 of us collaborate across eight studios in Denmark, the Netherlands, Poland, Sweden, Switzerland, and the US.


Every day, millions of users around the world rely on the products we help shape. From seamless payments to daily commutes, from better health management to smarter shopping. Our work supports more than €150 million in daily transactions and consistently earns an average App Store rating of 4.5.


Together with some of the world’s most ambitious brands, including Essity, SJ, Swish, and SEB, we craft products that lead markets and push boundaries. Because when products win, businesses win. We call it Win by product.

**What you get**
----------------

* **For us, it’s office first.** Our cozy Stockholm office is our main location for work. Right in the middle of the city, it’s a welcoming space where there’s always something happening, whether it is a demo, a fika, or someone testing out a new idea. We spend time together to build culture, optimize for stronger collaboration, better products, and greater value for our partners — challenging ourselves while having fun doing it. We mix that with the freedom to work from home when it makes sense, and hours that flex around real life.
* **A culture of curiosity.** On Fridays we have weekly demos, Wednesdays mean lunch-and-learns, and sometimes we throw ourselves into conceptathons just to see what happens. We gather for company conferences to share ideas, and we take time to learn something new when needed.
* **The freedom to follow your “what if.”** We believe the best roles are shaped by the people in them. If you are curious about something, you will have the trust and space to chase it, and probably a few teammates who want to jump in with you.
* **Teammates who bring their whole selves.** Designers who doodle during standups, engineers who can’t resist showing off a clever hack, product leads who keep the energy up when things get tricky. Around here, people genuinely like sharing what they know and celebrating when someone tries something new.
* **And of course, the benefits you’d expect.** A generous wellness grant, top-up on your parental leave, occupational pension, and plenty more to make life outside of work easier.

**Please note:** For this role, you need to be based in **Stockholm, Sweden**, or within commuting distance of our Östersund studio. Unfortunately, we are not able to offer relocation.

**Our hiring process**
----------------------

* First interview
* Case assignment
* Technical interview
* Final meeting

**About Framna**
----------------



Framna is a diverse and global team of builders, thinkers, and creators. We are united by one mission: to craft digital products that make everyday life better for millions of people worldwide. Today, over 600 of us collaborate across ten studios in Denmark, the Netherlands, Poland, Sweden, Switzerland, and the US.


Our name, rooted in Old Norse, means “to bring forward.” And that is exactly what we do. We partner with industry leaders (and those about to be) to create digital products that define markets, reshape industries, and drive meaningful growth. We call it Win by product.

title: Graduate AI Engineer - ADAS AI Agents
description:
Graduate AI Engineer – ADAS AI Agents
  
Are you passionate about Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, and the future of automotive technology? Do you want to help shape the next generation of connected, autonomous, and electric vehicles?
  
DXC Luxoft is a global leader in software engineering and digital transformation, partnering with many of the world's leading automotive manufacturers and suppliers. We are now looking for a talented and motivated Graduate AI Engineer to join our growing Automotive team in Sweden.
  
In this role, you will work at the intersection of Artificial Intelligence and Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS), developing innovative AI agents and intelligent tools that support the creation of safer, smarter vehicles. You will collaborate with experienced automotive and AI engineers, apply cutting-edge technologies such as Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Large Language Models, and contribute to real-world solutions for the mobility challenges of tomorrow.
  
This is an exciting opportunity for recent graduates and early-career professionals who are eager to combine their technical skills with creativity, innovation, and a passion for automotive technology. If you are looking for a role where you can learn, grow, and make a meaningful impact in a fast-moving global environment, we would love to hear from you.
  
Join DXC Luxoft and help drive the future of intelligent mobility.
  
  

**Project Description:**  

DXC Luxoft is a leading global software services company, delivering professional services across multiple business verticals such as finance, automotive, and digital transformation. The Automotive practice inside DXC Luxoft delivers software projects to a majority of the world's car manufacturers and suppliers for both personal and commercial vehicles. We are known for our Automotive software expertise and for helping our customers with high quality services and deliveries. Currently we are growing for our Swedish customers and are looking for Automotive cloud engineer with knowledge in cloud infrastructure development to join our team. You will be part of our growing organization in Sweden and will be part of developing next generation systems for the Automotive industry in the era of connected, autonomous, electric vehicles.
  
  

**Responsibilities:**  

Design, develop, and maintain C++ software for automotive systems with a strong focus on system safety
  
Candidates who can support in development of component adhering to functional safety standards
  
Contribute to system analysis, and implementation in compliance with automotive standards
  
Collaborate with hardware, software, and system teams across the development lifecycle
  
Develop and evaluate AI agents for automotive and ADAS use cases.
  
Build AI-powered tools to improve engineering productivity.
  
Apply Machine Learning and Generative AI techniques to ADAS challenges.
  
Work with ADAS engineers to prototype and deploy AI solutions.
  
Analyze automotive datasets and support AI model development.
  
Participate in research and innovation activities related to AI in automotive systems.
  
  

**Mandatory Skills Description:****Hard skills:**  

* Degree in Physics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field, with MSc or BSc preferred in Computer Science, AI, Data Science, Robotics, or Computer Vision.
* Experience in C++ software development within automotive settings.
* Foundational knowledge of AI and Machine Learning principles.
* Python programming.
* Understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs) and Generative AI concepts.
* Competence in data analysis to support problem-solving efforts.


**Soft skills:**  

* Demonstrated leadership capabilities and effective communication skills.
* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
* Proven track record in automotive software development projects


**Nice-to-Have Skills Description:**  

* ADAS knowledge: Familiarity with Advanced Driver Assistance Systems concepts and applications.
* Computer Vision: Understanding of image processing and visual data interpretation techniques.
* Deep Learning (PyTorch/TensorFlow): Experience with deep learning frameworks used for modeling and training AI systems.
* Master's Thesis related to ADAS, AI, Autonomous Driving, or Computer Vision: Relevant academic research demonstrating specialized expertise in these areas.
* Experience with AI Agent frameworks: Exposure to frameworks that facilitate the development of intelligent autonomous agents.
* Experience in agile or scaled agile environments: Optional familiarity with iterative and collaborative development methodologies.

description:
Ansök nu
* Ansök senast: 20 september 2026

* Arbete på plats
**Arbetsuppgifter**
-------------------

**Nu söker vi en Receptionist & Conference host till Scandic Uppsala Nord.**



Oavsett varför gästen kommer till oss är det få saker som är så uppskattade som ett vänligt ansikte som hälsar välkommen. Du agerar värd tillsammans med övriga teamet på hotellet och skapar en gästupplevelse i världsklass.



Hos oss får du ta ett stort eget ansvar för att ta de beslut som krävs för att göra gästen nöjd och teamen utvecklar och förbättrar arbetssätt och service i takt med att omvärlden förändras. Vi är nämligen övertygade om att det är när du får utvecklas och bidra med all din kompetens och erfarenhet som vi överträffar gästens förväntningar. På köpet får vi kul på jobbet!



Så ta med dig dina erfarenheter, ditt engagemang och ditt sätt att tänka till oss – och bidra till en kultur där vi bryr oss på riktigt: om varandra, våra gäster och vår planet. Välkommen till Scandic!


**Vad är innebär rollen?**



Du som arbetar i receptionen är ansvarig för att våra gäster får service i världsklass. Du är spindeln i nätet som ser till att gästen alltid är i fokus. Du är den som går igenom ankomstlistan och lägger tid på detaljerna. Ser till att gästens önskemål uppfylls. Du har alltid ett leende på läpparna och en kreativ lösning i bakfickan. Du löser det mesta och är en stjärna på att vända en missnöjd gäst till en nöjd gäst. Din arbetsplats är vår lobby. För det är där du möter flest gäster. I ansvarsområdet ingår även värdskap i vår konferensavdelning, administrativt arbete, säkerhetsarbete och arbete med försäljning.


Arbetet i receptionen innebär att checka in och ut hotellets gäster, hälsa välkommen och ge gästen den information den behöver om sin vistelse. Du hanterar bokningar i systemet Opera Cloud och hanterar administrativa uppgifter runt gäster och säkerhet. Allt arbete sker med gästnöjdhet och försäljning i fokus.


Hotellet har öppet dygnet runt och det är därför viktigt att du trivs med att arbeta i skift (förmiddagar, eftermiddagar, nätter och helger).


**Vem är du?**



För att passa i rollen tror vi att du har en väl utvecklad social förmåga och är kapabel att hantera att det händer många olika saker samtidigt. Det är mycket viktigt att du kan förmedla ett gott värdskap till hotellets gäster.



Du har också vana och kunskap i att arbeta med dator som arbetsredskap.


Eftersom arbetet till stor del består av att kommunicera med gäster är goda kunskaper i svenska och engelska en förutsättning. Talar du ytterligare ett språk är det meriterande.


Allra viktigast är dock dina personliga egenskaper och din inställning. För att passa i rollen behöver du vara en lyhörd och prestigelös lagspelare som tar ett stort ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter och helhetsresultatet.


**Information om tjänsten**



Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning på deltid.


Vi tar enbart emot ansökningar via vår hemsida. Alla ansökningar kommer att behandlas löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag, varför vi ber dig att ansöka så snart som möjligt. I denna rekrytering använder vi oss av ett enklare test om service vid urvalet.



Vi ser fram emot att välkomna dig till oss på Scandic!



Ps. på vår hemsida kan du läsa mer om vår kultur, vad tjänsten innebär och om våra förmåner!

title: Customer Analytics Analyst
description:
I'm interested
* Application Deadline: Sept. 30, 2026
* Stockholm
* Hybrid
**Job Description**
-------------------

**Do you want to be part of shaping the future of the biggest hotel chain in the Nordics?**



Scandic is on an exciting journey to strengthen how we use customer data, analytics and CRM to create more relevant guest experiences and drive commercial growth. To support this transformation, we are now looking for a highly motivated **Customer Analytics Analyst with focus on CRM** to join our team.


**Who are you?**



You are curious about customer behavior and passionate about turning data into insights that support better decisions and more relevant customer communication.



By analyzing customer behavior and engagement across the guest journey, you generate insights that support customer value performance, retention and more relevant communication across CRM channels.



You enjoy working in a cross functional environment where analytics supports both strategic decision making and operational activation. You collaborate closely with business and IT stakeholders to understand needs and translate them into analytical insights.



At Scandic, customer data is structured and analyzed in our Customer Data Analytics Domain in Snowflake, visualized through Power BI, and used to support decision making and activation across our MarTech platforms, mainly Salesforce today.


**Your key responsibilities will include;**


**Customer Analytics & Insights**


* Utilize SQL, R, Python (or equivalent languages) to conduct data analyses, predictive models such as churn prediction, customer lifetime value and behavioral segmentation, and perform statistical analyses aimed at optimizing the customer journey and supporting business strategies.
* Develop and maintain dashboards and reports using Power BI or Tableau, providing insights into customer behaviors, performance and engagement trends.
* Support the development of analytical models such as churn prediction, customer lifetime value and value segmentation to ensure they serve their purpose.
* Translate customer data and performance into actionable insights through analysis, and reporting that enable stakeholders to make data-driven decisions regarding CRM, and customer engagement initiatives.
* Work closely with peers within the CRM & Marketing Automation team as well as collaborating across commercial departments, to integrate customer analytics into broader company strategies and decision-making processes.
* Support the connection between analytics and activation by ensuring that insights, segments and analytical outputs can be used in CRM platforms such as Salesforce Data360, and Marketing Cloud to enable data-driven personalization and customer engagement.
* Analyze customer data within Scandic’s Customer Data Analytics Domain in Snowflake, create visualizations in Power BI, and ensure insights and segments can support CRM activation and data-driven personalization.
* Analyze, and create visualization in Scandic’s operational customer database (Data360) Tableau view to enable activation in MarTech systems.

Ansök


Teknisk och hälsovetenskaplig fakultet har utbildning och forskning inom teknik, hälsa och informationsdesign med tydlig utgångspunkt i samhällsutmaningar. Vår forskning bedrivs i nära samverkan med externa aktörer, nationellt och internationellt, och bidrar till kunskapsutveckling och innovation. Genom våra samverkansplattformar samlar vi akademi, offentlig sektor och näringsliv för att gemensamt driva kunskapsutveckling och stärka forskningens och utbildningens relevans. Utbildningen på alla nivåer är forskningsanknuten och har tydlig koppling till samhällets och arbetslivets behov. Tillsammans bidrar vi till hållbar samhällsutveckling.  

  

Inom fakulteten finns tre institutioner där sammanlagt ca 500 personer arbetar.  

  

Vid institutionen för hälsovetenskap, innovation och design bedrivs utbildningar kopplat till olika professioner inom vård och hälsa. Dessutom ges utbildningar inom folkhälsovetenskap, innovation och informationsdesign. Inom institutionen bedrivs en stark och tillämpad forskning som adresserar samhällsviktiga problem. Forskning och utbildning utvecklas i samverkan med offentlig sektor, näringsliv och civilsamhälle för att ge studenterna dagsaktuell kunskap inför sitt kommande yrkesliv.

**Arbetsuppgifter**
-------------------



Som universitetsadjunkt är dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter undervisning. Till undervisning hör även handledning, examination, kursutvärdering, kursutveckling. Samverkan är en integrerad del av universitetets forsknings- och utbildningsuppdrag och som universitetsadjunkt bidrar du aktivt till universitetets utvecklingsarbete. I arbetsuppgifterna ingår även allmän administration och kompetensutveckling samt att delta i den dagliga verksamheten, i ämnets och institutionens arbete.



För den här anställningen ingår att bedriva undervisning och genomföra kursmoment inom digital och fysisk grafisk design, visualisering och printteknik i kurser inom olika program vid MDU såsom interaktionsdesign, rumslig gestaltning, visualisering och textdesign, internationella masterprogrammet i innovation och design samt  

ingenjörsutbildingar med fokus på produktutveckling.



I rollen ingår även att stödja studenter i design-, visualiserings- och produktionsprojekt och fungera som specialistresurs för lärare, studenter och övriga verksamheter vid universitetet. Du kommer också att ansvara för drift, underhåll och utveckling av printerrummets utrustning, tillhandahålla print- och grafisk service till verksamheter inom MDU samt hantera inköp och lagerhållning av material samt förbrukningsvaror.

  


**Behörighetskrav**
-------------------



Vi söker dig som har visat pedagogisk skicklighet och har en magisterexamen eller motsvarande kompetens.



Den pedagogiska skickligheten ska vara dokumenterad på ett sådant sätt att det går att bedöma kvaliteten på det tidigare arbetet.



För att anställas som lärare vid MDU efterfrågas högskolepedagogisk utbildning eller motsvarande kunskaper. Den som anställs men saknar högskolepedagogisk utbildning kommer erbjudas att genomgå sådan i anställningen inom två och ett halvt år. Den högskolepedagogiska utbildningen vid Mälardalens universitet motsvarar tio veckors utbildning.



För denna anställning tillkommer följande behörighetskrav, utöver de som är fastställda i Anställningsordning vid MDU:


* Magisterexamen inom ett för anställningen relevant ämne såsom exempelvis grafisk design, grafisk form, eller motsvarande kompetens.
* Pedagogisk kompetens samt erfarenhet av undervisning och handledning inom digital och fysisk grafisk design och printteknik på högskole- eller universitetsnivå.
* Goda kunskaper i grafiska programvaror, särskilt Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator och InDesign).
* God materialkunskap avseende exempelvis papper, canvas, vinyl, plexiglas, Re-board, trä och metall.

* God muntlig och skriftlig kommunikationsförmåga i såväl svenska som engelska på den nivå som krävs för att utföra ordinarie arbetsuppgifter inom undervisning och administration.

**Bedömningsgrunder**

Som bedömningsgrund ska dels graden av den skicklighet som krävs för anställningen gälla, dels den förmåga och lämplighet i övrigt som krävs för att kunna utföra arbetsuppgifterna väl.



Utöver de bedömningsgrunder som är fastställda i Anställningsordning vid MDU, kommer särskild vikt att läggas vid följande för denna anställning:


* Bred kompetens inom grafisk formgivning och visuell kommunikation i  

olika medier och sammanhang
* Erfarenhet av inköp och beställning av grafiskt material och teknisk  

utrustning
* Engagemang i grafisk formgivning och produktion
* God teknisk förståelse, med särskild inriktning mot grafisk teknik
* Erfarenhet av grafisk produktion inom print, tryck och produktion som exempelvis utställningar, event och mässor
* Kunskap om drift, hantering och underhåll av skrivare och  

professionella printsystem

  



Vid en samlad bedömning av lämplighet läggs även vikt vid personliga förmågor. Alla anställda vid MDU förväntas samarbeta och bemöta kollegor och studenter med respekt, ta ansvar för verksamheten och de egna arbetsuppgifterna samt bidra till en god arbetsmiljö.

Vi värdesätter även de kvaliteter som en jämn ålders- och könsfördelning samt etnisk och kulturell mångfald tillför verksamheten.

title: Analytics Lead
description:
*Natural Cycles° is a leading women’s health company that developed the world’s first birth control app, used by millions globally. We are a fast growing startup, and we promote an international working environment filled with smart and ambitious colleagues based in Stockholm, Geneva, New York, and remotely. Our mission is to pioneer women’s health through research and passion, empowering every woman with the knowledge she needs to take charge of her health.*


Natural Cycles is scaling both user and revenue growth across its international markets, and we need a single trusted view of how that growth actually happens. As Analytics Lead you will own how we measure, understand and optimise performance across the entire funnel — from acquisition and activation to retention and monetisation — and turn complex data into decisions the business acts on.


Analytics is a recognised capability gap at Natural Cycles, so the remit is broad and yours to shape: own performance measurement, attribution and media-mix modelling across markets today, and grow it into the wider insight capability the company does not yet have. Your work will directly shape how we invest across paid, owned and organic channels, with a relentless focus on CAC, LTV, payback and unit economics.


The role is roughly 80% hands-on analysis and 20% commercial storytelling. You will work for the UK GM as an analytical business partner along with other regional leads.

**Mission**


Give Natural Cycles a single trusted view of how growth happens — owning performance measurement, attribution and media-mix modelling across markets, and growing it into the wider insight capability the company does not yet have.

**What you will be doing**

**Measurement foundations & data integrity**

* Own the definitions — one agreed way to count new sign-ups, new paying users and cost per acquisition — and retire the competing versions.
* Connect the data warehouse to the tools the business uses, so daily numbers stop depending on a manual export.
* Find, fix and document the faults that make figures untrustworthy — double-counted attribution, inconsistent market coding, and metrics that cannot validly be divided by one another.

**Attribution & media-mix measurement**

* Own attribution end to end: assess, select and implement the approach, including the business case for any new tooling.
* Build media-mix modelling and incrementality testing (geo experiments, lift studies) and use them to guide budget allocation within and across markets.
* Establish which conversions are genuinely driven by paid media, and produce a defensible view of blended versus paid-only cost per acquisition.

**Performance analytics across the funnel**

* Measure the acquisition funnel end to end, from first impression to first payment, across paid media, organic, CRM and owned channels.
* Analyse user behaviour across app and web to uncover insights that improve conversion, engagement and retention.
* Extend measurement into activation, retention and referral, supporting the shift of the North Star toward returning paying users.

**Reporting & tooling**

* Build and maintain scalable dashboards, reporting and analytical models using tools such as Snowflake, Mixpanel and Tableau.
* Give every report a named reader and a single question it answers.

**Business partnering & commercial storytelling**

* Act as analytical business partner to regional leads, translating commercial questions into analysis and analysis back into decisions.
* Present findings to the senior team in plain commercial language — including when the honest answer is that a number cannot yet be established.
* Partner with finance on unit economics — lifetime value, payback period and contribution margin.

**Cross-functional & quality**

* Work with performance marketing, brand, CRM, organic, product analytics, finance and the regional teams to keep definitions consistent across markets.
* Contribute, as every employee does, to maintaining and improving the quality system to comply with all applicable regulations and standards, especially ISO 13485.

**What skills and experience we think you have**

* A technically very strong, hands-on analyst — the core of the role. Fluent SQL and confident in a cloud data warehouse (Snowflake, BigQuery), a product analytics platform (Mixpanel) and BI tools (Tableau, Looker). You can take a raw transactional dataset and derive the numbers yourself — revenue by market, new paying users by month, trial-to-paid conversion, channel attribution from discount codes — not just read a dashboard.
* Deep performance-marketing analytics: media-mix modelling, attribution and incrementality testing (geo experiments, lift studies, MMM), and a strong command of CAC, LTV, payback and unit economics.
* Full-funnel understanding across acquisition, activation, retention and monetisation, across app and web. Typically 6+ years in growth, marketing or product analytics, ideally in a subscription or app business.
* A commercial storyteller as well as an analyst — turns a dataset into a clear recommendation for non-technical and C-level audiences, with sound judgement about certainty.
* Hands-on and operational, comfortable building foundations that do not yet exist. Open on seniority, with level and title set to the individual. Based in Stockholm, London or Berlin; relocation support available. Fluent English.

**What we offer**

* Flexible work arrangement - you will be part of a team based in and around Stockholm that values effective collaboration and transparent communication, irrespective of work location
* Professional development - you will collaborate with industry leading developers, promoting continuous growth and skill enhancement
* Modern technology - you will leverage innovative technologies and tools, within an environment that empowers you to contribute ideas and take ownership of your work
* Impactful projects - you will contribute to groundbreaking projects that redefine industry standards and create tangible value
* Commitment to quality - you will join a dynamic and progressive organization that prioritizes profitable, long-term product development

 **Location**


We are remote-friendly, but we find great value in being able to connect with our teams in person. **Most of the team you will work with is located in Stockholm.**

 **Sounds interesting?**


If you want to be part of a successful team, we encourage you to apply for this position as soon as possible.


We look forward to hearing from you!

 **How to apply**


To apply, just upload your CV and answer the questions on the application form. Keep in mind that we can't accept applications through email because of GDPR, and only applications submitted via the career site (and in English) will be considered.


At Natural Cycles we value diversity and inclusion because we know that teams with people from different backgrounds and experiences are stronger. We welcome candidates from all walks of life and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and candidates.  

  

**Note: We are not looking for consultants or help from recruitment agencies**

title: HPC Infrastructure Engineer
description:
### **Vill du bygga infrastrukturen bakom nästa generations HPC- och AI-plattformar?**


Bakom framtidens fordon, energilösningar, avancerade industriprodukter och AI-modeller finns stora beräkningsbehov. Våra HPC- och AI-plattformar hjälper teknikintensiva organisationer att simulera, analysera, träna och utveckla snabbare och mer hållbart. Nu söker vi dig som vill vara med och bygga nästa generation av de miljöerna.

#### **Det här blir du en del av**


Du blir en del av Gompute, Advanias specialistteam inom High Performance Computing. Vi bygger och driftar plattformarna själva, från bare metal och nätverk till Kubernetes, GPU-kluster och infrastrukturen bakom Advanias AI-satsning ALT. Det innebär att du kommer nära flera delar av den tekniska miljön, till exempel:

* OpenStack med Kolla/Kayobe, Ceph och OVN.
* Bare metal-provisionering med Puppet och Foreman.
* Kubernetes-kluster för AI och HPC, exempelvis RKE2 och OKD.
* Infrastructure as Code med Terraform, Ansible och GitOps.
* Höghastighetsnätverk, distribuerad lagring och observability med verktyg som Prometheus, Grafana och Loki.

#### **Din vardag**


I rollen får du arbeta brett över hela infrastrukturen, från daglig drift och avancerad felsökning till utveckling, automation och tekniska designbeslut. Du förväntas ta ansvar för tekniska frågor hela vägen från analys till hållbar lösning, oavsett om det handlar om Linux, OpenStack, Kubernetes, nätverk, lagring eller tjänstelager. Du arbetar nära tekniken, automatiserar installation och livscykelhantering med verktyg som Terraform, Ansible och Puppet, och är med och vidareutvecklar miljöerna framåt.

### **Din erfarenhet och tekniska grund**


Du har stark praktisk erfarenhet av Linuxbaserade miljöer och kan självständigt drifta, analysera och felsöka system i komplexa sammanhang. Har du arbetat med RHEL eller Rocky Linux är det ett plus, men erfarenhet av Ubuntu är också mycket relevant.


Utöver det tror vi att du känner igen dig i flera av dessa områden:

* OpenStack eller annan private cloud-plattform
* Kubernetes, exempelvis RKE2, OKD/OpenShift eller motsvarande
* Terraform, Ansible, Puppet och Infrastructure as Code
* Ceph, parallella filsystem eller andra distribuerade lagringsplattformar
* Nätverk och datacenterinfrastruktur, gärna BGP, VLAN eller InfiniBand
* GPU-beräkning, AI-infrastruktur, Bash eller Python för automation
* Monitorering och logghantering, exempelvis Prometheus, Grafana och Loki


Erfarenhet från HPC är meriterande men inget krav. Har du byggt och felsökt avancerad Linux-, cloud- eller infrastrukturmiljö i ett annat sammanhang står du på en stark grund. Du kommunicerar professionellt på engelska och trivs med att ta ansvar, prioritera och driva tekniska frågor framåt.

### **Varför det här är en rolig roll**


Det här är en roll för dig som vill arbeta nära tekniken och se dina lösningar bli verklighet. Du får kombinera drift, automation, utveckling och arkitektur i miljöer med GPU-kluster, InfiniBand, storskalig lagring och avancerad Linux- och HPC-infrastruktur. Här arbetar du tillsammans med erfarna specialister i en kultur där teknisk nyfikenhet, kunskapsdelning och ständig förbättring är en naturlig del av vardagen.

#### **Om Gompute**


Gompute är Advanias specialistverksamhet inom High Performance Computing. Vi utvecklar, bygger och driftar avancerade HPC- och AI-plattformar för organisationer som vill korta utvecklingscykler, förbättra produktkvalitet och accelerera innovation genom simulering, analys och storskalig beräkning.

#### **Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!**

Visa gärna ditt intresse så snart som möjligt då vi intervjuar löpande. Vi välkomnar sökanden med olika bakgrunder, erfarenheter och synsätt, eftersom vi vet att en bredare mångfald berikar var och en av oss och stärker såväl effektivitet som kreativitet i vårt arbete.


Som en del av vår rekryteringsprocess genomgår våra slutkandidater en obligatorisk bakgrundskontroll, en för oss kvalitativ kontroll inför ett anställningsbeslut. Advania samarbetar med Ljung & Sjöberg i ärenden kopplat till alkohol-, drog- och spelproblematik och är en certifierad "Proaktiv Arbetsplats".


Tveka inte att höra av dig om du har några frågor eller funderingar.️

Securitas is a world-leading safety and security solutions partner that helps make your world a safer place. By leveraging technology in partnership with our clients, we offer a broad portfolio of value-enhancing services and solutions integrated across the security value chain – from on-site services to advanced monitoring, comprehensive risk prediction and advisory services.


With around 322 000 employees in 44 markets, our innovative, holistic approach with local and global expertise makes us a trusted business partner to many of the world’s best-known companies. Benefitting from almost nine decades of deep experience and guided by our values of integrity, vigilance, and helpfulness, we create sustainable value by helping our clients optimize their operations and protect what matters most - their people and assets.

**Securitas IT**


Securitas’ vision is to become the Intelligent Protective Services Partner by being client centric, data driven and people focused. Our protective services help make your world a safer place. IT is a key function in enabling the modern and powerful technology needed to fulfil Securitas’ business strategy.

**About the role**


The **Senior Data Platform Lead** is a critical **senior technical leadership role** responsible for owning and evolving the organization's core data platform, driving engineering excellence across Databricks, Fabric and the broader technical data ecosystem. This leader will balance hands-on technical oversight with strategic engagement - **acting as the connection between platform engineering, business demand, and strategically important data programmes.**


This role suits a seasoned data engineer or architect who has grown into leadership, retains a strong technical grounding, and can credibly engage with both engineers and executive stakeholders.  

  

Securitas Group utilizes a federated operating model, and it is essential that the Data Platform supports this framework while aligning with our strategic objectives.

**Key responsibilities**

**1. Data Platform Ownership & Engineering Leadership**

* Own the technical strategy, architecture, and roadmap for the organization's data platform, with Databricks as the primary compute and analytics engine.
* Provide a clear Service Description of the Platform options and expected roles and responsibilities in our Federated Environment.
* Lead platform reliability, performance, and scalability - ensuring SLAs are met and operational risk is minimized.
* Establish and enforce engineering standards, including CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and testing practices all in a Federated Environment
* Oversee cluster configuration, cost management, and resource optimization within Databricks.
* Drive adoption of platform best practices across Delta Lake, Unity Catalog, MLflow, and related components.

**2. Demand Management & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Create a true Business/Consumer orientated Data Products shopping experience.
* Work with the Enterprise Data Governance team to technically realise data governance and data quality frameworks in the platform.
* Act as the primary technical point of contact for data platform demand, triaging and prioritising requests from business units, analytics teams, and product owners.
* Partner with business stakeholders to translate requirements into platform solutions, balancing speed-of-delivery with architectural integrity & platform roadmap.

**3. Strategic Data Program Support**

* Serve as a senior technical contributor and platform authority on enterprise data transformation programs (e.g. cloud migration, data product adoption, AI/ML enablement).
* Collaborate with data architects, data product owners, and data governance leads to align platform capabilities with strategic initiatives.
* Provide technical due diligence and risk assessment for new tools, vendors, and integration patterns.
* Contribute to data strategy documentation, business cases, and executive presentations where platform capability is relevant.

**4. Integration & Data Movement**

* Lead or oversee the design of data integration patterns, including batch ingestion, event streaming, and API-based data movement.
* Ensure robust connectivity between Databricks and upstream/downstream systems (ERP, CRM, SaaS platforms, data warehouses, client portals).
* Evaluate and manage integration tooling (e.g. ADF, dbt, Fivetran, Kafka, or equivalent) in line with platform strategy.
* Define standards for data contracts, schema management, and pipeline observability.

**5. Team Leadership & Development**

* Directly manage and develop a team of data engineers and platform engineers (4-7 consultants), including performance management, coaching, and professional growth.
* Foster a culture of engineering excellence, continuous improvement, and collaborative problem-solving.
* Manage third-party vendor relationships where applicable.
* Support financial plan up to a 3-year time horizon based on the Platform Strategy & backlog, industry trends and Business needs.

**Requirements**

**Key competencies**

* **Technical Depth -** can engage deeply on platform architecture, code quality, and engineering trade-offs — not just at a conceptual level.
* **Strategic Thinking -** connects platform decisions to business outcomes; anticipates future needs and plans accordingly.
* **Stakeholder Management - c**ommunicates clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences; builds trust across the organisation by meaningfully engaging with senior technical and business stakeholders.
* **Delivery Focus** - prioritises pragmatically, manages complexity, and consistently moves things forward.
* **People Leadership - d**evelops talent, builds psychological safety, and gets the best from diverse teams.
* **Data Governance Mindset** - understands the importance of data quality, cataloguing, access control, and lineage.

**Skills & Experience**

**Essential**

* **Around 10+ years** of experience **leading data platform and/or data engineering teams in a complex enterprise environment.**
* Deep hands-on expertise with Databricks, including Spark, Delta Lake, Databricks SQL, Workflows, and Unity Catalog.
* Strong understanding of lakehouse architecture, cloud-native data infrastructure (Azure preferred / AWS / GCP), and modern data stack principles.
* Experience owning a technical platform end-to-end — including reliability, security, cost, and roadmap.
* Track record of working across business and technology stakeholders to manage demand and deliver outcomes.
* Previous experience with leading a team.
* Familiarity with data governance, data cataloguing, and metadata management practices.
* Fluency in **English.**

**Highly Desirable**

* Background in data integration - including pipeline design, event streaming (Kafka, Event Hubs), or ETL/ELT tooling (dbt, ADF, Fivetran, or similar).
* Experience contributing to large-scale strategic data programs (e.g. cloud migration, data platform modernisation, AI/ML platform build-out).
* Exposure to data mesh, data product thinking, or domain-oriented data ownership models.
* Familiarity with MLflow, Feature Store, or Databricks Model Serving for ML workloads.

**Leadership & Behavioral**

* Demonstrates executive presence and the ability to influence without authority.
* Brings clarity and calm to ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
* Is a natural collaborator who builds strong relationships across engineering, architecture, and business functions.
* Has a growth mindset - curious, adaptive, and committed to both personal and team development.
* Reference to our Leadership Framework (checked during recruitment process).

**Working conditions**


We are currently welcoming applications from candidates based in **European countries** where our company has an established entity.


This role follows a **hybrid working model** (with office attendance requirements aligned with local office regulations) and regular travel.

**What we offer**


At Securitas we believe in doing the right thing and doing it well. For our customers and our employees. Our employees come from all walks of life and bring with them many talents and perspectives. We aim for diverse representation throughout the company, and we are committed to equal pay, safe working conditions, gender balance and an inclusive work environment with a wide range of skills and development opportunities.

**If this sounds like the right next step in your professional career, don't hesitate and apply!**

description:

**Job Description**
-------------------

*Join Tele2 Procurement and help us challenge the status quo.*


**About the role**  

Tele2 is a fast-moving, ever-changing tech company where we constantly challenge how things are done. As a new IT & Indirect Sourcing Manager, you will take ownership, lead initiatives, and drive commercial outcomes across IT and Indirect spend categories from day one.
  

  

You will work with everything from software and cloud services to professional services and other business-critical sourcing projects. You will collaborate directly with stakeholders across Tele2—including IT, Finance, Legal, Security, and our commercial teams—acting as a driver who gets things done.  

  

**Your responsibilities will include:**


* Leading sourcing projects and competitive tenders (RFPs, RFIs, RFQs) from start to finish
* Driving supplier negotiations and securing strong commercial agreements
* Exploring and applying AI, automation, and modern digital tools to improve how we analyze spend, manage data, and run procurement processes
* Analyzing spend data, market trends, and emerging technologies to identify savings, efficiency gains, and innovation
* Collaborating closely with internal stakeholders to understand their business needs and challenge requirements constructively
* Managing contracts actively and driving continuous improvement in existing supplier relationships
* Ensuring sourcing activities adhere to Tele2’s high security, compliance, and sustainability standards


**Who are you?**  

You don’t need years of procurement background, but you do need a strong inner drive, high curiosity, and the confidence to take the lead. You are genuinely interested in how tools like AI and automation can improve ways of working, and thrive in an environment where priorities shift quickly. You learn fast, dare to challenge established truths, and welcome being challenged in return.  

You might be a recent graduate or have 1–2 years of experience within IT, consulting, business development, finance, or procurement.

  

**We believe you have:**


* A university degree in engineering, IT, business, economics, or a related field
* A strong tech interest and enthusiasm for AI, automation, and digital ways of working
* A proactive, hands-on mindset with a drive to deliver results independently
* Sharp analytical and problem-solving skills
* Strong communication skills and the ability to influence and build credibility across teams
* Fluency in Swedish and English, both written and spoken



It is a plus if you have prior exposure to procurement, commercial contracts, or IT/tech projects, but your drive and mindset matter most.

  

**As a person, you:**


* Take accountability from day one and enjoy driving projects across the finish line
* Adapt quickly to change and learn new concepts with ease
* Love to challenge "the way we’ve always done it" and enjoy constructive discussions
* Are naturally curious about new technologies, automation, and smarter ways of working
* Combine a structured, analytical approach with speed and execution power


**Great Place to Work**
-----------------------

* Pension and health care
* Hybrid and flexible work life balance
* Career opportunities
* Parental benefit
* Employee benefits and Tele2 discounts
* Inclusive workplace
**Skills & Requirements**
-------------------------

**A few words from your new manager**  

*Hi, I'm Anders Sjöström, Head of IT & Indirect Sourcing at Tele2.*  

*The Procurement team plays a central role in driving change at Tele2. We challenge how things are done, work closely with the business, and create measurable value in a fast-paced environment.*  

*In this team, you won’t just support—you will be given real responsibility, your own projects to run, and the mandate to test new ideas and tools like AI and automation. You’ll work alongside experienced colleagues who will support you, share knowledge, and challenge you to grow every day.*  

*If you are driven, tech-savvy, eager to learn fast, and ready to take ownership from day one, I look forward to receiving your application!*


**Why Tele2**


* **A culture of natural born challengers** – At Tele2 we don’t just do things the traditional way. We challenge the status quo and push boundaries to create smarter and more valuable solutions for our customers. You will be part of a culture that values curiosity, initiative and collaboration, where new ideas are welcomed and everyone’s contribution matters.
* **Inclusive and supportive environment** – We believe in fostering a creative and flexible workplace where people can bring their whole selves to work. Diversity and inclusion are important to us, and we strive to create an environment where people feel welcome, respected and supported in growing both personally and professionally.
* **A sustainability challenger** – We are proud that Tele2 has been recognised as Europe’s Climate Leader by the Financial Times and named as Sweden’s most sustainable company by Time Magazine and Statista, reflecting our strong commitment to reduce emissions, transparency and long-term climate goals. Our efforts focus on three areas where we can make the biggest difference: advancing a circular economy, combating climate change, and protecting children online. By embedding these focus areas into how we operate and innovate, we aim to create positive impact for people, planet and profit.


**Interest and application**  

Would you like to be a part of the Tele2s value-driven and including culture? Then hit the “apply now” button and let’s find out if we’re a match!


If you have any specific questions regarding the position, please feel free to contact TA specialist: angelica.ek@tele2.com



Please note that in compliance with personal data management regulations (GDPR), we are unable to accept CVs via email.


Warmly welcome to submit your application! To ensure an inclusive and fair recruitment process, we focus on your experiences and skills. Therefore, Tele2 has chosen not to consider cover letters. Instead, we kindly ask you to answer the screening questions included in the application form.


*As a step in the recruitment process, Tele2 performs a background check on final candidates.*


**Work with great people**
--------------------------

Emma
Digital Capabilities & Technology
*"Everyone at Tele2 always aim for the stars in order to create unlimited possibilities."*
Fanny
Systemspecialist Unified Communications
*"The work environment at Tele2 supports both personal and professional development, and there are significant opportunities for further career advancement"*
**About the company**
---------------------

At Tele2, we challenge the telecom industry to create more valuable solutions for our customers. Guided by our challenger mindset, we deliver high-quality connectivity and digital services, ranging from mobile and fixed networks to TV, streaming and global IoT.


Sustainability is an integral part of how we work. Tele2 has been recognised as a climate leader in Europe by the Financial Times and named Sweden’s most sustainable company, reflecting our long-term commitment to reducing our environmental impact and advancing circular solutions together with our customers.


Our values – Be Brave, Take Action, Make it Simple and Act Cost-efficiently – guide our culture, how we collaborate and how we turn ideas into action.
