title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We're looking for a DevOps Engineer experienced in cloud to join our Platform Delivery and Reliability Services (PDRS) team in Stockholm. You will be a key contributor to our Cloud Strategy and Operations Team (CSOT), helping us design, govern, and scale our AWS footprint across a complex, multi-account environment.
 



  





 This is a hands-on role with real ownership. You will work on improving and automating our cloud infrastructure, contributing to governance initiatives, and being the go-to escalation point for AWS-related questions from engineering teams. You won't just maintain what is there, you will actively look for what needs fixing and fix it.
 



  





**What You'll Do** 



* Manage and evolve our multi-account AWS environment: organisations, SCPs, landing zones, and identity center.
* Drive infrastructure-as-code coverage, primarily through terraform, reducing reliance on manual processes and legacy CloudFormation setups.
* Contribute to CSOT governance initiatives: tagging strategies, resource ownership, cost visibility, and guardrails.
* Act as an escalation point for engineering teams on AWS-related issues — from access problems to account requests to architectural questions.
* Take vague requirements and turn them into reasoned, actionable proposals — weighing cost, complexity, and operational overhead.
* Review AWS designs and architectures, flag gaps, and suggest alternatives.
* Support and evolve our EKS clusters and the platform tooling teams depend on.
* Participate in incident management and root cause analysis.
* Document AWS design decisions clearly, for both technical and non-technical audiences.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




**Must-Have** 



* Broad, hands-on AWS experience across a wide range of services — you don't need to know everything, but you move around AWS and its documentation comfortably
* Solid understanding of AWS IAM: permission boundaries, roles, and trust policies
* experience with multi-account AWS architectures: organisations, SCPs, landing zones
* Ability to take a vague requirement and come back with a structured, reasoned proposal
* able to review designs independently, flag risks, and articulate tradeoffs — without needing to be pointed at the problem first
* Hands-on experience writing Terraform
* Working knowledge of CloudFormation
* Solid understanding of CI/CD practices and tooling
* Experience with Kubernetes (EKS and/or on-prem)
* Strong understanding of Linux/Unix systems
* Strong verbal and written communication skills — comfortable explaining AWS decisions to non-specialists



  





**Nice-to-Have** 



* Experience with AWS cost governance: cost explorer, budgets, tagging and resource governance strategies
* Experience in a highly regulated industry (gaming, fintech, or similar)
* Experience with Ansible, Jenkins/Groovy, Gitlab or Bitbucket
* Scripting or development experience in python or shell



  





**Our Stack (What You'll Work With)** 




**Cloud:** 
 AWS (primary), OpenStack
 



**Orchestration:** 
 Kubernetes, Helm, ArgoCD
 



**Governance/Security:** 
 AWS Organizations, IAM, SCPs, Config, Security Hub
 



**CI/CD:** 
 GitLab, Jenkins
 



**IaC:** 
 Terraform, CloudFormation, Ansible
 



**Governance/Security:** 
 AWS organisations, IAM, SCPs, config, security hub
 



**Operating System:** 
 Linux

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
**Senior Data Engineer** 




 Help build and take real ownership of the data platform behind proof, insights and optimisation in open-web video advertising, processing billions of video streams and hundreds of billions of events.
 



  





**About SeenThis** 




 The open web has massive untapped advertising potential, but video has historically underperformed here. SeenThis is changing that. As a video advertising partner, we prove the open web delivers exceptional results, capturing more attention with cost-effective video that keeps publishers profitable and the internet independent. Since 2017, we've served billions of streams for 5,000+ brands across 50+ countries.
 



  





 We believe brands deserve reach wherever audiences are, publishers deserve sustainable revenue, and the internet deserves to stay open.
 



 Our team of 130+ employees works globally from offices in Stockholm, Oslo, London, Paris, Singapore, Hong Kong, New York and Sydney. We're expanding across all teams and looking for people who want to make a real impact in a fast-moving, collaborative environment.
 



  





 Do you want to be part of our journey, where we dare to discover, own it and win together?
 



 Join SeenThis!
 



  





**About the role** 




 You'll join our R&D organisation, where Product, Engineering, Design, Data and Infrastructure work together across three product streams: Core Tech, our streaming, delivery and measurement technology; Studio, our production system for advertising; and Creative Manager, the workflow and orchestration layer around campaign execution.
 



 Data works across all three and supports teams across SeenThis, turning product, operational, commercial and financial data into governed models, shared definitions, reporting and insight.
 



 The data team today consists of a lead data engineer, who built the platform and leads its technical direction, and a data analyst working closely with teams across reporting, insight and the business.
 



  





 You'll be the second data engineer, with substantial hands-on responsibility for running and evolving the platform and its governed models, and a real say in where we go next.
 



 The platform was rebuilt over the past year and now runs in production across high-volume streaming and event data, alongside product, campaign, CRM and finance data.
 



 You'll thrive here if you enjoy shaping the solutions and how to build them rather than just executing against a fixed spec, partner naturally with business stakeholders to get at the real problem before reaching for a technical solution, and take initiative to move things forward.
 



 Our stack includes Python and SQL, Airflow 3 on GKE, GCS and S3, BigQuery, ClickHouse, and Terraform across GCP and AWS. We use AI tools in engineering where they add value, backed by the fundamentals to judge their output.
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* Run and evolve the data platform end to end, from ingestion through transformation, modelling and serving.
* Make it reliable without constant attention through data-quality checks, monitoring and alerting, idempotent pipelines, backfills and repair tooling.
* Work with data of very different shapes and scales, from high-volume events to third-party APIs, operational databases and files.
* Build and evolve governed models, onboard new sources, retire legacy paths and expand self-service through curated datasets.
* Build the trusted data products behind campaign reporting, commercial and financial reporting, billing and reconciliation, product insight and operational decision-making.
* Work directly with teams across SeenThis to identify what data can do for them and shape ambiguous problems into valuable use cases. You will not wait for someone to hand you a finished spec.
* Improve how we build and operate the platform, including using AI where it adds clear value.



  





**Who you are** 



* You have substantial experience building and operating production data platforms, with strong Python and advanced SQL.
* You have built and run orchestrated data pipelines in production. Airflow experience is strongly preferred.
* You have worked with cloud environments at a meaningful scale, ideally GCP.
* You have built data lakes, data warehouses and complex dimensional models.
* You think operationally and build for long-term reliability, data quality, performance and cost efficiency.
* You have taken meaningful end-to-end responsibility for production systems and work well independently in a small senior team.
* You use AI tools pragmatically in your engineering work and have the fundamentals to judge their output.
* You communicate clearly and leave systems, code and technical decisions understandable for the people working on them next.



  





**Bonus if you have experience with** 



* ClickHouse, Kubernetes/GKE or Terraform.
* High-volume event, impression or streaming data.
* Ad tech, martech, media measurement or another commercially complex data domain.
* Decommissioning legacy systems, or building AI/LLM-backed tooling or data products.



  





**Application** 




 If you're close on most of this and strong where it counts, we'd rather hear from you than not.
 



 As we review applications and interview continuously, please apply as soon as possible. Due to the high volume of applications, we are unable to provide personalised feedback prior to the interview stage. Thank you for understanding!
 



  





 We conduct background checks on all SeenThis hires to meet customer requirements and protect business-critical information.
 



  





 We look forward to welcoming you to SeenThis!

title: Domänarkitekt Infrastruktur IT
description:
Som nyckelaktör i Sveriges energiomställning växer Svenska kraftnäts IT-division för att möjliggöra en fördubblad elproduktion och en fossilfri framtid. Med den senaste tekniken ökar vi både infrastrukturens kapacitet och utvecklingstakten inom digitalisering och processer. För att fortsätta den här resan framåt söker vi en erfaren Domänarkitekt till Infrastruktur IT.
   

  

**Om tjänsten**
 Här blir du en del av IT-arkitekturenheten som består av 15 personer. Enhetens ansvarsområde är att tillhandahålla en övergripande målbild för Svenska kraftnäts IT-arkitektur.
   

  

 Som
 **Domänarkitekt Infrastruktur IT** 
 får du en nyckelroll i utvecklingen och moderniseringen av Svenska kraftnäts framtida IT-infrastruktur, både on-prem och i molnet. Du leder arbetet med att ta fram och etablera en stabil målarkitektur och färdplaner samt säkerställer att lösningarna följer myndighetens strategiska riktning, standarder och höga säkerhetskrav.
   

  

 Rollen innebär ett nära samarbete med lösningsarkitekter och teknikområdesansvariga, där du i ditt arbete bidrar till att skapa en modern, standardiserad och robust infrastruktur för en samhällskritisk verksamhet. Samtidigt som du är del i den egna enheten arbetar du tvärfunktionellt och har en given plats i arkitekturrådet, där du bidrar till den övergripande arkitekturella utvecklingen. Rollen innebär att balansera innovation med mycket höga krav på säkerhet, robusthet och regulatorisk efterlevnad i en komplex och samhällskritisk miljö.
   

  

**Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter:**
* Leda och driva framtagandet av målarkitekturer för Svenska kraftnäts IT-infrastruktur, både on-prem och i publika molnmiljöer
* Agera senior teknisk rådgivare och ledningsstöd genom att förankra målbilder på hög nivå, ge beslutsunderlag till chefer och säkerställa rätt strategiska vägval och prioriteringar
* Säkerställa att IT-lösningar designas i enlighet med våra målarkitekturer och standarder
* Driva standardisering av våra IT-infrastrukturtjänster för att underlätta arbetet i våra utvecklingsprojekt och IT-förvaltningar
* Delta i olika samarbetsgrupper för coachning och granskning av lösningar, arkitekturstyrning, utveckling av arkitekturramverk etc.
* Beskriva och kommunicera arkitekturen till aktuella målgrupper
* Ansvara för framtagning av målbilder och färdplaner
* Stödja portföljstyrningen och framtagandet av utvecklingsplaner inom förvaltningsorganisationen
* Inom domänen leda och coacha lösningsarkitekter och teknikspecialister i projekt och IT-drift
* Hålla dig uppdaterad genom omvärldsbevakning inom ditt område


 Här erbjuds stora möjligheter att påverka Svenska kraftnäts framtida IT-landskap.
   

  

**Om dig**
**Skallkrav:**
 Vi söker dig som är samarbetsorienterad och trivs med att arbeta tvärfunktionellt för att nå gemensamma mål. Du tar naturligt en ledande roll, skapar engagemang och driver arbetet framåt genom att få med dig och motivera andra. Du är van vid att kommunicera på alla nivåer, är inlyssnande samtidigt som du kan hantera motstånd och utmaningar utan att avvika från beslutade styrningar och inriktningar. Du är analytisk och kan förstå komplexa sammanhang och omsätta insikter i väl underbyggda ställningstaganden. Vidare är du resultatorienterad och driver arbetet framåt med tydligt fokus på vad som behöver uppnås.
   

  

 Du ska också leva upp till den statliga värdegrunden. I denna rekrytering lägger vi stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.
   

  

 Du har en högskole-/universitetsutbildning inom ett relevant tekniskt område alternativt gedigen bakgrund inom IT-arkitektur och IT-infrastruktur förvärvad genom arbetslivserfarenhet.
   

  

 Du har även:
   

  

* Minst 8 års aktuell arbetslivserfarenhet av att arbeta som IT-infrastrukturarkitekt i enlighet med etablerade arkitekturmetoder, verktyg och processer
* Minst 2 års aktuell erfarenhet av att agera domänarkitekt eller lead architect för infrastruktur
* Flerårig arbetslivserfarenhet av tekniskt arbete inom IT-infrastruktur, såsom applikationsplattformar, middleware, nätverk, lagring eller operativsystem – med djup kompetens inom minst ett område
* Erfarenhet av att ta fram och förankra målarkitekturer inom infrastrukturområdet
* Erfarenhet av hybrid‑ eller molnarkitektur (t.ex. IaaS/PaaS‑tjänster)
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta i en stor och komplex IT-organisation
* Mycket god förmåga att uttrycka sig i tal och skrift på svenska och engelska


**Meriterande**
* Certifiering inom IT-arkitektur (t.ex. CITA, TOGAF eller Dataföreningens arkitektcert)
* Certifiering inom annat relevant infrastrukturområde (såsom CISSP, PKI, IAM, Azure, VMware, Cisco, Red Hat, Windows Server eller liknande)
* Erfarenhet av arbete med IT-säkerhet inom en samhällskritisk verksamhet alternativt verksamhet med mycket höga säkerhetskrav
* Erfarenhet av IAM
* Erfarenhet av att driva transformation mot DevOps‑principer, automatisering av infrastruktur genom skriptning, Infrastructure as Code och/eller modern platform engineering-praktik


**Bra att veta**
* Tjänsten är placerad i Sundbyberg
* Möjlighet till distansarbete upp till 50 %, om arbetet tillåter
* Resor kan förekomma i denna tjänst
* Sista ansökningsdag 2026-10-02, vi använder urvalsfrågor istället för personligt brev. Vänligen bifoga ditt CV skrivet på svenska som tydligt beskriver den erfarenhet som vi söker.

**Vid frågor, kontakta gärna följande personer:**
 I denna rekrytering samarbetar vi med Computer Sweden Recruitment. Vid frågor kontakta ansvarig rekryteringskonsult Johanna Nordberg, 070 3343159, johanna.nordberg@csrecruitment.se alternativt ansvarig rekryterare hos Svenska kraftnät Maria Sahlén, 072-459 85 27, maria.sahlen2@svk.se.
   

  

 Fackliga representanter:

* Erica Midfjäll, facklig representant ST, 010 475 87 31


 Du når oss också via e-post: Förnamn.Efternamn@svk.se

title: AI Tech Consultant - Stockholm | BCG Platinion
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Do you want to turn the challenges of digitalization into the solutions of the future? Join BCG Platinion in tackling the core technology issues of leading global companies!
   

  

 Deploy customized platforms, architectures, strategies, and organizations to leverage the digital potential of our customers and drive true innovation, with state-of-the-art tools such as cloud computing, AI, blockchain, microservices, and containerization. Add your individual strengths to our unique team, always there to support you. Together with Boston Consulting Group and our clients, we turn digital visions into reality.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 For our Stockholm office, we are looking for AI Tech Consultants who will collaborate with colleagues from BCG Platinion and/or the Boston Consulting Group on local and international client projects!
   

  

 What You'll Bring
   

  

**You can help us make a difference if you**
* have a degree in computer science, informatics, business with focus on IT, or a related field
* gathered approx. two years of relevant experience in IT consulting, either in part- or full time roles
* are no stranger to the buzzwords machine learning, cyber resilience, DevOps, agile, AI, and robotics
* bring hands-on experience with LLMs and other generative AI tools and know how to apply them across work tasks
* enjoy tackling complex digital challenges and are enthusiastic about developing and sharing solutions
* feel comfortable in interdisciplinary teams and global contexts and are flexible and willing to travel
* are excellent at understanding and communicating complex topics in English


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

**Shape the world of tomorrow**
* Shape the digital future of globally leading companies in an individual client context with overarching technical solutions
* Develop groundbreaking projects by enabling your clients to effectively use agile methods and modern approaches in the context of strategic IT implementation
* Smooth the path for tailored, future-oriented customer journeys based on precise analyses of the individual situation and with current market developments and trends such as machine learning in mind
* Design and optimize unique IT architectures within the framework of enterprise solution requirements, modern custom software developments, and sustainable digital solutions, including cyber resilience


 Additional info
   

  

**How To Grow With Us**
 We guarantee constant development incentives in an open and rewarding work environment! Together with a dedicated team of talented colleagues, you get to work on new challenges every day. Individual training offers and a culture of open feedback will provide the framework needed to explore and perfect personal strengths. Our modern structures allow focusing on the essence of our work - with easy travel booking, an excellent back-office support and comprehensive Knowledge Center. With our regular office Fridays and legendary events, we nurture a strong and close team network beyond our case work.
   

  

*#BCGPlatinion*
 Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: IT-driftansvarig
description:
Vill du ta ett ägarskap för IT-driften i ett bolag där tekniken bidrar till något större? På Medley får du utveckla en modern IT-miljö och samtidigt vara med och skapa bättre förutsättningar för folkhälsa, simkunnighet och rörelseglädje.
 



  





**Om Medley** 




 På Medley skapar vi platser där människor i alla åldrar kan mötas, röra på sig och må bättre. Vi driver och utvecklar över 30 badanläggningar runt om i Sverige, som varje år välkomnar omkring fem miljoner besökare till bad, träning och simundervisning. Här förenas ett viktigt samhällsuppdrag med en affärsmässig verksamhet - och just nu är vi inne i en spännande utvecklingsfas med fokus på digitalisering och smartare arbetssätt.
 



  





**Om rollen** 




 Som IT-driftansvarig har du det operativa och delar av det taktiska ansvaret för Medleys IT-drift och rapporterar till IT-chef Johan Jansson.
 



  





 Du ansvarar för att hålla ihop och utveckla Medleys IT-drift i nära samarbete med våra externa IT-partners och verksamheten. Rollen kombinerar eget operativt arbete med att koordinera och följa upp våra partners.
 



  





 Rollen är bred och kombinerar löpande IT-drift med utveckling och förbättring av vår IT-miljö samt arbete inom IT-säkerhet, system och integrationer.
 



  





**Huvudsakligt ansvar** 



* **IT-drift** 
 – ansvara för den löpande IT-driften och säkerställa en stabil, säker och välfungerande IT-miljö. Ta ägarskap för incidenter och tekniska problem och driva dem till lösning.
* **IT-partners** 
 – koordinera och följa upp våra IT-partners och tillsammans med dem säkerställa en bra och effektiv leverans.
* **Rutiner och arbetssätt** 
 – ansvara för och utveckla interna IT-rutiner, processer och dokumentation samt driva förbättringar och effektiviseringar.
* **IT-säkerhet** 
 – driva det operativa IT-säkerhetsarbetet och säkerställa att beslutade säkerhetsåtgärder genomförs och följs upp.
* **Nya anläggningar** 
 – ansvara för IT-arbetet vid etablering och implementation av nya anläggningar i nära samarbete med verksamheten och våra partners.
* **Användare och verksamhet** 
 – utbilda, vägleda och stödja användare samt bidra till bra, effektiva och säkra digitala arbetssätt.
* **System och integrationer** 
 – arbeta med tekniska frågor kring våra system och integrationer samt felsöka och driva frågor tillsammans med verksamhet och leverantörer.



  





**Vem söker vi?** 




 Vi söker dig som har några års erfarenhet av IT-drift eller en liknande teknisk roll och en bred förståelse för hur en modern IT-miljö hänger ihop. Du arbetar självständigt, tar ägarskap för tekniska frågor och vet när du behöver involvera en specialist eller extern partner.
 



  





 Du är strukturerad, ansvarstagande och lösningsorienterad med ett genuint tekniskt intresse. Eftersom rollen har många kontaktytor är du även serviceinriktad och pedagogisk, med förmåga att lyssna in behov och förklara teknik för användare på olika kunskapsnivåer.
 



  





 Du har erfarenhet av flera av följande områden:
 


* Microsoft 365, klienter, identitet och behörigheter
* Nätverk och moderna IT-miljöer
* IT-säkerhet
* Felsökning och incidenthantering
* Samarbete med externa IT- och systemleverantörer
* Koordinering av tekniska implementationer



  





 Erfarenhet av integrationer, API och automation är högst meriterande. Det är även ett plus om du använder AI som ett praktiskt arbetsverktyg och ser möjligheter att effektivisera IT-driften. Du behöver inte kunna allt från början – det viktigaste är att du har en stabil teknisk grund, tar ansvar och vill fortsätta lära dig.
 



  





**Vi erbjuder** 




 Här får du en central roll med stort utrymme att påverka. Medley har byggt en modern och säker IT-grund, men det finns fortfarande mycket att strukturera, förbättra och utveckla. För rätt person finns möjlighet att bredda ansvaret och bidra till Medleys fortsatta arbete med digitalisering, automation och AI.
 



  





 Du rapporterar till IT-chefen, som leder genom frihet under ansvar och uppskattar egna initiativ och tydligt ägarskap.
 



  





 Tjänsten utgår från Medleys kontor på Sankt Eriksgatan 121A i Stockholm, med arbete på plats fyra dagar i veckan och möjlighet att arbeta hemifrån en dag.
 



  





**Rekryteringsprocess** 




 I denna rekrytering samarbetar vi med HCM Partner. Ansvariga rekryteringskonsulter är Sara Burman och Hanna Ringqvist.
 



  





 Rekryteringsprocessen innefattar intervju, tester och referenstagning. Bakgrundskontroll genomförs på slutkandidat.

title: Systemingenjör
description:
Som systemingenjör kommer du vara med i utvecklingen av tekniska produkter och system. Här får du vara med och omsätta verksamhetsbehov till tekniska lösningar, samt säkerställa att systemen fungerar genom hela utvecklings- och integrationskedjan.
   

  

**Arbetsuppgifter:**
 Du kommer att arbeta med kravhantering, systemdesign och analyser i utvecklingsprojekt där flera teknikdiscipliner samverkar. Rollen omfattar att definiera och bryta ned krav, ta fram lösningar, koordinera integration mellan olika system samt delta i verifiering och validering av lösningarna du tagit tar fram.
   

  

 Du kommer att samarbeta nära utvecklare, arkitekter, testingenjörer och andra specialister för att säkerställa att systemen uppfyller krav på funktion, kvalitet och säkerhet. Arbetet omfattar hela produktlivscykeln, från tidiga konceptfaser till färdig leverans.
   

  

 Du kommer genomgå en säkerhetsprövning innan start.
   

  

**Önskvärda kompetenser och erfarenheter**
* Systemingenjörsarbete i tekniskt avancerade miljöer
* Kravhantering och systemdesign
* Systemutveckling eller mjukvaruutveckling
* Förståelse för systemarkitektur och integration
* Verifiering och validering av tekniska system
* Tekniska analyser och utredningar
* Cloudmiljöer och moderna utvecklingsprocesser
* CI/CD
* Distribuerade system och realtidssystem
* AI- och dataplattformar
* Säkerhetskritiska system
* Fordonsindustrin, tillverkningsindustrin eller tungindustri
* Elektronik- eller produktutvecklande verksamhet
* Komplexa tekniska produkter och system där flera discipliner samverkar
* God kommunikationsförmåga på svenska och engelska i tal och skrift
* Högskole- eller civilingenjörsutbildning inom datateknik, mjukvara, elektronik, mekatronik, teknisk fysik eller motsvarande


**Önskvärda egenskaper**
* Analytisk och strukturerad
* Stark problemlösningsförmåga och helhetssyn
* Förmåga att växla mellan detaljer och övergripande perspektiv
* Kommunikativ och samarbetsorienterad
* Nyfiken och drivs av att förstå komplexa system och tekniska samband
* Självständig med god förmåga att driva frågor framåt


**💚 Humanit**
 Humanit handlar om att göra saker lite annorlunda, att på riktigt sätta våra anställda i fokus. Vi växer tillsammans och värdesätter engagemang och ambition. För oss är det viktigt att du får chansen att vara med och påverka vägen framåt.
   

  

 I utbyte erbjuder vi kompetens- och karriärutveckling genom varierande och utmanande uppdrag. Vi är inte branschinriktade och kan därför erbjuda en fantastisk variation bland uppdragen för dig som konsult. Självklart ser vi till att du får rätt utbildning och vi är väl medvetna om att det är det livslånga lärandet som bygger vår framgång.
   

  

 Tillsammans skapar vi framtiden 🚀
   

  

* Tillsvidareanställning med fast månadslön
* Kollektivavtal
* Vi tillämpar sex månaders provanställning, inklusive maxat friskvårdsbidrag
* Utvecklingsplan
* Hälsoförsäkring + pension
* Förskottssemester


**Start** 
 : Omgående med hänsyn till uppsägningstid och när säkerhetskontroll är genomförd. Uppdraget är på heltid och är tillsvidare.
   

  

**Plats** 
 : Stockholm
   

  

**Ansökan** 
 : Vi rekryterar löpande. Så skicka in din ansökan redan idag!
   

  

***Sveriges 7:e bästa arbetsplats 2026!***
*Humanit arbetar tillsammans med Great Place To Work för att vi skall bli Sveriges bästa arbetsplats.*
**Och förresten:**
*Som en aktiv del i ett samhälle med kulturell och social mångfald är Humanit’s ambition att präglas av inkludering och bred representation, samt vara en arbetsplats med lika möjligheter för alla. Humanit anställer, bibehåller, befordrar och i övrigt behandlar alla medarbetare och kandidater efter erfarenhet, kvalifikationer och kompetens, oavsett kön, religion, ursprung, ålder, sexuell läggning, könsidentitet eller funktionsvariationer.*

title: Technical Account Manager - Stockholm
description:
**About Us**
 Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.
   

  

 Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.
   

  

 1,000+ customers across 50+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to
 **$100M+ in ARR** 
 , with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI and Graceview.
   

  

 We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.
   

  

 Joining Legora means three things.
   

  

* We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.
* We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.
* We grow together: as a team and with our customers.


 Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.
   

  

 If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.
   

  

 This is the most senior seat on the advisory ladder and the person our largest clients trust when it matters most. In legal AI, that trust is hard-won: matters run to fixed dates, data is privileged, and clients hold Legora to the same standard of care they apply to their own work. Part technical advisor, part incident lead, part operating model owner, you hold the technical health of Legora's most complex client relationships and define the playbook the whole function runs on.
   

  

 What you’ll do
   

  

* Own the relationship: Hold the technical health and escalation outcomes for our Strategic Accounts, serving as their primary point of escalation and continuity, and read usage and adoption signals to get ahead of risk.
* Lead in a crisis: Act as incident lead on Sev1 and Sev2 events, owning coordination, customer communication, and the path to resolution. Drive post-incident reviews as trust-building artifacts and product feedback loops, not just process checkboxes.
* Set the standard: Define and own the escalation criteria, account-health model, and cross-team interfaces the function runs on. Build mechanisms that make the team consistent and not dependent on individual heroics.
* Own the Technical Blueprint: Maintain the single source of truth for each account, including data setup, integrations, security and legal considerations, and workflow context. Carry technical context from implementation into the live relationship so nothing is lost in the handoff and the whole account team can rely on it.
* Drive adoption and enablement: Run technical reviews and enablement sessions that deepen product usage, unlock new value, and keep customers current on the platform.
* Partner proactively: Work with Engagement Managers (CSM function) on Quarterly Business Reviews that tie technical health to business outcomes.
* Coordinate escalations: Align the Platform Consultants and the Technical Platform Expert around a single resolution path, holding customer-facing ownership while technical root cause is driven in parallel.
* Stay close to the signal: Own the highest-stakes cases in the L2 queue for your assigned Strategic Accounts, and serve as the escalation point for Platform Consultants before an issue reaches the Technical Platform Expert, so you stay close to the ground truth of each account's technical health.


 What you bring
   

  

* You have owned strategic, high-value B2B accounts and kept clients confident when things went wrong.
* You have led incident response or major escalations under pressure, start to finish.
* You communicate with executives as clearly as with engineers: confirmed facts, explicit trade-offs, named owners, and no speculation presented as certainty.
* You build frameworks, not workarounds, and you raise the bar for everyone around you.
* A background in legal AI, legal tech, or a regulated professional-services domain is a strong plus.


 What’s in it for you
   

  

* Global collaboration: Partner with teams and clients across regions, on work that crosses every major legal market.
* Meaningful work: Your work shapes how the world’s leading legal teams adopt AI day to day.
* Competitive package: Comprehensive salary, benefits, and the tools to do your best work.
* In-person environment: A workspace built for ambitious builders.


**Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer**
 At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: IT-säkerhetsspecialist till Must
description:
Vill du använda din erfarenhet inom mjukvara och IT-säkerhet för att bidra till ett säkrare Sverige i en osäker värld?
   

  

 Då ska du söka dig till oss på avdelningen för krypto och IT-säkerhet på Must! Vi söker nu IT-säkerhetsexperter som vill arbeta med att ta fram de kryptosystem och IT- säkerhetskomponenter som skyddar Sveriges säkerhet.
   

  

**Huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter**
 Rollen IT-säkerhetsspecialist är tydligt inriktad på mjukvara och mjukvarunära IT-säkerhet. Rollen passar dig som vill ta ansvar, påverka tekniska vägval och bidra med djup expertis. Arbetet bedrivs i projektform där du får arbeta tillsammans med några av Sveriges ledande IT-säkerhetsexperter.
   

  

 I arbetet ingår bland annat att:
   

  

* Kravställa och granska kryptosystem, protokoll och IT-säkerhetskomponenter, samt testa och verifiera implementationer av dessa.
* Utvärdera säkerhetsarkitekturer, identifiera sårbarheter, genomföra säkerhetstester, granska kod och ställa krav på produkter och produktutveckling.
* Utveckla våra policyer, standarder och metoder inom IT-säkerhetsområdet.
* Bedriva kontinuerlig och systematisk omvärldsbevakning.


**Om enheten**
 Som IT-säkerhetsexpert på avdelningen för krypto och IT-säkerhet får du möjlighet att arbeta i en miljö där erfarenhet värderas högt, där beslut grundas i teknisk förståelse och där säkerhet är en grundförutsättning inte ett tillägg. Hos oss värdesätts säkerhet, kvalitet och långsiktighet högre än snabba genvägar. Vi strävar efter att ligga i teknisk framkant och ser kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling som en självklar del av arbetet. Hos oss får du tid, förtroende och stöd att fördjupa dig inom ditt expertområde. Vi samarbetar även nära med andra myndigheter och organisationer, både i Sverige och internationellt.
   

  

 Vi erbjuder ett viktigt och stimulerande arbete där du dagligen bidrar till Sveriges säkerhet. Vi erbjuder också mycket goda möjligheter till kompetensutveckling. Hos oss finns det
   

  

 friskvårdsmöjligheter som inkluderar träning tre timmar i veckan på arbetstid, samt goda förutsättningar till balans mellan fritid och arbete.
   

  

**Personliga egenskaper**
 För att trivas och lyckas i rollen ser vi att du är analytisk. Du tycker om att sätta dig in i komplexa tekniska sammanhang och har förmåga att kritiskt granska kryptosystem,
   

  

 säkerhetsarkitekturer och implementationer för att identifiera risker, sårbarheter och förbättringsområden.
   

  

 Du är lösningsorienterad och tar gärna initiativ för att driva arbetet framåt. Du tar ansvar för att identifiera säkerhetsutmaningar, hitta lösningar och bidra till välgrundade tekniska vägval.
   

  

 Noggrannhet är viktigt för dig och du arbetar strukturerat samt med hög precision. Du förstår vikten av detaljer när du kravställer, granskar kod, genomför säkerhetstester och verifierar säkerhetskritiska implementationer.
   

  

 Du trivs med att arbeta tillsammans med andra och delar gärna med dig av din kunskap. Du bidrar aktivt i projekt och har lätt för att kommunicera och diskutera komplexa säkerhetsfrågor med andra.
   

  

**Kvalifikationer**
* Erfarenhet inom IT-säkerhet och/eller mjukvaruutveckling, alternativt annat för tjänsten relevant område.
* Akademisk utbildning inom relevant område eller motsvarande kompetens förvärvad genom arbetslivserfarenhet.
* Erfarenhet av utveckling i ett etablerat systemprogrammeringsspråk, exempelvis C eller C++.
* God förmåga att läsa och skriva teknisk dokumentation på både svenska och engelska.


**Meriterande**
* Erfarenhet av att designa, utveckla och leverera säkerhetskritiska system.
* Vana att granska och identifiera brister i design och implementation av säkerhetskritisk mjukvara.
* Erfarenhet av olika utvecklingsmetodiker och att producera robust mjukvara.
* En djup förståelse för hur operativsystem fungerar, exempelvis Linux eller Windows.
* Erfarenhet av inbyggda system eller anpassning av säkerhetsfunktioner i Linux eller Windows.
* Kunskap om systemarkitektur, domänseparation och begrepp som principle of least privilege.
* Erfarenhet av penetrationstestning eller reverse engineering.
* Kunskap om signalskyddssystem.
* Erfarenhet av arbete i Försvarsmakten.


 Vid urval kommer stor vikt att läggas vid personliga egenskaper.
   

  

 Ovan ställda kvalifikationer ska på begäran kunna verifieras genom intyg, referenser samt arbets- eller urvalstester.

*människors lika värde, rättvisa och jämlikhet och främjar demokrati och mänskliga rättigheter (läs mer på www.forsvarsmakten.se).*

title: IT-säkerhetsspecialist - SIEM Expert
description:
**Om tjänsten** 




 Som SIEM Expert ansvarar du för drift, förvaltning och utveckling av Svenska kraftnäts SIEM-lösning för säkerhetsövervakning. Du bidrar till att stärka säkerheten i en av Sveriges mest samhällskritiska verksamheter genom att utveckla och förbättra säkerhetsövervakningen i en komplex IT- och OT-miljö.
 



  





 Du driftar och underhåller säkerhetsövervakningsplattformen Splunk och arbetar nära plattformens användare inom Security Operations Center (SOC) samt IT-driftsorganisationen. I uppdraget ingår bland annat konfiguration och förvaltning av Splunk-kluster, Linux-administration samt utveckling av innehåll i plattformen.
 



  





**Tjänsten innebär bland annat att:** 



* Drifta, förvalta och utveckla Svenska kraftnäts SIEM-lösning för säkerhetsövervakning.
* Utveckla nya funktioner i SIEM-lösningen.
* Utveckla och förvalta datamodeller i SIEM-plattformen.
* Tillgodose SOC-analytikernas behov genom en nära dialog och ett tätt samarbete.
* Utföra drift- och förvaltningsåtgärder i SIEM-systemet.
* Arbeta tillsammans med IT-drift för att ansluta nya IT-system till SIEM-plattformen.
* Vara en del av Svenska kraftnäts team för att hantera IT-säkerhetsincidenter.Som IT-säkerhetsspecialist



  





 Hos oss får du möjlighet att utvecklas inom IT-säkerhet i en verksamhet med höga säkerhetskrav. Rollen erbjuder stora möjligheter till personlig utveckling och kontinuerlig kompetensutveckling.
 



 Du får arbeta tillsammans med erfarna kollegor, dela kunskap både internt och med externa samarbetspartners inom branschen och myndighetsvärlden samt bidra till den fortsatta utvecklingen av Svenska kraftnäts säkerhetsövervakning.
 



  





 Du är placerad på enheten Operativ IT-säkerhet, som är en del av IT-säkerhetsavdelningen. Här arbetar du i ett team med omkring 20 tekniska IT-säkerhetsspecialister som tillsammans ansvarar för att upprätthålla, utveckla och förbättra Svenska kraftnäts säkerhetsplattform. Du arbetar med system som spänner över både IT- och OT-miljöer i en samhällskritisk verksamhet.
 



  





**Om dig** 




**Skallkrav:** 




 Personliga egenskaper:
 



 Vi söker dig som är samarbetsorienterad, analytisk, strukturerad och lösningsorienterad. Du trivs med att samarbeta med andra och har ett strukturerat arbetssätt som hjälper dig att analysera komplexa tekniska miljöer och hitta hållbara lösningar.
 



 Du ska också leva upp till den statliga värdegrunden.

 Du har en akademisk utbildning inom IT eller motsvarande kompetens förvärvad på annat sätt som Svenska kraftnät bedömer likvärdig.
 



  





**Du har även:**

title: SAP Technical Architect
description:
**Job Description**
**Be part of something bigger. Decode the future.**
 At Electrolux Group, as a leading global appliance company, we strive every day to shape living for the better for our consumers, our people and our planet. We share ideas and collaborate so that together, we can develop solutions that deliver enjoyable and sustainable living.
   

  

 Come join us as you are. We believe diverse perspectives make us stronger and more innovative. In our global community of people from 100+ countries, we listen to each other, actively contribute, and grow together.
   

  

 Join us in our exciting quest to build the future home.
   

  

**All about the role:**
 The SAP Technical Architect is a strategic role that will enable business capabilities with SAP technology. The role includes creation of technology roadmaps as well as governance and support of existing deliveries and will be instrumental in modernising Electrolux technical landscape.
   

  

 Working with the landscape in Electrolux means working with a wide range of applications in a global environment. Electrolux landscape includes applications from on premise ERP, SCM, EWM, etc to public cloud solutions like IBP, CCv2, C4C, etc. There is currently a big modernisation of the landscape moving into private cloud/RISE, Integration Suite, BW/4HANA, BTP and eventually S/4HANA.
   

  

 The successful candidate is passionate about driving business value from technical solutions, analysing and designing solutions and collaborating with different level of stakeholders in a global setting. You will be part of a team of global architects with expertise in different business processes and technologies.
   

  

**What you'll do:**
* Create and own the SAP landscape strategy and design technical landscapes, both on premise and cloud.
* Establish and maintain SAP technical architecture principles, standards and guardrails to ensure scalable, secure and supportable solutions across the SAP landscape, for example considering data volume and performance.
* Define and govern non-functional requirements including security, availability, performance, resilience, recoverability and operational supportability.
* Own architecture decisions and review proposed solutions from functional and technical teams to ensure alignment with architecture standards.
* Collaborate with SAP, implementation partners and internal teams to jointly resolve complex issues or design solutions.
* Provide architecture leadership and guidance in high-priority support issues.
* Create and own the roadmap for Application Lifecycle Management to ensure the applications used are efficiently supporting the IT processes.
* Participate in ERP modernisation program, including move to private cloud, conversion to S/4HANA and implementation of Business Data Cloud (BDC).
* Proactively monitor innovation and emerging technologies, including AI-driven capabilities, to identify business value opportunities.
* Mentor and provide guidance to technical and functional teams and promote architecture best practices across the organization.


**Who you are:**
* You possess excellent written and oral communication skills and ability to communicate complex concepts to senior IT management, technical, functional and business teams in English.
* Demonstrate strong business acumen, with a solid understanding of SAP business processes and the ability to influence stakeholders through effective relationship management and communication.
* Able to work independently and as part of distributed, multi-disciplinary, multi-national teams with good collaboration skills
* Able to deal with ambiguity and manage multiple priorities
* A proactive learner with a strong passion for continuously expanding your knowledge and skills across SAP technologies and the broader digital ecosystem.
* Hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
* Fluent in English.


**Required qualifications** 
**:**
* 8+ years of SAP technical platform and architecture experience, including significant experience designing and governing enterprise-scale hybrid SAP landscapes.
* Proven experience acting as SAP Technical Architect, Lead SAP Basis Architect, SAP Platform Architect or equivalent architecture leadership role.
* Application Lifecycle Management, including e.g. transports, monitoring, testing and documentation using Solution Manager, CloudALM and/or third party tools.
* S/4HANA conversion, preferably with experience in optimizing downtime.
* Experience with SAP BTP platform architecture, account models, service enablement, for example linked to AI.


**Nice to have** 
 :
   

  

 The following experience is a plus, but not mandatory:
   

  

* SAP Security, including roles and authorisation design.
* Integration technology (PI/PO, CPI, Integration Suite).
* Custom development on stack and side-by-side in BTP or non-SAP platforms.
* SAP licensing and commercial models (on-premise, RISE, BTP and cloud subscriptions).
* FinOps, linking cloud consumption with financial processes, both for public cloud and credit-based solutions such as BTP, BDC, AI and PCE/RISE.
* Experience working with Enterprise Architecture frameworks.


**Where you will be:**
 This is a full-time position based in Electrolux Group's headquarters in Stockholm in the Stadshagen district of Kungsholmen.
   

  

 We offer 20% workplace flexibility, while maintaining the collaboration, connectivity, and team spirit that come from working together at our Global Headquarters.
   

  

 With more than 60 nationalities under one roof, you will be part of a dynamic international environment where English is the common language and diversity is part of everyday life.
   

  

**Benefits highlights:**
* Generous vacation allowance and a range of family-friendly benefits, including extended paternity leave.
* Comprehensive insurance coverage.
* Discounts on our award-winning Electrolux products and services.
* Extensive learning and development opportunities, with flexible career paths.
* Access to in-house sports facilities.


 We look forward to receiving your application!
   

  

 As part of Electrolux, we will continuously invest in you and your development. There are no barriers to where your career could take you.

title: (Senior) AI Tech Consultant, Enterprise Solutions - Stockholm | BCG Platinion
description:
Who We Are
   

  

 Do you want to turn the challenges of digitalization into the solutions of the future? Join BCG Platinion in tackling the core technology issues of leading global companies!
   

  

 Deploy customized platforms, architectures, strategies, and organizations to leverage the digital potential of our customers and drive true innovation, with state-of-the-art tools such as cloud computing, AI, blockchain, microservices, and containerization. Add your individual strengths to our unique team, always there to support you. Together with Boston Consulting Group and our clients, we turn digital visions into reality.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

 For our Stockholm office, we are looking for (Senior) AI Tech Consultants for our Enterprise Solutions chapter!
   

  

 At BCG Platinion, we provide sound advice on all relevant IT issues. In particular, the migration to the SAP S/4HANA solution against the background of the planned mainstream maintenance presents our customers with special challenges. The typical questions our customers have range from justification and business benefits of the SAP S/4 HANA Transition to optimized roadmaps taking into account the implications on overall architecture and also alternative solutions and platforms.
   

  

 To serve our customers even better, we would like to strengthen our Enterprise Solutions team. You work together with colleagues from Platinion and/or the Boston Consulting Group on local and international customer projects. Together with our customers, you actively develop superior, business value driven ERP and application architecture strategies, concepts and roadmaps and apply your sound technical and process-related understanding. Last but not least, you enjoy your work and embody the 'BCG Platinion Spirit' with your hands-on manner.
   

  

 What You'll Bring
   

  

**This Is How You Make a Difference**
* An above-average degree in computer science, business informatics, business administration or a related field
* At least 3 years of relevant experience in the context of strategic ERP/CRM/SCM projects
* Technical knowledge along typical end-to-end processes relevant in the enterprise solutions context (Purchase-2-Pay, Order-2-Cash, Lead-2-Quote, Record-2-Report, Hire-2-Retire etc.)
* General knowledge of wider portfolio of industry specific solutions, solution add-on’s and analytical tools
* Exceptional analytical and conceptual skills
* Hands-on experience with LLMs and other generative AI tools and the ability to apply them across work tasks
* Fluent in one Nordic Language and English (written and spoken)
* Strong client and result orientation
* Team spirit, communication and presentation skills as well as intellectual agility
* Ability to align individuals and organizations to a common goal


 Who You'll Work With
   

  

**Shape The World Of Tomorrow**
* Supporting the client in ERP/CRM/SCM projects along the entire supply chain: from requirements analysis to solution design/technical concept, implementation, testing, training and rollout
* Design / definition of specific ERP/CRM/SCM solutions along the value chain of our clients and the required functional modules Introduction of 'best practices' in the evaluation, specification and implementation of user requirements, in particular with a view to reducing one-off and maintenance costs
* Technical management of implementation and migration projects or in specific domains Requirements management within the scope of enterprise solutions projects, incl. the management of specialist concept workshops with business process managers
* Control and prototyping of customizing of ERP/CRM/SCM solutions Support in the sale of large Enterprise Solutions projects by providing technical and methodological expertise
* Further development of the content of the enterprise solutions topics at BCG Platinion, e.g., through participation in conferences, in the creation of a training catalog or with technical articles


 Additional info
   

  

**How You Can Grow With Us**
 We guarantee constant development incentives in an open and rewarding work environment! Together with a dedicated team of talented colleagues, you get to work on new challenges every day. Individual training offers and a culture of open feedback will provide the framework needed to explore and perfect personal strengths. Our modern structures allow focusing on the essence of our work - with easy travel booking, an excellent back-office support and comprehensive Knowledge Center. With our regular office Fridays and legendary events, we nurture a strong and close team network beyond our case work.
   

  

*#BCGPlatinion*
 Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Solution Consultant
description:
Who is Benifex? 💚💜
   

  

 We are a fast-moving technology company, and one of the most successful providers of online reward and benefits solutions in the world. We believe that everyone deserves an exceptional experience at work, every day, and build workplace technology that makes this happen. Benifex’s mission is to build remarkable experiences that employees love. Today Benifex supports more than five million employees in over 3,000 organisations across more than 100 countries. To help us on our quest to be the best, we need brilliant people on board and that’s where you come in. 🚀
   

  

**Why you should apply ⭐**
* Impact: You'll play a pivotal role in shaping best‑practice employee benefits solutions for customers around the world
* Rewarding: Work on complex, varied implementation projects across UK&I and international markets, keeping your work challenging and rewarding
* Growth: Build deep expertise in benefits technology, integrations and the global benefits landscape, with clear opportunities to grow at different seniority levels
* Ownership: Be trusted to own your solutions end‑to‑end, acting as a key advisor to customers, brokers and benefit providers
* Sunday Times Best Place to Work 2025 and Best Large Tech Company to Work for 2025
* Work for a profitable, fast-growing market leader in the online reward and employee benefits space


**Great Benefits**
 ⚖️ A hybrid working model
   

  

 🧠 ITP1 pension
   

  

 ❤️ Lifeplan - a leading financial advisory service that offers personalized advice for maximizing your pension savings
   

  

 📝 Collective agreement
   

  

 💸 Access to our comprehensive benefits portal
   

  

 🤸 Generous wellness allowance
   

  

 ✈️ 30 vacation days / year
   

  

 💰 Referral bonuses
   

  

 🌟 Enhanced parental pay
   

  

 🙂 Volunteer Days – two paid days annually to give back to the community.
   

  

 Role Overview
 **🚀**
 As a Solution Consultant at Benifex, you’ll act as the vital bridge between our customers and our internal technical teams, ensuring successful delivery of employee benefits portal implementations. Working across customers of varying size and complexity, you’ll gather and translate requirements into high-quality, best‑practice solutions that deliver an excellent user experience. You’ll take ownership of your designs, confidently explaining technical concepts to non‑technical stakeholders while collaborating closely with technical experts. This role suits a proactive, solution‑oriented consultant who enjoys problem‑solving, building relationships and making a real impact on customer outcomes.
   

  

**Responsibilities** 
**🤘**
* Lead collaboration with customers, brokers and benefit providers throughout implementation projects across UK&I and international markets
* Gather, document and analyse customer requirements, producing detailed solution designs aligned to Benifex best practices
* Partner with technical colleagues to design feasible, scalable solutions that meet customer goals within Benifex technology
* Identify risks, exceptions and edge cases early, designing robust end‑to‑end processes and workflows
* Deliver solutions with a strong focus on user experience for both employees and customer administrators
* Build and maintain trusted advisor relationships with key customer stakeholders
* Act as a subject matter expert on benefits, Benifex solutions and integrations for internal teams
* Support product development initiatives with customer and market insights
* Represent Benifex as a solution expert in sales meetings when required
* Contribute to and continuously improve Benifex best‑practice libraries, processes and implementation standards
* Share knowledge and act as a role model within the consulting community, supporting the development of others
* Continuously research and expand your understanding of the global benefits landscape


**What we are looking for** 
**🔎**
* Experience in a customer‑facing, requirements‑gathering role within a project delivery environment
* Proven ability to deliver multiple customer projects simultaneously
* Experience working on system integration projects, ideally HR or Payroll integrations
* Strong ownership mindset with a completer‑finisher approach and high accountability
* Evidence of proactively driving improvements and constructively challenging the status quo
* Excellent communication skills, with the ability to explain complex or technical concepts to varied audiences
* Confidence in navigating difficult conversations with empathy and fairness
* A collaborative team player with a solution‑oriented, problem‑solving mindset
* Comfortable working with technology and logical process design
* Experience in the benefits/HR/ technology/payroll industry in a consulting or implementation role


 Our Interview Process ✌
   

  

 Benifex understands the need to have a fast and efficient process, the below will all be completed in the shortest time possible.
   

  

 📞 Initial interview with the Talent Team
   

  

 ⏳ Interview and Presentation with the Hiring Manager
   

  

 🤩 Final Interview with a Senior Team Member/Director.
   

  

 Please apply with an English CV.

**We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected. We believe that diversity and inclusion are essential to our success, and we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.**

title: Internal IT Support – Parental Leave Cover
description:
Svea Solar is entering an exciting new phase of sustainable growth. Following a transformation that has already delivered strong results, Svea Solar is steadily strengthening its profitability and operational efficiency, creating a solid foundation as a leading company within Energy Solutions.
   

  

 In short, we are maturing as a company. We are aiming to become the trusted energy partner for our customers, lowering energy bills for thousands of European households. This also means strengthening our position within Internal IT.
   

  

 We're now looking for an Internal IT Support Specialist to join our four-person Internal IT team on a parental leave cover from November 2, 2026, until July 30, 2027.
   

  

 The team and the role
   

  

 Your days will be varied. Very varied. We're a high-paced environment, so you'll need to be comfortable switching between different tasks and occasionally rolling up your sleeves to handle the less glamorous stuff too.
   

  

 One moment, you might be making sure a meeting room works before an important presentation. The next, you're troubleshooting a laptop, managing a support ticket, helping with access rights, or escalating an issue to colleagues working with CRM, ERP or Data & Analytics.
   

  

 This is a parental leave cover, but we want your time with us to be valuable beyond the assignment. Your main focus will be providing internal IT support, with the opportunity to broaden your skills and take on additional responsibilities over time. So depending on your performance and interests, you may also get exposure to areas such as infrastructure, IAM, IT security, networking and hardware.
   

  

 Are we a match?
   

  

 You don't need ten years of experience. In fact, we're more interested in your attitude and willingness to learn.
   

  

**What Matters Is That You**
* Have an IT education, either from high school or further education
* Have previous experience working with IT support
* Have experience with ticket management, using Jira or a similar system
* Have hands-on experience with computers and hardware
* Have a strong level of English, both written and spoken
* Are comfortable working from our office 4 days per week

title: Optimisation Engineer
description:
**About us** 




 Ingrid was born out of a simple belief: the energy transition must move faster and work smarter. We're pioneers at the forefront of the global energy transition — pushing boundaries, turning bold ideas into reality, and solving the problems that matter most.
 



  





 The INtelligent GRID of tomorrow needs to absorb and release more power. We develop, build and operate high-performance batteries — the lungs of modern energy infrastructure — enabling a more flexible and resilient energy supply across Europe. With 500 MW already deployed across the Nordics and rapid expansion into continental Europe, we manage, optimise and trade both our own assets and those of third parties through our sophisticated tech platform, making every battery — and the entire grid — stronger.
 



  





**Watch our film** 




  





**About the team** 




 At Ingrid, our tech team builds and maintains an in-house optimisation engine to maximise battery efficiency within the grid. We also focus on creating a data-driven culture by building data pipelines and a Business Intelligence layer to provide stakeholders with actionable insights. Our team plays a key role in driving strategic decision-making and overall company success, and we work closely together to ensure a smooth transition of ideas from concept to reality. At Ingrid, we foster a collaborative and inclusive environment where everyone’s voice is valued. We believe in empowering our team members to make a real impact.
 



  





**About the role** 




 As our Optimisation Engineer at Ingrid, you'll lead efforts in optimising battery storage to support the grid and transition to renewable energy. You'll be key in improving our battery optimisation algorithms, ensuring they operate at peak efficiency. This role requires strong mathematical skills and a mix of optimisation techniques. The impact of your work on our revenue is substantial, with an annual output that continues to grow. You'll collaborate across teams to incorporate diverse data into our models and translate insights into actions.
 



  





 Location: Stockholm (on-site)
 



  





**What you'll do** 



* **Contribute to the evolution of our battery system optimisation algorithms.** 
 Craft and refine them to maximise efficiency and economic performance, leveraging multi-stage optimisation strategies.
* **Apply your mathematical expertise to real-world energy challenges.** 
 Apply deep mathematical knowledge and cutting-edge problem formulation techniques to tackle intricate energy storage challenges using stochastic optimisation, linear programming, and reinforcement learning.
* **Bridge the data gap.** 
 Collaborate closely with your team to seamlessly integrate forecasts and other crucial data into our optimisation models.
* **Champion innovation.** 
 Cultivate a culture of continuous improvement by actively contributing to the advancement of our data science and optimisation approaches.
* **Collaborate to optimise.** 
 Work
 
 closely with stakeholders to align business goals with tailored optimisation solutions.



  





**Who we think you are** 




 Ideally, you have experience from the energy sector, particularly battery storage or renewable energy systems, and experience in battery optimisation or hydro optimisation is, of course, very meritorious. You have a track record of innovation and a problem solving mindset, in complex, data-driven projects.
 



  





 Here's what will set you up for success:
 


* **Experienced Optimiser:** 
 You have proven experience in optimisation, data science, operations research, applied mathematics, or other related field, with a strong foundation in optimisation algorithms and/or machine learning.
* **Math Mastermind:** 
 Solid foundation in mathematical concepts essential for optimisation modeling, including linear programming and scenario analysis.
* **Technical Expertise:** 
 You're comfortable applying various optimisation methods, including linear programming. Proficiency in Python or another suitable programming language for optimisation tasks is required.



  





 For this role, we think you have an educational background in mathematics, engineering physics, data science, energy systems, computer science or similar.
 



  





**Why join us?** 




 At Ingrid, we're pioneers at the forefront of the global energy transition — pushing boundaries, turning bold ideas into reality, and solving what matters most. Our culture is built on Bold Impact · Curious Grit · Inspiring Collaboration. We believe a thriving organisation runs on trust, growth, and learning from mistakes — and that wellbeing matters as much as work. From lunch & learns to social activities, we make space to connect, recharge, and thrive together.
 



  





**Next step** 




 We’ll make selections on an ongoing basis and finalise the recruitment as soon as we’ve found the perfect match. This process will run over summer vacations and we will keep everyone involved updated on our expected timeline.
 



  





 We look forward to hearing from you!
 



 /Team Ingrid

title: Senior Investigator
description:
At Accenture, you can bring your innovative vision to the heart of change to transform entire market sectors. Shape the future of business and technology by developing cutting-edge solutions that create new value.
   

  

 Your role and opportunities
   

  

 Join our international network of talents in the Incident Response field. You will work with innovative technologies on exciting projects, developing solutions to manage data securely. Specifically, you will be able to:
   

  

 Responsibilities:
   

  

  

- Perform incident response to cybersecurity incidents, including but not limited to APT & Nation State attacks, Ransomware infections and Malware outbreaks, Insider Threats, BEC, DDOS, Security and Data breach, etc.

- Conduct in-depth investigations of cybersecurity incidents, identifying the root cause, the extent of the impact, and recommended actions for containment, eradication, and recovery, and providing a final report that contains recommendations on how to prevent the same attack in the future by strengthening security posture.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather information, coordinate incident response efforts, and communicate findings to relevant stakeholders, including management and legal teams.

- Perform digital forensics examinations on various digital devices (workstations, servers, mobile devices, etc.) to collect, analyze, and preserve evidence related to security incidents or policy violations.

- Develop/Update incident response plan, playbooks, process, and process documentation to ensure standardized incident response procedures.

- Participate in threat hunting activities, proactively seeking out and identifying potential security threats and weaknesses.

- Assist in implementing and fine-tuning security tools and technologies to enhance threat detection and incident response capabilities.

- Conduct training sessions and workshops to educate employees on cybersecurity best practices and incident response procedures.

- Work closely with the Nordic clients to ensure quality relationships.

 If you share our passion for cybersecurity and have the following characteristics, we are looking forward to meeting you:
   

  

  

- Knowledge of file and memory forensics techniques and commonly used tools such as EnCase, Axiom, Autopsy, Kape, Plaso, Volatility, and FTK Suite.

- Good command of incident management and response processes and procedures.

- In-depth knowledge of cybersecurity operations, security monitoring, EDR and SIEM tools, including Crowdstrike, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, TrendMicro VisionOne, and Splunk.

- Experience in conducting static or dynamic malware analysis, using solutions such as IDA Pro, OllyDbg, REMnux distro, and other disassemblers/debuggers.

- Detailed knowledge of Windows and Unix-based operating systems and administrative tools.

- Proficiency in English & Swedish.

- Ability to pass Security Clearances in Sweden

- Familiarity with disk and memory forensic analysis (Windows, Unix, or Linux environments).

- Knowledge of security controls such as authentication and identity management, network architectures enhanced for security, and application-based controls (including Windows, Unix, and network equipment).

- Proficiency in network traffic analysis and protocols using tools such as Wireshark.

- Interest to work closely with the clients, building relationships.

 Please expect slower feedback on your application due to summer vacation period, until August 11.
