title: Analytiker - AI och digital verksamhetsutveckling
description:
Sjukvården står inför ett av sina största skiften någonsin. Ny teknik och datadriven analys öppnar helt nya möjligheter att förbättra vården – för patienter, medarbetare och verksamheter. Vill du vara med och driva den förändringsresan på ett av världens bästa sjukhus?
   

  

 Vi söker nu en nyfiken och engagerad analytiker som vill inrikta sig mot AI och verksamhetsutveckling samt bidra till högre kvalitet, bättre flöden och tryggare vårdprocesser för våra patienter.
   

  

**Du erbjuds**
* en varierande och meningsfull roll där du får verka nära verksamheten i en engagerad och professionell miljö
* arbeta i en dynamisk och utvecklingsorienterad miljö
* möjlighet att fördjupa dig och bygga verklig spetskompetens inom analys och digital utveckling, med stöd av erfarna kollegor
* chansen att vara med och forma hur vi använder ny teknik, data och AI för att förbättra vården
* att se ditt arbete göra verklig skillnad – för patienter och medarbetare, inte bara på pappret
* en arbetsplats där nyfikenhet och analytisk skärpa värdesätts högt


 Självklart får du också ta del av våra generella förmåner som Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset erbjuder dig.
   

  

**Om tj** 
**ä** 
**nsten**
 Uppdraget för Tema Akut och Reparativ Medicin (ARM) är att säkerställa högklassig vård, forskning och utbildning för patientgrupper inom akutsjukvård, internmedicin, trauma- och akutkirurgi, ortopedi, infektionssjukdomar, plastik- och käkkirurgi, Öron näsa hals Hörsel och balans samt transplantation.
   

  

 Tema ARM har cirka 1 800 medarbetare inom sex medicinska enheter och tre omvårdnadsenheter. Verksamheten omfattar såväl akutsjukvård och det kompletta omhändertagandet av den akut sjuka patienten som Karolinskas högspecialiserade uppdrag inom områdena ovan. Verksamheten bedrivs i Huddinge och Solna samt på Danderyds sjukhus och Rosenlunds sjukhus.
   

  

 På Tema ARM är du ett viktigt stöd i arbetet med att säkerställa att både enskilda verksamheter och temat som helhet når sina mål. Du samarbetar nära med medarbetare, chefer och temaledning och ingår i ett team av verksamhetsutvecklare som stöttar hela temat kring leverans.
   

  

 Rollen har tyngdpunkt på analys och data kombinerat med verksamhetsutveckling, kravinsamling och projektledning. Du arbetar nära verksamheten för att förstå hur den fungerar, identifiera behov och gå till botten med komplexa problem. Målbilden är att ta fram analytiskt beslutsstöd som gör det enkelt för verksamheterna att fatta rätt beslut. Du tar ansvar för hela kedjan – från analys och identifierade behov till implementerad lösning och utvärderad effekt.
   

  

 Allt utvecklingsarbete har samma övergripande syfte: att skapa bättre utfall för våra patienter och en enklare vardag för våra medarbetare. Du får möjlighet att successivt utvecklas i rollen med stöd av mer erfarna kollegor.
   

  

**Dina Arbetsuppgifter Kan Bland Annat Innebära Att**
* analysera komplexa verksamhets- och patientflöden samt utveckla datadriven uppföljning, analysunderlag och analytiska beslutsstöd
* arbeta med prediktion, prognoser, simulering och flödes- och resursoptimering över hela vårdkedjan
* arbeta med, testa och utveckla AI-lösningar, såväl egna prototyper som befintliga verktyg
* träffa medarbetare och chefer för att kartlägga behov och identifiera var digitala lösningar kan skapa nytta
* genomföra behovsinventering och kravställning tillsammans med verksamheten
* stödja införandet av digitala verktyg och arbetssätt, inklusive utbildning och uppföljning
* arbeta med verksamhetsstyrning och andra verksamhetsutvecklande insatser
* växla mellan analysarbete och projektledning utifrån uppdragets behov.


 Vår förmåga att leverera vård utifrån patienternas behov är alltid viktigast och arbetsuppgifterna kan därför variera utifrån verksamhetens behov. Du får möjlighet att arbeta med både kortsiktiga uppdrag och mer långsiktiga utvecklingsinitiativ och att successivt utvecklas i rollen med stöd av mer erfarna kollegor.
   

  

 Arbetet sker främst på Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset i Solna och Huddinge, men arbete kan även förekomma vid våra verksamheter på Danderyds sjukhus och Rosenlunds sjukhus. Du arbetar på plats i verksamheten under merparten av arbetsveckan.
   

  

**Vi s** 
**ö** 
**ker dig som**
* har god analytisk och problemlösande förmåga och kan strukturera, tolka och dra välgrundade slutsatser av komplexa data- och verksamhetsunderlag. Du ska kunna presentera underlaget på ett pedagogiskt sätt.
* ser dig själv mer som specialist än generalist – du vill gå till botten med problem och analysera och förstå saker på djupet
* trivs med att vara ute i verksamheten, är lyhörd för olika perspektiv och har god samarbetsförmåga samt lätt för att bygga relationer med medarbetare och chefer på olika nivåer
* är driven och tar initiativ – du arbetar strukturerat och självständigt, driver arbetet framåt och tar ansvar för att det leder till genomförande och faktisk effekt i verksamheten
* trivs med ett varierat jobb och är nyfiken – du är flexibel och uppskattar att variationer kan ske snabbt med kort omställning.


 Vidare ser vi gärna att du är serviceminded och ser dig själv som en del av teamet som bidrar till att vi når våra gemensamma mål att driva utveckling av vård i världsklass
   

  

**Kvalifikationer**
**Krav**
* Högskoleutbildning med kvantitativ inriktning, till exempel datavetenskap, statistik eller annan beräkningsinriktad ("computational") utbildning, alternativt annan relevant utbildning
* Minst 1 års relevant arbetslivserfarenhet
* Erfarenhet av att ha samlat in eller sammanställt behov från verksamhet/kund
* Erfarenhet av att arbeta med data- eller verksamhetsunderlag som grund för slutsatser och beslut, gärna inom AI
* Flytande språkkunskaper i svenska, både tal och skrift
* Mycket goda kunskaper i Excel, PowerPoint och Office 365


**Meriterande**
* Praktisk erfarenhet av att ha arbetat med digital utveckling och/eller införande av digitala verktyg i en organisation, exempelvis genom tidigare anställning eller projekt under studietiden
* Erfarenhet av att ha deltagit i ett fullständigt utvecklingsprojekt, från behov till infört system
* Goda kunskaper i SQL och minst ett relevant programmeringsspråk, exempelvis Python
* Erfarenhet av Tableau eller annat analys-/visualiseringsverktyg
* Erfarenhet av prediktion, simulering eller experimentella/kausala metoder (till exempel A/B-test), exempelvis inom kapacitets- eller vårdplanering
* Projektledning
* Erfarenhet från hälso- och sjukvård eller annan komplex, reglerad verksamhet


**Om rekryteringsprocessen**
 Urval och intervjuer kan komma att ske löpande under ansökningstiden.
   

  

 I samband med din ansökan behöver du bifoga CV. Istället för ett personligt brev ber vi dig besvara urvalsfrågor samt kort motivera varför du passar för rollen. Att besvara frågorna är en förutsättning för att din ansökan ska anses komplett.
   

  

 Varmt välkommen med din ansökan - Tillsammans är vi Karolinska!
   

  

 Inför tillsättning av befattning som innefattar vård av barn och ungdom, kontrolleras den som erbjuds tjänsten mot misstanke- och belastningsregistret. Här kan du läsa mer om rekryteringsprocessen och om vilka kontroller som utförs på Karolinska.
   

  

 Som anställd på Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset kan du komma att krigsplaceras. Läs mer om vad det innebär här.
   

  

 Om du är eller tidigare har varit anställd i Region Stockholm kommer vi att ta interna referenser från din nuvarande eller tidigare chef om du blir aktuell för anställning.
   

  

 För tillsvidaretjänster kan provanställning komma att tillämpas.
   

  

**Om Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset**
 Vi på Karolinska Universitetssjukhuset är stolta över att vi är ett av världens främsta universitetssjukhus. Förutom vårt särskilda ansvar för den högspecialiserade vården i Stockholmsregionen är huvuduppdraget att tillsammans med Karolinska Institutet utbilda framtidens vårdanställda och bedriva världsledande forskning samtidigt som vi fortsätter vårt arbete med att utveckla vården för patientens bästa. Vi arbetar inom en rad olika områden och professioner.
   

  

 Du kan läsa mer om vårt uppdrag inom vård, forskning och utbildning här.
   

  

 Vår vision - Vi ska bota och lindra imorgon det ingen kan bota och lindra idag.
   

  

 Läs gärna mer om oss på karolinska.se och följ oss på sociala medier!
   

  

**Tema Akut och Reparativ Medicin**
 Tema Akut och Reparativ Medicin består av sex medicinska enheter (Akut, Trauma/akutkirurgi och ortopedi, Plastikkirurgi och kraniofaciala sjukdomar, Öron näsa, hals Hörsel och balans samt Transplantation).
   

  

 Här kan du läsa mer om oss.
   

  

**Att söka jobb i Region Stockholm**
 Vi eftersträvar jämställdhet och jämlikhet på vår arbetsplats och ser gärna sökande med olika bakgrund och förutsättningar.
   

  

 Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via detta system. Ansök genom att klicka på knappen ”Ansök”. Ansökningar per brev eller e-post beaktas inte. Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt säljare av ytterligare jobbannonser.
   

  

 Vårt rekryteringssystem kan inte hantera anonyma ansökningar eller sökande med skyddade personuppgifter. Om du har skyddade personuppgifter ber vi dig att kontakta den kontaktpersonen som finns angiven i annonsen. Din ansökan kommer då att hanteras utanför rekryteringssystemet. Du bör även vara försiktig med vilken information du lämnar i din ansökan och endast ta med information som är relevant för den aktuella befattningen.
   

  

 Region Stockholm ansvarar för hälso- och sjukvård, kollektivtrafik, regional utveckling och bidrar till kulturlivet. Varje dag, dygnet runt. I landets snabbaste växande region. Tillsammans skapar vi Europas attraktivaste storstadsregion.
   

  

 Läs mer om hur det är att jobba hos oss i Region Stockholm (öppnas i nytt fönster)

title: Head of Accounting and Reporting Transformation Platform
description:
**Are you interested in leading others and take on one of the most critical transformation roles in Swedbank? At Swedbank, we believe that successful leaders enable us to realize our strategy.**
 As Head (and Product Manager) of ART (Accounting and Reporting Transformation), you will take full ownership of both the solution and the organization responsible for Swedbank’s next-generation accounting platform. This includes delivering and realizing value from a group-wide Oracle-based general ledger and accounting hub, replacing a complex legacy landscape.
   

  

 This is the midst of a multi-year, business-critical transformation that goes far beyond technology replacement. It redefines finance processes, data structures, controls, and development in the accounting area. You are the accountable leader for the area – combining strong people leadership with true end-to-end product ownership. Your mandate is clear: deliver a future-proof accounting solution, fully realize its value, and do so at pace.
   

  

 This is a rare opportunity to shape the financial core of a leading bank — with visibility at the highest levels and real impact on performance, compliance, and future competitiveness
   

  

 Your responsibilities:
   

  

* Be a leader who builds trust, inspires people and shows courage.
* Aligning your work and the team’s contribution to the bank’s direction and strategy.
* Take full product ownership of the Oracle platform, with accountability for delivery, quality, and tangible value realization at group level.
* Lead one of Swedbank’s most significant transformation initiatives – replacing legacy general ledgers and accounting hubs with a unified Oracle-based solution.
* Drive delivery with intensity and precision, ensuring progress, momentum, and business impact in a complex, high-stakes environment.
* Own and execute the product strategy and roadmap, balancing business area demands, finance needs, and long-term architectural direction.
* Ensure the solution delivers real transformation – simplifying processes, improving data quality, strengthening controls, and enabling faster insight.
* Lead and develop a high-performing leadership team and organization, building a strong culture of accountability, collaboration, and delivery excellence.
* Secure end-to-end alignment across Finance, IT, Data organization and Business/Product areas, engaging senior stakeholders with credibility and clarity.
* Ensure stability, compliance, and resilience of the accounting platform, meeting the high standards of financial and regulatory control.
* Actively explore and leverage AI to transform both accounting processes and the way the transformation itself is delivered.


 What is needed in this role:
   

  

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree, or equivalent deep work experience in a related field.
* A senior leader with a strong track record of owning and delivering complex, business-critical solutions – ideally in Product Manager or equivalent roles with full accountability.
* Proven ability to drive large-scale finance or accounting transformations, with a relentless focus on delivery and value realization.
* Deep expertise in banking accounting, including financial reporting, regulatory frameworks, and end-to-end flows from source system to general ledger and onwards to consolidation and reporting.
* Hands-on experience from ERP implementations in finance, preferably Oracle-based, including data migration, process redesign, and platform consolidation.
* Strong product mindset – able to define vision and strategy, and translate it into execution with clear priorities, milestones, and outcomes.
* A delivery-oriented leader who combines structure and pace with the ability to navigate complexity and remove obstacles.
* Highly collaborative team player with the ability to build trust and alignment across senior stakeholders in Finance, Business and Technology.
* Curiosity and forward-leaning perspective on how AI and automation can reshape accounting and accelerate transformation.
* Demonstrated ability to modernize legacy landscapes and drive simplification and standardization at scale.
* A courageous and accountable leader who challenges constructively, takes decisions, and leads through change with integrity.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, fluent in Swedish and English.


 With us, you can experience:
   

  

* Personal and professional growth through self-leadership and continuous development.
* Meaningful work that positively impacts our workplace, our customers, and society.
* An open and collaborative culture that encourages cross-functional teamwork and provides networking opportunities.
* A supportive and inclusive environment that promotes a balanced and sustainable work-life, with flexible working conditions when suitable for the role.
* Benefits such as our share based reward program Eken, company pension plan, employee offer for banking products, health insurance.


 "This is our team...
   

  

 Take on a challenging role in a highly skilled and dynamic team, where you can continue to grow as a professional. Given the nature of the work, you will collaborate across CFO Office and the enterprise growing your network. We expect ambition, proficiency and self-leadership from our teams. We are always open to new ideas helping us to improve. You will belong to and work together with a professional, competent and open team''
 **Nina Larsson, Recruiting Manager**
 We look forward to receiving your application by 20.09.2026.
   

  

**Location:** 
 Stockholm
   

  

**Recruiting manager:** 
 Nina Larsson
   

  

 We want to inform you that the selection process may begin after the summer holidays.
   

  

**Swedbank does not discriminate anybody based on gender, age, sexual orientation or sexual identity, ethnicity, religion or disability – everybody is welcome.**

title: IT CHANGE MANAGER
description:
**Challenges You Will Work On**
 At SAS, change is constant, but disruption should not be. As Change Manager, you will ensure that changes to critical IT services are implemented in a structured, controlled, and predictable way, balancing innovation with operational stability.
   

  

 You will own and continuously improve the IT Change Management process across SAS, helping teams deliver change with confidence while minimizing operational risk. Working closely with technical teams, service owners, and business stakeholders, you will strengthen the quality, predictability, and transparency of change activities across the organization.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities Include**
* Own and continuously improve the end-to-end IT Change Management process, governance framework, policies, and procedures.
* Ensure production changes are properly documented, risk-assessed, tested, approved, scheduled, and communicated before implementation.
* Lead and develop Change Advisory Board (CAB) and Emergency CAB practices.
* Coordinate the forward schedule of change and proactively manage dependencies, conflicts, and operational constraints.
* Collaborate with infrastructure, cloud, security, application, release, deployment, and vendor teams to improve quality change.
* Ensure emergency changes follow an appropriate governance process while maintaining operational responsiveness.
* Track change-related incidents, failed changes, and recurring quality issues, driving corrective actions, and continuous improvement.
* Define, monitor, and communicate KPIs, trends, and risk indicators related to change management.
* Drive post-implementation reviews and ensure lessons learned are translated into improved ways of working.
* Develop and enhance ServiceNow workflows, automation, and data quality related to change management.
* Promote a culture where governance enables safe and efficient delivery.


 The Team
   

  

 You will work closely with Service Owners, Application Owners, Infrastructure and Cloud teams, Cybersecurity specialists, Product and Development teams, and strategic technology partners across SAS. The role also involves collaboration with business stakeholders supporting critical airline operations, where effective change management is essential for maintaining stability and service quality. As SAS continues its digital transformation journey, this role offers the opportunity to strengthen operational excellence and help shape how technology changes are delivered across the organization.
   

  

 To be successful we believe you have
   

  

* Strong experience in IT Service Management and IT Change Management within a complex enterprise environment.
* Solid understanding of ITIL practices, particularly Change Enablement, Incident Management, Problem Management, Release Management, and Configuration Management.
* Experience working with ServiceNow or a similar enterprise ITSM platform.
* The ability to assess technical and operational risk and facilitate decisions across multiple teams and stakeholders.
* Experience from high-availability, mission-critical, or 24/7 operational environments.
* Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, communication, and analytical skills.
* Experience driving governance, process improvements, and operational excellence in a collaborative environment.
* The ability to build trust, create alignment, and influence stakeholders across both technical and business teams.
* A structured and proactive approach combined with a continuous improvement mindset.
* ITIL certification, or equivalent practical experience, is considered an advantage.


 Why SAS?
   

  

**Benefits**
 At SAS, we offer extensive opportunities for professional development in an international, fast-paced working environment. We are dedicated to the continuous growth of our employees. Working with us comes with a variety of benefits, including:
   

  

* Travel Perks: Enjoy discounted travel opportunities around the world with SAS.
* Health & Wellness: Access to health and wellness benefits, including a newly renovated gym with complimentary classes such as CrossFit and yoga.
* Discounts: Receive discounts from a wide range of brands, as well as on transportation to and from airports, airport shops, hotels, and car rentals.
* Work Environment: Our office location in Frösundavik offers a vibrant workspace with a restaurant, café, and easy access to outdoor activities in Hagaparken and Brunnsviken. Engage in running, tennis, outdoor gym sessions, kayaking, and stand-up paddling with equipment available free of charge.
* Convenient Commute: Benefit from a non-stop bus service connecting our office to Solna station, and commuter trains, alongside a network of cycle paths.


 Our Culture at SAS
   

  

 At SAS, we are dedicated to caring for each other, delighting our travelers, and driving the transformation towards sustainable aviation. As a future colleague on our team, you'll join a culture where we work collaboratively towards common goals, recognize each other's contributions, and celebrate successes. Our focus is on safe, sustainable, and punctual execution, and we are committed to protecting our planet while transforming SAS for the future. This is an empowering workplace where you can thrive, grow, and take ownership of your work. Join us at SAS and be part of shaping the future of aviation!
   

  

 Come and fly with us!
   

  

 Additional information
   

  

* Apply by: 16/09/2026. We review applications continuously, so please send us your CV as soon as you can. The role may be filled before the deadline.
* Start and scope: Full-time role, starting with a 6-month probation period.
* Location: This position is based in Stockholm or Copenhagen. This is mainly an onsite role, with some flexibility for remote work depending on the agreement with your manager.
* Security: As this role is security classified, a background check will be part of the final stage of the recruitment process.


 If you have any questions about the role, please contact Jarno Putta, Head of Service Management, at jarno.putta@sas.se. Please note that, due to GDPR, we can’t accept applications by email.

title: Tech Procurement Specialist
description:
**TL;DR:**


You'll own how Lovable sources and negotiates the vendor relationships that power the product: deals taken end-to-end from "an engineer needs this" to a signed contract, the economics modelled properly, and the process and data left better each time. Procurement judgement first, tooling second — we'll help you with the second part.

**Why Lovable?**


Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.


We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.


Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

**The portfolio you'd own**


This is a big book from day one. Lovable runs on a fast-growing stack of software, infrastructure and services, and the pace of that hasn't slowed since launch.

* **10–25 live processes at any given time, and a multi-million dollar value portfolio.** Real money, genuinely custom commercial and legal terms, and no dedicated owner today. You’ll get to set the playbook, not inherit someone else's.
* **Decisions that land in the P&L.** These are numbers big enough to matter at company level, which means the gap between an average outcome and a sharp one is visible from the top. Few procurement roles offer this much line of sight from a single negotiation to the financials.
* **A seat at the biggest tables.** You'll work alongside Finance, Legal, EPD and Partnerships on the relationships that matter most to how the company operates, and the mandate grows as the company does — we're scaling fast, and so is what this role owns.

**What we’re looking for**

* **You've done this before:** tech procurement, strategic sourcing or vendor management, and you know the platforms and benchmarking sources that tell you what "good" looks like for a company our size.
* **Commercially sharp negotiator:** you compare offers, find leverage, and know when to push, when to walk away and when to escalate. You don't only chase a lower number: you reframe the shape of a contract so it works better for both sides. Precise, prepared, calm under pressure.
* **Technically fluent and financially rigorous:** you grasp technical concepts well enough to partner with Product and Engineering, translate requirements into commercial implications, and pressure-test vendor claims. You can also model pricing structures, commitments, credits, discounts, ramps, usage scenarios, renewal options, minimums and overages, and land on a clear recommendation.
* **Process-minded:** you ask where the data should live, what should be standard next time, and what should never again depend on someone remembering. One-off heroics become playbooks.
* **Fluent enough in product and engineering context:** you can sit with a PM or an engineer, understand what a vendor actually powers, and carry that into the commercial conversation.
* **Data-comfortable and AI-native:** messy data from contracts, invoices, billing exports, usage and vendor portals doesn't faze you, and you use AI as leverage by default. Some SQL, scripting or no-code helps. We'll support you here — curiosity matters more than existing skill.

**What you’ll do**

* **Run sourcing and vendor negotiations end-to-end:** need, market scan, RFP/RFQ, commercial modelling and legal negotiation, recommendation, approval, signature and renewal readiness. The whole process, not one slice of it.
* **Partner with Finance, Legal, Product and Engineering:** FP&A and business owners on demand, Product and Engineering on requirements, Legal on risk and redlines, vendor fit and implementation risk.
* **Support strategic partnerships and complex deals:** non-standard relationships where Lovable may be customer, vendor, partner or infrastructure buyer at once. Partnerships owns the front end; you pick it up at deal economics and carry it to signature.
* **Turn deal structures into decisions:** scenarios, walk-away positions and a crisp memo people can act on.
* **Enrich the flow and the systems behind it:** intake today is close to binary — here's what I want to buy, here are the reviews. Bring in vendor intelligence and deal benchmarking, build up the contract, renewal and SLA data, and evolve intake, approvals and CLM so every agreement lands in the right system with the right metadata.
* **Automate the parts that shouldn't need judgement:** vendor research, contract extraction, renewal alerts, benchmark gathering, approval routing and negotiation prep.

**About your application**


Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.


We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.

title: Software Verification Engineer
description:
### **Responsibilities**


* Contribute to the design and development of new MedTech products as part of a cross-functional project team.
* Define software requirements and specifications based on product standards, requirements, and risk analysis.
* Plan, execute, document, and report software verification activities.
* Test and evaluate embedded software to ensure functionality, performance, reliability, and compliance with applicable standards.
* Integrate and verify software developed by other engineers.
* Contribute to system-level risk analysis and product verification activities.
* Ensure compliance with relevant medical device regulations and standards, including FDA, MDR, and ISO requirements.
* Participate in technical design reviews and maintain required product and project documentation.
* Provide technical support to Manufacturing, Quality Assurance, and Operations when needed.


**Requirements**


* BSc or MSc in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience with embedded software and testing in electromechanical systems.
* Experience with real-time operating systems (RTOS).
* Experience with test automation and scripting.
* Hands-on experience with diagnostics and debugging of embedded software.

description:
**WANT TO REVOLUTIONIZE GOLF?**

  

At Toptracer, we create technology that makes golf more engaging — from ball-tracing technology used in broadcasts worldwide to interactive experiences enjoyed by millions of players at driving ranges.

  

Join our Stockholm R&D team and work with talented, down-to-earth colleagues where you can make a real impact. We develop, test, and deploy our technology from Stockholm. Combining innovation, golf, and a fun, collaborative culture.

We are looking for a Senior Infrastructure Engineer to help develop, test, and deliver the infrastructure services behind Toptracer’s camera-based driving range technology. In this role, you will transform business and operational needs into reliable technical solutions. You will work closely with our infrastructure, software, and hardware teams throughout the full development lifecycle from planning and testing to implementation and continuous improvement.  

  

A central part of the role is sharing your expertise across the organization. You will train and support infrastructure colleagues in Toptracer’s internally developed hardware and software, while helping our global teams and partners build the knowledge required to operate our technology successfully.


You will also lead infrastructure-related projects, coordinate initiatives across multiple teams, and contribute to establishing and developing infrastructure capabilities in the US and other international markets.


This is a hands-on senior position for someone who combines deep technical infrastructure knowledge with project leadership, collaboration, and a passion for developing both technology and people.

* Linux-based development and production environments

title: Exterior Parts Design Engineer / Component Owner
description:
We are looking for an experienced Exterior Parts Design Engineer with minimum 3 years of automotive experience in the development of exterior body components and plastic parts. The role combines hands-on design responsibility with technical leadership of components and subsystems throughout the complete product development lifecycle.
  
  

**YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:**  

In this role, you will act as Component Owner for assigned exterior components and subsystem areas throughout the entire product development process. You will be responsible for the design and development of exterior body parts such as bumpers, grilles, spoilers, trims, claddings, wheel arch moldings, and other related plastic components. A key part of the role involves creating and maintaining 3D CAD models and drawings in accordance with OEM standards and requirements.
  
  

You will lead technical activities and coordinate cross-functional stakeholders to ensure the successful delivery of components and subsystems. This includes driving design reviews, risk assessments, technical problem-solving, and engineering decisions, while managing interfaces between exterior systems and the surrounding vehicle architecture.
  
  

You will also be responsible for planning and monitoring design activities, deliverables, timing, and maturity status for your assigned components. Working closely with suppliers, you will support development and industrialization activities, as well as engineering change management throughout the project lifecycle. In addition, you will participate in DFMEA, tolerance analysis, design verification, and validation activities to ensure robust and high-quality solutions.
  
  

As a key technical contact, you will regularly communicate project progress, technical status, and potential risks to customers and other project stakeholders, contributing to successful project execution and customer satisfaction.
  
  

**YOUR PROFILE:**  

**To thrive and succeed in this role, we believe you have:**  

Bachelor or Master degree in Mechanical Engineering, Automotive Engineering or equivalent.
  
3+ years of experience in automotive exterior component development.
  
Strong knowledge of plastic component design and injection molding processes.
  
Experience with automotive exterior systems and visible Class-A related components.
  
Experience as Component Owner, Technical Lead or equivalent responsibility is highly meritorious.
  
Proficiency in CATIA V5/V6, Creo, NX or similar CAD systems.
  
Knowledge of GD&T, tolerance stack-up analysis and automotive product development processes.
  
Experience coordinating suppliers and cross-functional engineering teams.
  
  

As a person
  
  

We are looking for a confident and engaging leader with a strong ability to build trust and manage relationships with a wide range of stakeholders. You are experienced in driving and leading technical activities forward, even without formal line management responsibility, and are motivated by achieving results through collaboration and influence. As a person, you are structured, proactive, and solution-oriented, with a natural ability to identify opportunities and address challenges effectively. You communicate fluently in English and can adapt your message to different audiences. Furthermore, you have a strong sense of ownership and accountability, with a focus on delivering high-quality results on time while keeping customer value and business needs at the forefront.
  
  

**WE OFFER:**  

At AVL, you will become part of a global engineering company at the forefront of development, simulation, and testing for the future of mobility. As the world's largest independent company in this field, with more than 12,000 employees worldwide, we drive innovation to create a greener, safer, and better mobility future.
  
  

Our expertise spans the entire value chain, from early concept and development phases through to industrialization and series production. We work with cutting-edge technologies in electrification, software, autonomous driving, digitalization, and energy-efficient powertrain systems, helping our customers shape the mobility solutions of tomorrow.
  
  

At AVL, you will find a workplace where you can grow, make an impact, and contribute to advancing technological innovation that truly makes a difference for the future of mobility.
  
  

Interested?
  
  

In this recruitment process, we apply continuous selection. This means that the recruitment process may move quickly, and the position may be filled before the application deadline.
  
  

We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Doctoral Student in Human-in-the-Loop Autonomous Systems
description:
We are looking for 5 motivated Doctoral students to help design the next generation of human-in-the-loop autonomous systems at the Division of Interaction Design and Software Engineering.



You will contribute to a future in which we can rely on better robots, autonomous networks, and other smart systems – impacting domains such as healthcare, transportation, and other areas of our society. These systems are often software-intensive and we develop mechanisms to create better software for safer, more secure, and more usable systems. You will be supervised by Associate Prof. Rebekka Wohlrab, whose research focuses on human-centered software engineering and self-adaptive systems. She is currently building up a team of more than 10 people. It will allow you to be part of a fun environment where you can collaborate with other Doctoral students and postdocs working on similar topics!


**About us**
------------



The Department of Computer Science and Engineering, a joint department of Chalmers and the University of Gothenburg, spans the breadth of computing disciplines. Our internationally visible research, strong industry links and diverse environment create a collaborative setting where ideas grow into real impact.



At the Division of Interaction Design and Software Engineering, we design smarter ways to engineer better software, and explore how people engage with digital systems, combining global research perspectives with strong collaboration with industry.


**About the research projects**
-------------------------------



We are currently recruiting Doctoral students in two projects:



- "Expectations" project. The aim is to make autonomous systems aware of the expectations of their end users. Today, autonomous systems are not aware of what humans expect - even though such awareness could enable them to behave in ways that better align with user expectations or provide meaningful explanations when unexpected situations arise. We plan to represent and model expectations using formal methods, develop techniques that help a system reason about human expectations at runtime, and evaluate the contributions using simulations and experiments with physical robots.  

  

For this project, you need to be comfortable with mathematics and hold a degree in Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, or a related field.  

It is an advantage if you have experience with probability theory, reinforcement learning, or Markov Decision Processes. Coursework or project experience in multi-agent systems, reinforcement learning, and/or probability theory will strengthen your application.


* "Self-adaptation" project. The goal is to design solutions that enable adaptive coordination between teams of humans and autonomous systems. Today, coordination between humans and autonomous systems is often hard-coded, despite the fact that real-world situations frequently require different team compositions, communication structures, or varying degrees of centralization and decentralization. The project aims to enable adaptive coordination, especially in contexts where multiple humans and multiple autonomous systems are involved. Runtime models (e.g., behavior trees or state machines) will be used to support adaptive coordination and increase the flexibility of coordination mechanisms. You will design software architecture solutions for adaptive coordination, develop software prototypes, and run experiments to evaluate them. Depending on your interests, one relevant research direction is cybersecurity in human-machine teaming contexts, including how teams should respond when an autonomous system behaves suspiciously or may have been compromised by an attack.

  

For this project, you need to be comfortable with self-adaptive systems and software architecture, and have a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

The projects are partially supported by the Swedish Research Council (VR), the Swedish Foundation for Strategic Research (SSF), and Wallenberg AI, Autonomous Systems and Software Program (WASP). WASP is Sweden’s largest individual research program ever, a major national initiative for strategically motivated basic research, education and faculty recruitment. The program addresses research on artificial intelligence and autonomous systems acting in collaboration with humans, adapting to their environment through sensors, information and knowledge, and forming intelligent systems-of-systems. The vision of WASP is excellent research and competence in artificial intelligence, autonomous systems and software for the benefit of Swedish society and industry. Read more: https://wasp-sweden.org/  

  

The graduate school within WASP is dedicated to provide the skills needed to analyze, develop, and contribute to the interdisciplinary area of artificial intelligence, autonomous systems and software. Through an ambitious program with research visits, partner universities, and visiting lecturers, the graduate school actively supports forming a strong multi-disciplinary and international professional network between Doctoral students, researchers and industry. Read more: https://wasp-sweden.org/graduate-school


**Who we are looking for**
--------------------------


#### **The following requirements are mandatory:**


* To qualify as a Doctoral student, you must have a Master's degree (*masterexamen*) of 120 credits or a Master’s degree (*magisterexamen*) of 60 credits\* inComputer Science or a related field
* A well-documented track record of research interests and achievements in software engineering, formal methods, or a related field
* You are highly motivated, energetic, independent, and have well-developed analytical problem-solving ability
* Your communication skills in English (written and oral) are of a high quality


* *If you have acquired substantially equivalent knowledge in some other way, you may also qualify. For instance, a 4-year Bachelor’s degree is accepted.*


#### **The following experience will strengthen your application:**


* Published papers in peer-reviewed conferences, journals, or workshops

**What you will do**
--------------------


* Research and develop theoretical foundations, methods, models, and tools for human-in-the-loop autonomous systems
* Evaluate those contributions using rigorous empirical methods, both in the lab and potentially in industrial contexts (e.g., with our existing collaborators Volvo Group and Ericsson)
* Publish research papers and present your research in top venues
* Take courses at an advanced level within the Graduate school of Computer Science and Engineering.
* Teach on Chalmers' undergraduate level or perform other duties corresponding to 20 percent of working hours.

**Contract terms**
------------------


* The Doctoral student positions are fully funded from start.
* The position is a fixed-term appointment of five years (with 20% teaching or other departmental duties).
* A starting salary of 35,725 SEK per month (valid from May 1, 2026), with an increase of 5000 SEK per month after 2 years.
* Doctoral studies require physical presence throughout the entire study period. A valid residence permit must be presented by the study start date; otherwise the admission may be withdrawn.

**What we offer**
-----------------


* As a Doctoral student at Chalmers, you are an employee and enjoy all employee benefits. Read more about working at Chalmers and our benefits for employees.
* A dynamic and inspiring working environment in the coastal city of Gothenburg.
* Read more about Sweden’s generous parental leave, subsidized day care, free schools, healthcare etc at Move To Gothenburg.


Chalmers is dedicated to improving gender balance and actively works with equality projects, such as the GENIE Initiative for gender equality and excellence. We celebrate diversity and consider equality and inclusion as fundamental aspects of all our activities.



If Swedish is not your native language, Chalmers offers Swedish courses to help you settle in.



Find more general information about doctoral studies at Chalmers here.


**Application procedure**
-------------------------


*The application should be written in English and attached as PDF-files, as below. Maximum size for each file is 40 MB. Please note that the system does not support Zip files.*


**CV**


**Personal letter (max. 1 page)**


* Introduce yourself
* Describe your previous experience of relevance for the position (e.g., education, thesis work and, if applicable, any other research activities)
* Describe your future goals and future research focus


**Bachelor’s and, if available, master’s thesis together with the transcripts.**



Use the button at the foot of the page to reach the application form.  

  

A background check may be conducted as part of the application process.  

  

**Please note:** The applicant is responsible for ensuring that the application is complete. Incomplete applications and applications sent by email will not be considered. Contact details to references will be requested after the interview.



Application deadline: October 15, 2026  

There will be an ongoing selection process and the advertisement may close before the application deadline.


#### **For questions, please contact:**

*Rebekka Wohlrab*  

*Associate Professor*  

*wohlrab@chalmers.se*


### **We look forward to your application!**


*\*\*\* Chalmers declines to consider all offers of further announcement publishing or other types of support for the recruiting process in connection with this position.* \*\*\*



*Chalmers University of Technology in Gothenburg conducts research and education in technology and natural sciences at a high international level. The university has 3100 employees and 10,000 students, and offers education in engineering, science, shipping and architecture. With scientific excellence as a basis, Chalmers promotes knowledge and technical solutions for a sustainable world. Through global commitment and entrepreneurship, we foster an innovative spirit, in close collaboration with wider society.*  

*Chalmers was founded in 1829 and has the same motto today as it did then: Avancez – forward.*

title: C++ Engineer - Experience
description:
We design Spotify’s consumer experience—end to end, moment to moment, across every screen, platform, and partner integration. Our mission is to make listening feel effortless, personal, and joyful for billions of users around the world. That means turning complexity into clarity across hundreds of touchpoints—from our mobile and desktop apps to the smart speakers, TVs, cars, and integrations where Spotify shows up every day. If it touches a consumer, we shape it. We bring deep insight into human behavior, design, and technology to craft experiences that feel intuitive, expressive, and unmistakably Spotify.
   

  

 The Desktop Natives squad, part of the Platform & Partner Experience (PPX) Studio, builds and maintains the native layer of the Spotify Desktop app across Windows, macOS, and Linux. We work across the systems outside the shared UI layer, from packaging and delivery to operating system integrations, backend services, release tooling, and the native C++ desktop shell that brings together Client-Core, Chromium Embedded Framework (CEF), and Spotify’s Web Player. Our work sits at the intersection of systems engineering, performance, and user experience, helping Spotify feel seamless and truly native on desktop.
   

  

 What You'll Do
   

  

* Contribute to and maintain Spotify’s Desktop C++ application across macOS and Windows.
* Develop native container capabilities that enable UI teams to build new experiences and take advantage of evolving platform capabilities.
* Improve platform systems, CI configurations, build pipelines, packaging, and application delivery.
* Develop and maintain backend services supporting content delivery, update infrastructure, and release tooling.
* Build and improve operating system integrations, including features that connect Spotify with partner platforms.
* Collaborate with external partners such as Microsoft to make use of the latest platform capabilities.
* Contribute to cutting-edge work exploring AI agent integrations within the Spotify Desktop experience.
* Work closely with a distributed group of engineers and partners to solve complex problems across systems, platforms, and technologies.


 Who You Are
   

  

* You have strong C++ development skills and are comfortable working on production software with a large user base.
* You have experience navigating complex codebases that span multiple programming languages, technologies, and systems.
* You’re comfortable taking ownership of systems through development, maintenance, and continuous improvement.
* You enjoy solving complex technical problems and can work through ambiguity to find practical solutions.
* You’re curious about how things work and motivated to learn new technologies, platforms, and areas of the codebase.
* You collaborate effectively across teams and communicate your thinking clearly.
* You’re comfortable working with colleagues across a fully distributed team.


 Where You'll Be
   

  

* This role is based in Stockholm or London.
* We offer you the flexibility to work where you work best! There will be some in person meetings, but still allows for flexibility to work from home.


 Spotify is an equal opportunity employer. You are welcome at Spotify for who you are, no matter where you come from, what you look like, or what’s playing in your headphones. Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all thrive, contribute, and be forward-thinking! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our differences that we will find the power to keep revolutionizing the way the world listens.
   

  

 At Spotify, we are passionate about inclusivity and making sure our entire recruitment process is accessible to everyone. We have ways to request reasonable accommodations during the interview process and help assist in what you need. If you need accommodations at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know - we’re here to support you in any way we can.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. SEB is more than a bank. We are a technology-driven financial institution where everything starts from our customer needs and business outcomes. AI, data and modern engineering are natural parts of how we work, build and deliver value. From core banking platforms to agentic AI , automation, cybersecurity and cloud, we offer a broad tech landscape and many paths to grow. Together, we are shaping secure, responsible and future- proof solutions for our customers and society. Are you ready to take on a new challenge?
   

  

 About the role:
   

  

 As a Solution Developer with Test Automation, you will develop and maintain high quality IT solutions (includes e.g., requirements, analysis & design, coding and testing). This role also focusses on implementing and improving our test automations as well as performing manual tests where automation is not possible. You will be part of T-shaped agile team of developers and testers where everyone is contributing to achieving our team goals.
   

  

 This is the place for you if you are interested in being part of a high-performing team, with varied work tasks. Working with great team members, and where qualities such as analytical mindset and team collaboration are important.
   

  

 To thrive in this role, we believe you have:
   

  

* Proven hands-on experience in C# and T‑SQL with Stored Procedures, with the ability to contribute to both development, test automation and test activities
* Strong understanding of coding standards and software development best practices.
* Strong analytical mindset with a focus on continuous improvement of test automation, engineering processes, and quality standards
* Curiosity and interest in AI, combined with some experience or a strong motivation to explore and learn.
* Experience using LLMs as part of your development workflow, either professionally or through personal projects.
* Ability to debug and analyze issues using logs, configuration files, and code, and to document and track defects in collaboration with other developers and testers
* Experience working in Agile environments (preferably SAFe), actively participating in refinement, estimation, and delivery of features
* A bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent
* A coaching mindset and are ready to share knowledge with the rest of the team
* Great communication skills and fluency in English
* Experience in finance regulatory reporting is meritorious


**What we offer:** 
  

  

* Entrepreneurial Scandinavian environment
* Hybrid work model, meaning remote work is possible up to 2 days/week
* International opportunities and working environment
+ Attractive compensation and access to SEB staff banking with exclusive benefits


**Do you want to be part of SEB?**
 It is our fundamental belief that inclusion and diversity is crucial for our future success. We strive to have an inclusive, value-driven culture where employees feel valued, respected, and involved irrespective of who they are, what they believe or where they come from.
   

  

 Since we select candidates continuously, feel free to send in your application today via the link in this ad, but no later than 2026-09-18. If you have questions about the position, please contact Team Manager Nicklas Svanehav at nicklas.svanehav@seb.se, but we will not process applications via email.
   

  

 Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes for example identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and criminal records checks. In some cases, we also apply random drug checks. During employment, employees within SEB can also expect to undergo recurring background checks.
   

  

 SEB Sweden has a redeployment responsibility, why this position might be covered by internal redeployment.
   

  

**Learn more about working at SEB** 
 on our Career website or through our Career podcasts.
   

  

 https://sebgroup.com/career
   

  

 https://bit.ly/SEBcareer

title: Systemutvecklare .NET, Stockholm
description:

 Som
 **.NET-utvecklare**

Du arbetar genom hela utvecklingsprocessen och är med och fattar tekniska beslut som påverkar lösningarnas kvalitet, stabilitet och långsiktighet. Hos oss får du arbeta i agila teamleveranser tillsammans med utvecklare, arkitekter, testare och verksamhet, där samarbete och kunskapsdelning är en naturlig del av vardagen. Läs mer här.

* 5 000 kr i friskvårdsbidrag samt hälsostöd
* 30 dagars semester samt två extra lediga dagar per år
* Certifieringsbonus och kompetensutveckling
* Föräldralön, tjänstepension och försäkringar
* Bidrag till hemmakontor och arbetsutrustning


**Det här kommer du att göra**

* Vara delaktig i tekniska beslut, design och implementation

* Dela kunskap och stötta kollegor i tekniska frågor


**Teknisk miljö**
 Du arbetar genom hela stacken med backend i .NET, C#, ASP.NET Core och REST API:er samt databaser via Entity Framework Core och SQL Server. På frontend arbetar vi med TypeScript och React eller Angular. Våra leveranser bedrivs agilt med fokus på kvalitet och samarbete.
   

  

**Vi söker dig som har**
* Minst fem års erfarenhet av .NET och C#
* Erfarenhet av ASP.NET Core, API-utveckling och databaser
* Erfarenhet av moderna webbtekniker i JavaScript eller TypeScript
* Erfarenhet av att bygga eller vidareutveckla robusta system

**Meriterande**
* Erfarenhet av Azure eller annan molnplattform
* Erfarenhet av mikrotjänster eller integrationslösningar
* DevOps-arbetssätt inom exempelvis CI/CD och containerteknik


**Rekryteringsprocessen**
 Rollen ställer höga krav på kompetens och säkerhetsmedvetenhet. Inför eventuell anställning genomför vi bakgrundskontroll och vid intervju behöver du kunna uppvisa giltig legitimation.

title: AI för prediktivt underhåll av kollektivtrafikens anläggningar
description:
Stockholmsregionen växer kraftigt – och allt fler pendlar till, från och inom länet. Snabb tillväxt och ökade krav från resenärer ställer krav på mer och attraktivare kollektivtrafik. Den växande regionen innebär också utmaningar för framkomlighet i vägnät och belastningar på miljö och klimat. Trafikförvaltningen har som mål att inte bara erbjuda befintliga resenärer en attraktiv kollektivtrafik utan även höja kollektivtrafikens konkurrenskraft och därigenom utöka användandet av kollektivtrafik. På så sätt blir kollektivtrafiken en pusselbit för att lösa Stockholms utmaningar i framtiden.
   

  





**Bakgrund**




 Trafikförvaltningen ansvarar för de tekniska systemen på cirka 100 tunnelbanestationer, 50 pendeltågsstationer och drygt 30 depåer. Det är bland annat ventilation, pumpar, hissar, rulltrappor och reservkraft. Systemen övervakas dygnet runt från vår driftledning via styr- och övervakningssystemet iFIX, som hanterar omkring 300 000 mätvärden varav ungefär 75 000 av dem sparas historiskt.
   

  





 Underhållet är i dag i huvudsak kalenderstyrt eller avhjälpande. Åtgärder görs vid fasta intervall eller när något redan har gått sönder. Samtidigt innehåller larmflödet till driftledningen mycket brus. Vi utvärderar därför i en pilot om historiska driftdata och AI kan upptäcka begynnande fel innan de blir driftstörningar, och om en språkmodell som körs i vår egen miljö kan formulera trolig orsak och lämplig åtgärd. Ingen data lämnar våra system.
   

  





**Syfte**




 Inom ramen för ex-jobbet blir din uppgift:
 


* **Datakvalitet:** 
 undersöka om historiken faktiskt bär de mönster metoden förutsätter: samplingsintervall, dödband, lagringstid och verklig mätpunktstäthet för de utvalda pilotobjektens mätvärden.
* **Avvikelsedetektering och modelldrift:** 
 träna en modell på hur 30–50 mätvärden för ett installationsobjekt normalt hänger ihop, och lösa hur modellen ska lära om sig efter ett servicebesök. Annars larmar den på utrustning som just har servats och fungerar.
* **Textgenerering:** 
 utvärdera hur väl en lokalt körd språkmodell med uppslag i våra egna driftkort och serviceprotokoll kan beskriva orsak och åtgärd, och hur den kvaliteten bör mätas.



 Omfattningen anpassas efter kandidat- eller masternivå. Du behöver eventuellt inte täcka alla tre delarna utan vi bestämmer avgränsningen tillsammans vid uppstart.
   

  





**Metod och genomförande** 



* Inläsning på anläggningen, driftledningens arbetssätt och befintligt pilotunderlag.
* Uttag och kvalitetsgranskning av historiska driftdata för ett eller ett par pilotobjekt, exempelvis ett ventilationsaggregat på en depå.
* Modellering och experiment i Python. Språkmodellen körs på hårdvara hos oss.
* Validering mot kända servicebesök och felhistorik, kompletterat med intervjuer med drifttekniker och underhållsentreprenör.
* Rapport och presentation med en rekommendation vi kan agera på.



 Du sitter hos oss på Kungsholmen och har tillgång till handledare, driftledning och testmiljö.
   

  





**Din utbildning och erfarenhet**




 Du läser sista året på civilingenjörs- eller masterprogram inom datateknik, teknisk fysik, elektroteknik, automation, energi- och fastighetsteknik eller motsvarande.
   

  





 Vi söker dig som:
 


* kan programmera i Python och har grundläggande kunskaper i maskininlärning
* arbetar självständigt och strukturerat
* behärskar svenska i tal och skrift då driftkort, serviceprotokoll och underlag är på svenska



 Meriterande:
 


* erfarenhet av tidsseriedata eller anomalidetektering
* erfarenhet av språkmodeller och sökbaserad textgenerering (RAG)
* kännedom om styr- och övervakningssystem eller fastighetsautomation
* intresse för underhåll och driftverksamhet



**Handledare**




 Emelie Leach/Johan Andersson
   

  





**Kontaktuppgifter**




 Om du har några frågor kring exjobbet kontakta handledare Johan Andersson johan.p.andersson@sl.se. Om du har övriga frågor vänligen kontakta student@sl.se
   

  





**Ansökan**




 Alla exjobb på trafikförvaltningen ligger publicerade på Studentsamarbeten på trafikförvaltningen - Region Stockholm samt på KTH:s exjobbsportal. Ansökan sker via vårt rekryteringssystem, vi har inte möjlighet att ta emot ansökningar via e-post.
   

  





 Ansök redan i dag eftersom intervjuer kan ske löpande. Sista ansökningsdag är den
 **2 oktober.** 
 Vi ser fram emot din ansökan!
   

  





**Var finns vi?**




 Trafikförvaltningens lokaler finns på Kungsholmen i Stockholm, Lindhagensgatan 100.
   

  





**Om oss**




 Enligt våra medarbetare är vår samlade kompetens och det gemensamma engagemanget utmärkande för vår verksamhet. Här finns också chefer och ledare som jobbar för att skapa och bibehålla ett öppet klimat. Tillsammans bidrar vi till Stockholms samhällsutveckling genom att bygga och utveckla en hållbar, modern och tillgänglig kollektivtrafik för 2,3 miljoner invånare. Vårt uppdrag – den gemensamma resan.  
   

  





**Webb och sociala medier**




 För mer information om hur det är att jobba hos oss, besök vår karriärsida www.regionstockholm.se/tfjobb. Du hittar oss också på Linkedin.
   

  





 Nyckelord: prediktivt underhåll, maskininlärning, anomalidetektering, dataanalys, drift och underhåll, kollektivtrafik, automation
   

  





 Vi är stolta samhällsutvecklare. Med kompetens och engagemang tar vi Stockholm och kollektivtrafiken framåt. Vi ansvarar för SL, Waxholmsbolaget, Färdtjänsten och Spårvägsmuseet och tillsammans utvecklar vi en trygg, attraktiv och tillgänglig kollektivtrafik för nära 900 000 resenärer. Följ med oss på resan!
   

  





****Att söka jobb i Region Stockholm****




 Vi eftersträvar jämställdhet och jämlikhet på vår arbetsplats och ser gärna sökande med olika bakgrund och förutsättningar.
   

  





 Vi tar endast emot ansökningar via detta system. Ansök genom att klicka på knappen ”Ansök”. Ansökningar per brev eller e-post beaktas inte. Vi undanber oss direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt säljare av ytterligare jobbannonser.
   

  





 Vårt rekryteringssystem kan inte hantera anonyma ansökningar eller sökande med skyddade personuppgifter. Om du har skyddade personuppgifter ber vi dig att kontakta den kontaktpersonen som finns angiven i annonsen. Din ansökan kommer då att hanteras utanför rekryteringssystemet. Du bör även vara försiktig med vilken information du lämnar i din ansökan och endast ta med information som är relevant för den aktuella befattningen.
   

  





 Region Stockholm ansvarar för hälso- och sjukvård, kollektivtrafik, regional utveckling och bidrar till kulturlivet. Varje dag, dygnet runt. I landets snabbaste växande region. Tillsammans skapar vi Europas attraktivaste storstadsregion.

title: AI Engineer Internship
description:
**AI Engineer Internship - Uniplay**
 We are looking for an AI Engineer intern who wants to shape how companies turn knowledge into engaging learning experiences. This is not a traditional software internship; at Uniplay, we use AI-agent workflows, source grounding, RAG, structured generation, and learning science to create adaptive learning from real company material. Over 12 weeks, you will prototype new AI workflows, test them on real or representative knowledge sources, and present recommendations to the team. If you are excited about AI-native development, agentic coding, learning technology, and moving fast from idea to prototype, this is your launchpad.
   

  

 What you'll do
   

  

* Prototype AI Learning Tools: Build experiments that improve how Uniplay creates, adapts, and evaluates learning content with AI.
* Work with Real Knowledge Sources: Explore how documents, links, videos, and internal company knowledge can become useful learning experiences.
* Experiment with New Learning Formats: Test ideas like interactive lessons, inline quizzes, diagrams, short-form learning, knowledge graphs, or AI-generated explanations.
* Improve AI Workflows: Help identify bottlenecks in our AI production process and improve prompts, templates, evaluations, or internal tools.
* Test and Evaluate: Run your prototypes on real or representative material, compare outputs, collect feedback, and analyze what works.
* Present Findings: Deliver a final demo and report with recommendations on what should be developed further, improved, or parked.


**Qualifications**
* AI-native mindset: You are excited about AI tools, agents, orchestration, and the new way of building software with AI.
* Own AI projects required: You have independently built or seriously experimented with your own AI projects, such as agents, prompt workflows, LLM apps, automations, RAG prototypes, AI coding experiments, or learning tools. You should be able to show at least one concrete project, demo, repo, write-up, or clear example of what you built and learned.
* Extreme drive: You have built or experimented with your own projects. You do not wait for permission. You make things happen.
* Fast iterator: You prototype quickly, learn from feedback, and are comfortable with messy early-stage exploration.
* Technical curiosity: Some coding ability or strong willingness to learn. TypeScript, Python, frontend prototyping, RAG, vector databases, or knowledge graphs are a plus.
* Learning mindset: You are curious about how people learn and how AI can improve content creation, feedback, practice, and retention.
* Strong communicator: You can explain your work clearly in Swedish and English.


 Why join Uniplay?
   

  

* Work on AI that turns real company knowledge into learning experiences.
* Experiment with RAG, agents, knowledge graphs, structured generation, and interactive learning.
* Collaborate with engineers, AI specialists, HR experts, and product designers.
* Take a prototype through the full cycle: idea → experiment → evaluation → product recommendation.
* Get weekly 1:1 mentorship and access to Uniplay assets, course examples, and AI tools.


 Uniplay is the world’s first game-based, AI-powered learning platform designed to transform corporate learning into an engaging experience. Founded by Linus Blomberg, a gaming industry veteran, and Eric Francia, a serial entrepreneur, Uniplay merges advanced game design with microlearning and AI technology to create a revolutionary corporate training experience, poised to redefine the way professionals learn and grow. Uniplay is an AI-first company, headquartered in Stockholm, Sweden. Visit Uniplay.io to learn more.

title: Function Developer - Engine Control Systems
description:
**Location** 
 : Gothenburg
   

  

**Assignment type** 
 : Consulting assignment
   

  

**Start:** 
 As soon as possible / according to agreement
   

  

 We are looking for a Function Developer for a consulting assignment within advanced automotive engineering. You will join an experienced development team working with engine control software for petrol and hybrid powertrains. The role focuses on developing, testing and validating control functions related to air charge estimation and control, combining model-based software development with analysis and practical testing.
   

  

 This is a hands-on engineering role where you will work throughout the development process, from function design and implementation to testing, evaluation and verification.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities Will Include**
* Develop and improve control functions for petrol and hybrid powertrains
* Work with functions related to air charge estimation and control
* Develop embedded control software using MATLAB and Simulink
* Work with model-based development tools such as Embedded Coder and TargetLink
* Test, analyse and validate developed functions
* Perform simulations and support Software-in-the-Loop (SIL) testing
* Analyse test results and troubleshoot function behaviour
* Plan, document and report development and verification activities
* Collaborate with software, calibration, testing and powertrain engineers


**Job requirements**
 To be successful in this role, we believe you have:
   

  

* B.Sc. or M.Sc. in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Engineering Physics or a similar technical field
* Experience in embedded systems or function development
* Strong knowledge of MATLAB and Simulink
* Experience with model-based software development
* Knowledge of Embedded Coder, TargetLink or similar tools
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills
* Professional proficiency in English


 It is not a must, but an advantage if you have:
   

  

* Knowledge of internal combustion engines and engine control systems
* Academic or professional experience within combustion engines, electronics or software development
* Experience with SIL testing
* Programming experience in Python
* Previous experience from automotive or powertrain development
* A valid B driving licence
* Swedish language skills


 You are a structured and analytical engineer who enjoys combining software development with practical testing and problem-solving. You are comfortable taking ownership of your work, investigating technical issues independently and communicating your findings clearly. You enjoy working in a collaborative engineering environment where software, controls and physical systems come together.
 **Application procedure**
 A Maandag® recruiter will assess your application as soon as possible to determine whether you are suitable for an open position.
   

  

**About The Company**
 If you are a good match, we would like to receive a CV in WORD format with motivation why you fit this assignment, your availability and any scheduled holidays.
